7.2.3.d: चतुर्विम्̐शो ऽग्निष्टोमो दशमम् अहर् अविवाक्यम् /
7.2.3.m: The tenth day is an agniṣṭoma having the twenty-fourfold stoma, during which no dispute may take place.

7.2.3.d: तस्मिन्न् अपहताय प्रतिरूपैः शब्दैः परिहरेयुः /
7.2.3.m: On it, so that [error] may be averted, they should make circumlocutions with appropriate words.

7.2.3.s: tathā cen na śaknuyur brahmā gṛhapatir upadraṣṭāro vā vibrūyuḥ /
7.2.3.d: तथा चेन् न शक्नुयुर् ब्रह्मा गृहपतिर् उपद्रष्टारो वा विब्रूयुः /
7.2.3.m: If they should not be able to do so, the brahman, the master of the house, or the overseers should speak out distinctly.

7.2.3.s: yāv akṣarau vibrūyus tau hotre vedayeran /
7.2.3.d: याव् अक्षरौ विब्रूयुस् तौ होत्रे वेदयेरन् /
7.2.3.m: Whatever two syllables they speak out distinctly, they should announce those to the hotṛ.

7.2.3.d: ताम् अनुष्टुभं परोक्षम्̐ संपादयेत् /
7.2.3.m: He should complete that anuṣṭubh verse indirectly.

7.2.3.s:
patnīsam̐yājānte prāñco 'bhyudetya
ayam̐ sahasramānavo dṛśaḥ kavīnāṃ matir jyotir vidharma /
bradhnaḥ samīcīr uṣasaḥ samairayat /
arepasaḥ sacetasaḥ svasare manyumantaś citā goḥ //
ity āhavanīyam upatiṣṭhante /
7.2.3.d:
पत्नीसम्̐याजान्ते प्राञ्चो ऽभ्युदेत्य
अयम्̐ सहस्रमानवो दृशः कवीनां मतिर् ज्योतिर् विधर्म /
ब्रध्नः समीचीर् उषसः समैरयत् /
अरेपसः सचेतसः स्वसरे मन्युमन्तश् चिता गोः //
इत्य् आहवनीयम् उपतिष्ठन्ते /
7.2.3.m: At the conclusion of the patnīsaṃyājas, having stepped forward eastward, they attend upon the āhavanīya fire with: / “This one, having a thousand minds, vision, thought of the poets, light, support; / the bright one has impelled the Dawns together; / stainless, attentive, in their dwelling, full of zeal, collected from the cow.”

7.2.3.d: सदः प्रसृप्योपविशन्ति /
7.2.3.m: Having crept into the sadas, they sit down.

7.2.3.d: हविर्धानं प्रपद्याध्वर्युर् मानसं ग्रहं गृह्णाति /
7.2.3.m: Entering the havirdhāna shed, the adhvaryu draws the mental cup.

7.2.3.s: imāṃ pātraṃ kṛtvā vāyum̐ somam upayāmagṛhīto 'si prajāpataye tvā \\ iti manasā grahaṇasādane stotropākaraṇaṃ ca /
7.2.3.d: इमां पात्रं कृत्वा वायुम्̐ सोमम् उपयामगृहीतो ऽसि प्रजापतये त्वा \\ इति मनसा ग्रहणसादने स्तोत्रोपाकरणं च /
7.2.3.m: Having made this [earth] the vessel, [he takes] Vāyu [and] Soma; the drawing and placing with the formula: “You are taken with a support; for Prajāpati [I take] you…” and the bringing near of the stotra [are performed] mentally.

7.2.3.d: सार्पराज्ञीषु पराचीषु स्तुत्वा होतारम् ईक्षते /
7.2.3.m: Having chanted on the Sārparājñī verses consecutively, he looks at the hotṛ priest.

7.2.3.d: तास्व् अध्वर्युर् मनसा पर्तिगृणाति //
7.2.3.m: To them the adhvaryu priest responds mentally.

7.2.3.d: अध्वर्यो ब्रह्म वदाव \\ इत्य् आमन्त्रयते //
7.2.3.m: He addresses: 'O adhvaryu, let us two speak sacred wisdom.'

7.2.3.d: ओम्̐ होतर् इत्य् अध्वर्युः /

7.2.3.s: vyavasāyaṃ caturhotṝn hotā vyācaṣṭe saha ṣaḍḍhotrā saptahotāram antataḥ //
7.2.3.d: व्यवसायं चतुर्होतॄन् होता व्याचष्टे सह षड्ढोत्रा सप्तहोतारम् अन्ततः //
7.2.3.m: Pausing, the hotṛ priest recites the caturhotṛ formulas together with the ṣaḍḍhotṛ formula, and the saptahotṛ formula at the end.

7.2.3.s: om̐ hotas tathā hotar iti pratigṛṇāti /
7.2.3.d: ओम्̐ होतस् तथा होतर् इति प्रतिगृणाति /
7.2.3.m: 'Om, O hotṛ; so be it, O hotṛ,' [the adhvaryu priest] responds.

7.2.3.s: pratigīrya caturhotṝn hotar ity uktvā prajāpatim̐ saptadaśam̐ vyācaṣṭe /
7.2.3.d: प्रतिगीर्य चतुर्होतॄन् होतर् इत्य् उक्त्वा प्रजापतिम्̐ सप्तदशम्̐ व्याचष्टे /
7.2.3.m: Having responded to the caturhotṛ formulas, having said, 'O hotṛ,' he recites Prajāpati as the seventeenth.

7.2.3.s: adhvaryur hotā yeṣām̐ vādhvaryuḥ prajāpatim̐ saptadaśam̐ yajñe 'nvāyattam̐ vedakā ṛdhnuvanti vaite sattriṇaḥ /
7.2.3.d: अध्वर्युर् होता येषाम्̐ वाध्वर्युः प्रजापतिम्̐ सप्तदशम्̐ यज्ञे ऽन्वायत्तम्̐ वेदका ऋध्नुवन्ति वैते सत्त्रिणः /
7.2.3.m: Whether the adhvaryu priest [or] the hotṛ priest—those whose adhvaryu priest knows Prajāpati as the seventeenth attached in the sacrifice—those session-sacrificers prosper.

7.2.3.s: naiṣām̐ yajño vyathate prajāpatau yajñena pratitiṣṭhanti //
7.2.3.d: नैषाम्̐ यज्ञो व्यथते प्रजापतौ यज्ञेन प्रतितिष्ठन्ति //
7.2.3.m: Their sacrifice does not waver; they are firmly established by the sacrifice in Prajāpati.

7.2.3.d: ओ श्रावय \\ इत्य् आम्नातम् /
एष वै प्रजापतिः सप्तदशो यज्ञे ऽन्वायत्तः /
7.2.3.m: This indeed is Prajāpati, the seventeenth attached in the sacrifice.

7.2.3.s: yadyanuvākyāyā eti yadi yājyāyā ataśca devenaiti /
7.2.3.d: यद्यनुवाक्याया एति यदि याज्याया अतश्च देवेनैति /
7.2.3.m: Whether it departs from the invitatory verse or whether from the offering verse, from that it departs with the deity.

7.2.3.s: naiṣām̐ yajño vyathate prajāpatau yajñena pratitiṣṭhanti //
7.2.3.d: नैषाम्̐ यज्ञो व्यथते प्रजापतौ यज्ञेन प्रतितिष्ठन्ति //
7.2.3.m: Their sacrifice does not waver; they are firmly established by the sacrifice in Prajāpati.

7.2.3.d: ओम् अध्वर्यो तथाध्वर्य इति प्रतिगृणाति /
7.2.3.m: 'Om, O adhvaryu; so be it, O adhvaryu,' he responds.

7.2.3.s: pratigīrya samāpte śastre grahādānaprabhṛti manasā kurvanty ā bhakṣaṇāt /
7.2.3.d: प्रतिगीर्य समाप्ते शस्त्रे ग्रहादानप्रभृति मनसा कुर्वन्त्य् आ भक्षणात् /
7.2.3.m: Having responded, when the recitation is finished, beginning with the taking of the cup up to the consumption, they perform mentally.

7.2.3.d: समीक्षणम् उपहवः /
जगच्छन्दसा भक्षयन्ति /
7.2.3.m: They consume with the jagatī metre.

7.2.3.s: apidhāya sadas iha dhṛtir \ iha svadhṛtir itiprabhṛtibhir audumbarīm ārabhya vācam̐ yachanti /
7.2.3.d: अपिधाय सदस् इह धृतिर् \ इह स्वधृतिर् इतिप्रभृतिभिर् औदुम्बरीम् आरभ्य वाचम्̐ यछन्ति /
7.2.3.m: Having closed the sadas, beginning with 'Here is support, here is self-support,' taking hold of the audumbarī post, they restrain their speech.

7.2.3.s: ādhivṛkṣasūryād ā vā nakṣatradarśanād anatikrāmantau dhiṣṇyān adhvaryū kṛṣṇājinam anvārabhete /
7.2.3.d: आधिवृक्षसूर्याद् आ वा नक्षत्रदर्शनाद् अनतिक्रामन्तौ धिष्ण्यान् अध्वर्यू कृष्णाजिनम् अन्वारभेते /
7.2.3.m: Until the sun is above the trees, or until the sight of the stars, not crossing the dhiṣṇya hearths, the two adhvaryu priests take hold of the black antelope skin.

7.2.3.s:
samanvārabdhāḥ prāñco 'bhyudetya
yuvaṃ tam indrāparvatā puroyudhā \ yo naḥ pṛtanyād apa taṃtam id dhatam\ vajreṇa taṃtam id dhatam /
dūre cattāya chantsad \ gahanam̐ yad inakṣat /
asmākam̐ śatrūn pari śūra viśvatas \\ darmā darṣīṣṭa viśvataḥ //
ity āgnīdhrīyam upatiṣṭhante /
7.2.3.d:
समन्वारब्धाः प्राञ्चो ऽभ्युदेत्य
युवं तम् इन्द्रापर्वता पुरोयुधा \ यो नः पृतन्याद् अप तंतम् इद् धतम्\ वज्रेण तंतम् इद् धतम् /
दूरे चत्ताय छन्त्सद् \ गहनम्̐ यद् इनक्षत् /
अस्माकम्̐ शत्रून् परि शूर विश्वतस् \\ दर्मा दर्षीष्ट विश्वतः //
इत्य् आग्नीध्रीयम् उपतिष्ठन्ते /
7.2.3.m:
Holding on continuously, going up eastward,

'You two, Indra and Parvata, as forefront fighters, / whoever would battle against us, strike that very one down, / with the vajra strike that very one down!

Let him hide far away who is driven off, / when he attains the abyss.

Around our enemies from every side, O hero, / let the shatterer tear from every side!'

—with [these verses] they attend upon the āgnīdhrīya hearth.

7.2.3.s: dvayoḥ samidha ādadhate varām̐ś ca vṛṇate /
7.2.3.d: द्वयोः समिध आदधते वराम्̐श् च वृणते /
7.2.3.m: On two [hearths] they place fuel sticks and choose boons.

7.2.3.d: उदयनीयो ऽतिरात्रः प्रायणीयेन व्याख्यातः /
7.2.3.m: The concluding atirātra is explained by the introductory one.

7.2.3.d: स सिद्धः संतिष्ठते /
7.2.3.m: It is concluded as established.

7.2.3.d: वापनकाले सशिखानि वापयन्ते /
7.2.3.m: At the time of shaving, they have [their hair] shaved together with the tufts.

7.2.3.d: पृथग् उदवसानीया /

7.2.4.m: Leading with the cup for Indra and Vāyu on the introductory and concluding days and on the tenth day.
In the previous three-day period of the pṛṣṭhya: leading with the cup for Indra and Vāyu, leading with the śukra cup, leading with the āgrāyaṇa cup.

7.2.4.s: samūḍha uttarasmin pṛṣṭhyatryahe chandomeṣu ca tryanīkān abhyasyed atha vyūḍha āgrāyaṇāgram aindravāyavāgraṃ dve śukrāgre āgrāyaṇāgram aindravāyavāgram /
7.2.4.d: समूढ उत्तरस्मिन् पृष्ठ्यत्र्यहे छन्दोमेषु च त्र्यनीकान् अभ्यस्येद् अथ व्यूढ आग्रायणाग्रम् ऐन्द्रवायवाग्रं द्वे शुक्राग्रे आग्रायणाग्रम् ऐन्द्रवायवाग्रम् /
7.2.4.m: In the combined [rite], in the second three-day period of the pṛṣṭhya and in the chandoma days, he should repeat the triads; then in the modified [rite]: leading with the āgrāyaṇa cup, leading with the cup for Indra and Vāyu, two leading with the śukra cup, leading with the āgrāyaṇa cup, leading with the cup for Indra and Vāyu.

7.2.4.s: upām̐śvabhiṣavo dvādaśa kṛtvo 'ṣṭau kṛtva ekādaśa kṛtvo 'tha chandomeṣv ekādaśa kṛtvo dvādaśa kṛtvo 'ṣṭau kṛtvaḥ /
7.2.4.d: उपाम्̐श्वभिषवो द्वादश कृत्वो ऽष्टौ कृत्व एकादश कृत्वो ऽथ छन्दोमेष्व् एकादश कृत्वो द्वादश कृत्वो ऽष्टौ कृत्वः /
7.2.4.m: The pressing of the upāṃśu cup is twelve times, eight times, eleven times; then in the chandoma days eleven times, twelve times, eight times.

7.2.4.s: etena kapālayogā vyākhātā bhakṣamantrāś ca pavamānānumantraṇāni ca //
7.2.4.d: एतेन कपालयोगा व्याखाता भक्षमन्त्राश् च पवमानानुमन्त्रणानि च //
7.2.4.m: By this, the arrangements of potsherds, the consumption formulas, and the accompanying mantras for the pavamāna chants are explained.

7.2.4.s: mahaṃ indro ya ojasā \\ iti gāyatrī māhendrasya puro ṛg bhuvas tvam indra \\ iti chanomeṣu ca /
7.2.4.d: महं इन्द्रो य ओजसा \\ इति गायत्री माहेन्द्रस्य पुरो ऋग् भुवस् त्वम् इन्द्र \\ इति छनोमेषु च /
7.2.4.m: 'Great Indra who by might' is the gāyatrī introductory verse of the Māhendra cup; 'You, O Indra, became' in the chandoma days as well.
He seizes the group of eleven animals distributed [over the days].

7.2.4.s: sattrād udavasāya pṛṣṭhaśamanīyair agniṣṭomaiḥ sahasradakṣiṇair yajeran /
7.2.4.d: सत्त्राद् उदवसाय पृष्ठशमनीयैर् अग्निष्टोमैः सहस्रदक्षिणैर् यजेरन् /
7.2.4.m: Having moved away from the sacrificial session, they should sacrifice with agniṣṭoma rites soothing the pṛṣṭha sāmans, with a thousand cows as sacrificial gift.
The sacrificial sessions and ahīna rites have the twelve-day rite as their archetype.
For the course of the cows, they should undergo initiation on the twelfth day of the Māgha fortnight.
It is established up to the introductory atirātra.
After that, the twenty-four-stoma introductory ukthya rite.

7.2.4.s: tato 'bhiplavaḥ ṣaḍaho jyotir agniṣṭomo gaur ukthya āyur ukthyo gaur ukthya āyur ukthyo jyotir agniṣṭomaḥ /
7.2.4.d: ततो ऽभिप्लवः षडहो ज्योतिर् अग्निष्टोमो गौर् उक्थ्य आयुर् उक्थ्यो गौर् उक्थ्य आयुर् उक्थ्यो ज्योतिर् अग्निष्टोमः /
7.2.4.m: Then the abhiplava six-day period: jyotiṣṭoma agniṣṭoma, go ukthya, āyus ukthya, go ukthya, āyus ukthya, jyotiṣṭoma agniṣṭoma.

7.2.4.s: taṃ catur abhyaset pṛṣṭhyam̐ ṣaḍaham upayanti sa māsaḥ /
7.2.4.d: तं चतुर् अभ्यसेत् पृष्ठ्यम्̐ षडहम् उपयन्ति स मासः /
7.2.4.m: He should repeat that four times; they undertake the pṛṣṭhya six-day period: that is a month.
By that [pattern] they proceed for four months.

7.2.4.s: trayo 'bhiplavāḥ ṣaḍahāḥ pṛṣṭhyaḥ ṣaḍaho 'bhijittrayaḥ svarasāmāno 'gniṣṭomā ukthyā vā /
7.2.4.d: त्रयो ऽभिप्लवाः षडहाः पृष्ठ्यः षडहो ऽभिजित्त्रयः स्वरसामानो ऽग्निष्टोमा उक्थ्या वा /
7.2.4.m: Three abhiplava six-day periods, a pṛṣṭhya six-day period, the abhijit day, three svarasāman days—agniṣṭomas or ukthyas.

7.2.4.s: teṣv anvaham̐ saṃtanoty atigrāhyān sarvatropayāmasādanaṃ ca //
7.2.4.d: तेष्व् अन्वहम्̐ संतनोत्य् अतिग्राह्यान् सर्वत्रोपयामसादनं च //
7.2.4.m: On these he connects the atigrāhya cups day after day; everywhere there is drawing [with a holder formula] and setting down.

7.2.4.s: upayāmagṛhīto 'si \ prajāpataye tvā prajābhyas \\ iti gṛhṇāti \\ eṣa te yoniḥ \ prajāpataye tvā prajābhyas \\ iti sādayati prajāpataye prajābhyas \\ iti juhoti \\ antarikṣāya tvā vanaspataye \\ iti gṛhṇāti \\ eṣa te yonir \ antarikṣāya tvā vanaspataye \\ iti sādayati \\ antarikṣāya vanaspataye \\ iti juhoti \\ adbhyas tvauṣadhībhyas \\ iti gṛhṇāti \\ eṣa te yonir \ adbhyas tvauṣadhībhyas \\ iti sādayati \\ adbhya oṣadhībhyas \\ iti juhoti /
7.2.4.d: उपयामगृहीतो ऽसि \ प्रजापतये त्वा प्रजाभ्यस् \\ इति गृह्णाति \\ एष ते योनिः \ प्रजापतये त्वा प्रजाभ्यस् \\ इति सादयति प्रजापतये प्रजाभ्यस् \\ इति जुहोति \\ अन्तरिक्षाय त्वा वनस्पतये \\ इति गृह्णाति \\ एष ते योनिर् \ अन्तरिक्षाय त्वा वनस्पतये \\ इति सादयति \\ अन्तरिक्षाय वनस्पतये \\ इति जुहोति \\ अद्भ्यस् त्वौषधीभ्यस् \\ इति गृह्णाति \\ एष ते योनिर् \ अद्भ्यस् त्वौषधीभ्यस् \\ इति सादयति \\ अद्भ्य ओषधीभ्यस् \\ इति जुहोति /
7.2.4.m: 'You are held by a holder; for Prajāpati, for the offspring, [I take] you'—with this he draws; 'This is your womb; for Prajāpati, for the offspring, [I set] you'—with this he sets it down; 'For Prajāpati, for the offspring'—with this he offers. 'For the intermediate space, for the lord of the forest, [I take] you'—with this he draws; 'This is your womb; for the intermediate space, for the lord of the forest, [I set] you'—with this he sets it down; 'For the intermediate space, for the lord of the forest'—with this he offers. 'For the waters, for the plants, [I take] you'—with this he draws; 'This is your womb; for the waters, for the plants, [I set] you'—with this he sets it down; 'For the waters, for the plants'—with this he offers.
That two-day period from the beginning: that is the month.
The first half [of the year] has a single accumulation.
Above that is the viṣuvant day, having the divākīrtya sāman,

7.2.5.m: At sunrise he enters upon the morning recitation.

7.2.5.s: tasminn atigrāhyān gṛhṇāti vṛttān saṃtanīn ud u tyaṃ jātavedasam iti sauryam āvṛttān saṃtanīn oṣadhībhyo 'dbhyo vanaspatibhyo 'ntarikṣāya prajābhyaḥ prajāpataye \ vācaspatim iti vaiśvakarmaṇam ayā viṣṭhā \\ iti prājāpatyam /
7.2.5.d: तस्मिन्न् अतिग्राह्यान् गृह्णाति वृत्तान् संतनीन् उद् उ त्यं जातवेदसम् इति सौर्यम् आवृत्तान् संतनीन् ओषधीभ्यो ऽद्भ्यो वनस्पतिभ्यो ऽन्तरिक्षाय प्रजाभ्यः प्रजापतये \ वाचस्पतिम् इति वैश्वकर्मणम् अया विष्ठा \\ इति प्राजापत्यम् /
7.2.5.m: On it he draws the atigrāhya cups, recurring [and] connecting: with 'Up that Jātavedas' the cup for Sūrya; recurring [and] connecting, for the plants, for the waters, for the lords of the forest, for the intermediate space, for the offspring, for Prajāpati; with 'The lord of speech' the cup for Viśvakarman; with 'By this posture' the cup for Prajāpati.
A white he-goat sacred to Sūrya is to be seized, having an inaudible deity.

7.2.5.s: yady astamite hāryo 'jo na syāt sūryo divo diviṣadbhyas \\ viśvān muñcatv am̐hasaḥ \ sa naḥ parṣad ati dviṣas \\ iti juhoti /
7.2.5.d: यद्य् अस्तमिते हार्यो ऽजो न स्यात् सूर्यो दिवो दिविषद्भ्यस् \\ विश्वान् मुञ्चत्व् अम्̐हसः \ स नः पर्षद् अति द्विषस् \\ इति जुहोति /
7.2.5.m: If at sunset the he-goat to be taken is not available, he offers with: 'May Sūrya from the sky release from all distress all those dwelling in heaven; may he take us across beyond the foes.'

7.2.5.d: उत्तरस्मिन् पक्षस्य् आवृत्ताः स्वरसामानो ऽभिप्लवाश् च /
7.2.5.m: In the latter half, the svarasāman days and the abhiplava six-day periods are reversed.
Above the viṣuvant are the svarasāman days.
In these, the saṃtani rites are reversed.

7.2.5.s: teṣāṃ prathame sutrāmāṇam ity ādityam atigrāhyaṃ gṛhṇāti /
7.2.5.d: तेषां प्रथमे सुत्रामाणम् इत्य् आदित्यम् अतिग्राह्यं गृह्णाति /
7.2.5.m: On the first of them, he draws the supplementary cup for the Ādityas with: "The good protector..."

7.2.5.s: śvobhūte vaiśvakarmaṇāntau vyatyāsam ā mahāvratād gṛhṇāti /
7.2.5.d: श्वोभूते वैश्वकर्मणान्तौ व्यत्यासम् आ महाव्रताद् गृह्णाति /
7.2.5.m: On the following day, he draws [the cups] ending with that for Viśvakarman alternately, up to the Mahāvrata.
The Viśvajit has crafts, has all the Pṛṣṭha-sāmans; at the midday service, during the Pṛṣṭha-stotras, there are crafts.
There is a Pṛṣṭhya six-day period commencing with the thirty-three-versed [stoma].
There are three Abhiplava six-day periods.

7.2.5.s: pṛṣṭhyaḥ ṣaḍahas trayastrim̐śārambhaṇaś catvāro 'bhiplavāḥ ṣaḍahāḥ sa māsaḥ /
7.2.5.d: पृष्ठ्यः षडहस् त्रयस्त्रिम्̐शारम्भणश् चत्वारो ऽभिप्लवाः षडहाः स मासः /
7.2.5.m: A Pṛṣṭhya six-day period commencing with the thirty-three-versed [stoma] and four Abhiplava six-day periods: that is a month.
With that, they proceed for four months.

7.2.5.s: trayo 'bhiplavāḥ ṣaḍahā āyuś ca gauś ca dve ahanī dvādaśāhasya daśāhāni /
7.2.5.d: त्रयो ऽभिप्लवाः षडहा आयुश् च गौश् च द्वे अहनी द्वादशाहस्य दशाहानि /
7.2.5.m: Three Abhiplava six-day periods, the two days Āyus and Go, and the ten days of the twelve-day rite;

7.2.5.s: ūrdhvam̐ viṣuvato 'ṣṭāvim̐śatyaho mahāvrataṃ cātirātraś ca māsaḥ /
7.2.5.d: ऊर्ध्वम्̐ विषुवतो ऽष्टाविम्̐शत्यहो महाव्रतं चातिरात्रश् च मासः /
7.2.5.m: after the Viṣuvant day, a twenty-eight-day period, the Mahāvrata, and an Atirātra: that is a month.
This is the Dvāsaṃbhārya arrangement. Now the Ekasaṃbhārya arrangement:

7.2.5.s: pṛṣṭhyaḥ ṣaḍahas trayastrim̐śārambhaṇaś catvāro 'bhiplavāḥ ṣaḍahāḥ sa māsaḥ /
7.2.5.d: पृष्ठ्यः षडहस् त्रयस्त्रिम्̐शारम्भणश् चत्वारो ऽभिप्लवाः षडहाः स मासः /
7.2.5.m: A Pṛṣṭhya six-day period commencing with the thirty-three-versed [stoma] and four Abhiplava six-day periods: that is a month.

7.2.5.s: dvāv abhiplavau ṣaḍahāv āyuś ca gauś ca dve ahanī dvādaśāhasya daśāhāny ūrdhvam̐ viṣuvataś caturaho mahāvrataṃ cātirātraś ca māsaḥ /
7.2.5.d: द्वाव् अभिप्लवौ षडहाव् आयुश् च गौश् च द्वे अहनी द्वादशाहस्य दशाहान्य् ऊर्ध्वम्̐ विषुवतश् चतुरहो महाव्रतं चातिरात्रश् च मासः /
7.2.5.m: Two Abhiplava six-day periods, the two days Āyus and Go, the ten days of the twelve-day rite; after the Viṣuvant day, a four-day period, the Mahāvrata, and an Atirātra: that is a month.

7.2.6.m: The Mahāvrata is a twenty-five-versed Agniṣṭoma.
When [the sun] has risen, he commences the morning recitation.

7.2.6.s: tasminn atigrāhyapātrāṇi prayunakty arkagrahāya pañca pūrvaṃ dakṣiṇam uttaram aparaṃ madhya ātmanīnaṃ / pṛṣṭhebhyo vṛttebhyaḥ saṃtanibhyaḥ sauryāyā vṛttebhyaḥ saṃtanibhya ādityavaiśvakarmaṇaprājāpatyebhyo vṛṣṭigrahāya mārttikaṃ catustanam̐ sārasvatāya ṣoḍaśaṃ pṛśniprāṇagrahebhyaḥ pañcadaśa vaiṣṇavaṃ dvātrim̐śaṃ bārhaspatyaṃ trayastrim̐śam /
7.2.6.d: तस्मिन्न् अतिग्राह्यपात्राणि प्रयुनक्त्य् अर्कग्रहाय पञ्च पूर्वं दक्षिणम् उत्तरम् अपरं मध्य आत्मनीनं / पृष्ठेभ्यो वृत्तेभ्यः संतनिभ्यः सौर्याया वृत्तेभ्यः संतनिभ्य आदित्यवैश्वकर्मणप्राजापत्येभ्यो वृष्टिग्रहाय मार्त्तिकं चतुस्तनम्̐ सारस्वताय षोडशं पृश्निप्राणग्रहेभ्यः पञ्चदश वैष्णवं द्वात्रिम्̐शं बार्हस्पत्यं त्रयस्त्रिम्̐शम् /
7.2.6.m: On it, he equips the vessels of the supplementary cups: five for the Arka cup—east, south, north, west, and in the middle the one pertaining to the self; for the Pṛṣṭha-sāmans that have turned back, for the Saṃtani rites; for the Sūrya cup, for the Saṃtani rites that have turned back; for the Āditya, Vaiśvakarman, and Prājāpatya cups; for the rain cup, an earthen one having four teats; a sixteenth for that of Sarasvat; fifteen for the spotted-breath cups; a thirty-second for that of Viṣṇu; a thirty-third for that of Bṛhaspati.
He touches the Aṃśu and Adābhya cups at their proper time with the spotted-breath cups.

7.2.6.s: vāyur asi prāṇo nāma svāhā tvā devāya savitre \ varco me dās \\ āyur asi cakṣur nāma svāhā tvā devāya dhātre \ śrotraṃ me dās \\ rūpam asi varṇo nāma svāhā tvā devāyendrāya \ kṣatraṃ me dāḥ \ śrutam asi satyaṃ nāma svāhā tvā devāya bṛhaspataye \ rāyaspoṣaṃ me dās \\ bhūmir asi bhūtir nāma svāhā tvā devebhyaḥ pitṛbhyas \\ apām oṣadhīnāṃ garbhaṃ me dās \\ ṛtasya tvā vyomne gṛhṇāmi \\ ṛtasya tvā vidharmaṇe gṛhṇāmi \\ ṛtasya tvā jyotiṣe gṛhṇāmi \\ ṛtasya tvā satyāya gṛhṇāmi \\ ṛtasya tvā mātrāyai gṛhṇāmi \\ ayaṃ puro bhūr iti pṛśniprāṇagrahān yathākālaṃ gṛhṇāti //
7.2.6.d: वायुर् असि प्राणो नाम स्वाहा त्वा देवाय सवित्रे \ वर्चो मे दास् \\ आयुर् असि चक्षुर् नाम स्वाहा त्वा देवाय धात्रे \ श्रोत्रं मे दास् \\ रूपम् असि वर्णो नाम स्वाहा त्वा देवायेन्द्राय \ क्षत्रं मे दाः \ श्रुतम् असि सत्यं नाम स्वाहा त्वा देवाय बृहस्पतये \ रायस्पोषं मे दास् \\ भूमिर् असि भूतिर् नाम स्वाहा त्वा देवेभ्यः पितृभ्यस् \\ अपाम् ओषधीनां गर्भं मे दास् \\ ऋतस्य त्वा व्योम्ने गृह्णामि \\ ऋतस्य त्वा विधर्मणे गृह्णामि \\ ऋतस्य त्वा ज्योतिषे गृह्णामि \\ ऋतस्य त्वा सत्याय गृह्णामि \\ ऋतस्य त्वा मात्रायै गृह्णामि \\ अयं पुरो भूर् इति पृश्निप्राणग्रहान् यथाकालं गृह्णाति //
7.2.6.m: "You are wind, breath by name; svāhā to you, god Savitṛ! Give me luster! You are life, sight by name; svāhā to you, god Dhātṛ! Give me hearing! You are form, color by name; svāhā to you, god Indra! Give me dominion! You are sacred learning, truth by name; svāhā to you, god Bṛhaspati! Give me abundance of wealth! You are earth, prosperity by name; svāhā to you, gods and fathers! Give me the embryo of waters and plants! I take you for the expanse of cosmic order; I take you for the distribution of cosmic order; I take you for the light of cosmic order; I take you for the truth of cosmic order; I take you for the measure of cosmic order! This one in front is Bhūḥ..."—with these, he takes the spotted-breath cups at their proper time.

7.2.6.s:
indram id gāthinas \\ iti pūrvārdhād upayāmagṛhīto 'si \\ indrāya tvārkavate \\ iti gṛhṇāti \\ eṣa te yonir \ indrāya tvārkavate \\ iti sādayati \\ abhi tvā śūra nonumas \\ iti dakṣiṇārdhe tvām id dhi havāmahe \\ ity uttarārdhe
imā nu kaṃ bhuvanā sīṣadhema\ indraś ca viśve ca devāḥ /
yajñaṃ ca nas tanvaṃ ca prajāṃ ca\ ādityair indraḥ saha sīṣadhātu //
iti paścārdhe
tad id āsa bhuvaneṣu jyeṣṭham\ yato jajña ugras tveṣanṛmṇaḥ /
sadyo jajñāno ni riṇāti śatrūn \ anu yam̐ viśve madanty ūmāḥ //
ity ātmanīne yathā prayuktam /
7.2.6.d:
इन्द्रम् इद् गाथिनस् \\ इति पूर्वार्धाद् उपयामगृहीतो ऽसि \\ इन्द्राय त्वार्कवते \\ इति गृह्णाति \\ एष ते योनिर् \ इन्द्राय त्वार्कवते \\ इति सादयति \\ अभि त्वा शूर नोनुमस् \\ इति दक्षिणार्धे त्वाम् इद् धि हवामहे \\ इत्य् उत्तरार्धे
इमा नु कं भुवना सीषधेम\ इन्द्रश् च विश्वे च देवाः /
यज्ञं च नस् तन्वं च प्रजां च\ आदित्यैर् इन्द्रः सह सीषधातु //
इति पश्चार्धे
तद् इद् आस भुवनेषु ज्येष्ठम्\ यतो जज्ञ उग्रस् त्वेषनृम्णः /
सद्यो जज्ञानो नि रिणाति शत्रून् \ अनु यम्̐ विश्वे मदन्त्य् ऊमाः //
इत्य् आत्मनीने यथा प्रयुक्तम् /

7.2.6.s:
itarām̐ś catustane
kṣetrasya pate madhumantam ūrmim\ dhenur iva payo asmāsu dhukṣva /
madhuścutaṃ ghṛtam iva supūtam \ ṛtasya naḥ patayo mṛḍayantu //
iti \\ upayāmagṛhīto 'si \\ adityai tvā caturūdhnyai \\ iti tṛtīyagrahaṃ mahīm ū ṣu mātaram iti dvitīyabhāgam idaṃ tṛtīyam̐ savanam iti saṃpūrayati \\ eṣa te yonir \ adityai tvā caturūdhnyai \\ iti sādayati // pāvakā naḥ sarasvatī \\ iti sārasvatam \\ vāyur asi \\ iti pṛśniprāṇagrahān idam̐ viṣṇur iti vaiṣṇavaṃ // bṛhaspatiḥ prathamaṃ jāyamānas \\ iti bārhaspatyam /
7.2.6.d:
इतराम्̐श् चतुस्तने
क्षेत्रस्य पते मधुमन्तम् ऊर्मिम्\ धेनुर् इव पयो अस्मासु धुक्ष्व /
मधुश्चुतं घृतम् इव सुपूतम् \ ऋतस्य नः पतयो मृडयन्तु //
इति \\ उपयामगृहीतो ऽसि \\ अदित्यै त्वा चतुरूध्न्यै \\ इति तृतीयग्रहं महीम् ऊ षु मातरम् इति द्वितीयभागम् इदं तृतीयम्̐ सवनम् इति संपूरयति \\ एष ते योनिर् \ अदित्यै त्वा चतुरूध्न्यै \\ इति सादयति // पावका नः सरस्वती \\ इति सारस्वतम् \\ वायुर् असि \\ इति पृश्निप्राणग्रहान् इदम्̐ विष्णुर् इति वैष्णवं // बृहस्पतिः प्रथमं जायमानस् \\ इति बार्हस्पत्यम् /
7.2.6.m:
—with this, in the one pertaining to the self, according as it was arranged.

"O Lord of the Field, a wave rich in sweetness, / like a milch cow, yield milk for us;

dripping sweetness, like well-purified ghee, / let the lords of cosmic order be gracious to us,"

—with this; with: "You are held by a support; for Aditi with four udders...", he draws the third cup; he fills it up with: "The great mother...", as the second part, and with: "This third pressing..."; with: "This is your womb; for Aditi with four udders...", he sets it down. With: "Purifying us, Sarasvatī...", the cup for Sarasvat; with: "You are wind...", the spotted-breath cups; with: "This Viṣṇu...", the cup for Viṣṇu; with: "Bṛhaspati, when first being born...", the cup for Bṛhaspati.

7.2.7.s: māhendrakāle śilpāni vyāyātayanti /
7.2.7.d: माहेन्द्रकाले शिल्पानि व्यायातयन्ति /
7.2.7.m: At the time of the Māhendra cup, they arrange the crafts.

7.2.7.s: upariṣady uktham /
7.2.7.d: उपरिषद्य् उक्थम् /

7.2.7.s: āsandy udgātuḥ preṅkho hotuḥ phalakam adhvaryoḥ kūrca itareṣām /
7.2.7.d: आसन्द्य् उद्गातुः प्रेङ्खो होतुः फलकम् अध्वर्योः कूर्च इतरेषाम् /
7.2.7.m: An armchair is for the udgātṛ priest, a swing for the hotṛ priest, a plank for the adhvaryu priest, and a grass seat for the others.

7.2.7.s: vāṇaḥ śatatantir audumbarapātro mauñjībhis tantibhiḥ khādiradaṇḍo vīṇākṛtir vatsatvacāpihitaḥ /
7.2.7.d: वाणः शततन्तिर् औदुम्बरपात्रो मौञ्जीभिस् तन्तिभिः खादिरदण्डो वीणाकृतिर् वत्सत्वचापिहितः /
7.2.7.m: The vāṇa lute has a hundred strings, an udumbara sound-box, strings of muñja grass, a khadira neck, the shape of a vīṇā, and is covered with calf-skin.

7.2.7.s: tam̐ vetasaśākhayā samullikhyodgātre prayachan stotram upākaroti /
7.2.7.d: तम्̐ वेतसशाखया समुल्लिख्योद्गात्रे प्रयछन् स्तोत्रम् उपाकरोति /
7.2.7.m: Having scraped it with a cane branch and handed it to the udgātṛ priest, he initiates the stotra.

7.2.7.s: tam̐ yajamānāya prayachati /
7.2.7.d: तम्̐ यजमानाय प्रयछति /
7.2.7.m: He hands it to the sacrificer.

7.2.7.s: tam̐ sam̐vādayaty ā stotranidhanāt /
7.2.7.d: तम्̐ सम्̐वादयत्य् आ स्तोत्रनिधनात् /
7.2.7.m: He makes it sound along until the finale of the stotra.

7.2.7.s: sarvāṇi vīṇājātāni patnya upavādayanty ā kāṇḍavīṇābhyaḥ /
7.2.7.d: सर्वाणि वीणाजातानि पत्न्य उपवादयन्त्य् आ काण्डवीणाभ्यः /
7.2.7.m: The wives play all kinds of lutes, down to the reed-lutes.

7.2.7.s: dikṣu dundubhayo vadanti bhūmidundubhiḥ pañcamaḥ paścād āgnīdhrīyasya jānudaghno 'rdham antarvedi savanīyacarmaṇābhihito lāṅgūlavādinaḥ /
7.2.7.d: दिक्षु दुन्दुभयो वदन्ति भूमिदुन्दुभिः पञ्चमः पश्चाद् आग्नीध्रीयस्य जानुदघ्नो ऽर्धम् अन्तर्वेदि सवनीयचर्मणाभिहितो लाङ्गूलवादिनः /
7.2.7.m: In the quarters, kettle-drums resound; the earth-drum is the fifth, behind the āgnīdhrīya shed, knee-deep, half within the altar, covered with the skin of the sacrificial animal, sounding by means of its tail.

7.2.7.s:
aṣṭau dāsyaḥ kumbhinyo hatavasanā mārjālīyaṃ dvedve
gāva eva surabhayas\ gāvo guggulagandhayaḥ /
gāvo ghṛtasya mātaras \ tā iha santu bhūyasīḥ //
iti gāyanti \\ idaṃ madhūkamadhu \\ iti pādau nihatya pradakṣiṇaṃ parītaḥ /
na vai gāvo maṅgīrasya \ gaṅgāyā udakaṃ papuḥ /
papuḥ sarasvatyāṃ nadyām\ tāḥ prācīr ujjigāhire //
idaṃ madhu \\ ity apare /
yadā rāghārādyam̐ vadatas\ grāmyamāṅgīradāsakau /
kṣemair ṛdhyete grāmo vā\ anaḍvām̐s tapyate vahan //
idaṃ madhu \\ ity apare /
etā vayaṃ plavāmahe \ śamyāḥ pracaratām iha /
nigīrya tubhyaṃ madhvas\ ākarṣe kuṣṭho yathā //
iti ninīya pratipariyanti /
7.2.7.d:
अष्टौ दास्यः कुम्भिन्यो हतवसना मार्जालीयं द्वेद्वे
गाव एव सुरभयस्\ गावो गुग्गुलगन्धयः /
गावो घृतस्य मातरस् \ ता इह सन्तु भूयसीः //
इति गायन्ति \\ इदं मधूकमधु \\ इति पादौ निहत्य प्रदक्षिणं परीतः /
न वै गावो मङ्गीरस्य \ गङ्गाया उदकं पपुः /
पपुः सरस्वत्यां नद्याम्\ ताः प्राचीर् उज्जिगाहिरे //
इदं मधु \\ इत्य् अपरे /
यदा राघाराद्यम्̐ वदतस्\ ग्राम्यमाङ्गीरदासकौ /
क्षेमैर् ऋध्येते ग्रामो वा\ अनड्वाम्̐स् तप्यते वहन् //
इदं मधु \\ इत्य् अपरे /
एता वयं प्लवामहे \ शम्याः प्रचरताम् इह /
निगीर्य तुभ्यं मध्वस्\ आकर्षे कुष्ठो यथा //
इति निनीय प्रतिपरियन्ति /

7.2.7.s: agreṇa mārjālīyam̐ śūdrāryau carma vyāyachete vāśam̐ śvetaṃ parimaṇḍalam ima udvāsīkāriṇa ime durbhūtam akran \\ iti bahirvedi śūdras \\ ime 'rātsur ime sūdam akran \\ ity antarvedy āryaḥ / saṃjitya prasadasyādadhāti /
7.2.7.d: अग्रेण मार्जालीयम्̐ शूद्रार्यौ चर्म व्यायछेते वाशम्̐ श्वेतं परिमण्डलम् इम उद्वासीकारिण इमे दुर्भूतम् अक्रन् \\ इति बहिर्वेदि शूद्रस् \\ इमे ऽरात्सुर् इमे सूदम् अक्रन् \\ इत्य् अन्तर्वेद्य् आर्यः / संजित्य प्रसदस्यादधाति /
7.2.7.m:
—having poured out [the water] with this, they go back in reverse order.

To the east of the Mārjālīya fire, a Śūdra and an Ārya pull a white, round skin of a bull away from each other: "These performers of uprooting have done evil," the Śūdra says outside the sacrificial altar; "These have succeeded, these have done well," the Ārya says inside the sacrificial altar. Having won it, he places it before the sadas.

7.2.7.s: dakṣiṇasyām̐ vediśroṇau pariśrite vṛṣalamithunau bhavato 'pagarābhigarau / pūrvas \\ bahu vā ime 'smin sattre 'kuśalam acārṣur apīklojān apavamānān iti bahirvedy apagaras \\ bahu vā ime 'smin sattre kuśalam acārṣuḥ pīklojān pavamānān ity antarvedy abhigaro pūrvaḥ /
7.2.7.d: दक्षिणस्याम्̐ वेदिश्रोणौ परिश्रिते वृषलमिथुनौ भवतो ऽपगराभिगरौ / पूर्वस् \\ बहु वा इमे ऽस्मिन् सत्त्रे ऽकुशलम् अचार्षुर् अपीक्लोजान् अपवमानान् इति बहिर्वेद्य् अपगरस् \\ बहु वा इमे ऽस्मिन् सत्त्रे कुशलम् अचार्षुः पीक्लोजान् पवमानान् इत्य् अन्तर्वेद्य् अभिगरो पूर्वः /
7.2.7.m: At the southern hip of the sacrificial altar, in an enclosed space, there are a low-born pair, a blamer and a praiser. The blamer speaks first: "Much indeed have these done wrong at this sacrificial session, [they are] apīklojas, not purifying," says the blamer outside the sacrificial altar; "Much indeed have these done well at this sacrificial session, pīklojas, purifying," says the praiser first, inside the sacrificial altar.

7.2.7.s: brahmacārī pum̐ścalī ca \\ anāryakarmann avakīrṇi duścaritaṃ nirākṛtam iti bahirvedi pum̐ścalī dhik tvā jāraṃ parasya janasya nirmārjani puruṣasyapuruṣasya śiśnapraṇejani \\ ity antarvedi brahmacārī /
7.2.7.d: ब्रह्मचारी पुम्̐श्चली च \\ अनार्यकर्मन्न् अवकीर्णि दुश्चरितं निराकृतम् इति बहिर्वेदि पुम्̐श्चली धिक् त्वा जारं परस्य जनस्य निर्मार्जनि पुरुषस्यपुरुषस्य शिश्नप्रणेजनि \\ इत्य् अन्तर्वेदि ब्रह्मचारी /
7.2.7.m: A Vedic student and a courtesan: "O un-Aryan actor, unchaste one, your misdeed is repudiated," says the courtesan outside the sacrificial altar; "Fie on you, paramour, wiper-off of strange people, washer of every man's penis!" says the Vedic student inside the sacrificial altar.

7.2.7.s: uttaratas tīrthasyāpayānāyāvakāśaṃ kṛtvopariṣṭādgrīvam̐ vāśam̐ śvetaṃ carma vighnanti /
7.2.7.d: उत्तरतस् तीर्थस्यापयानायावकाशं कृत्वोपरिष्टाद्ग्रीवम्̐ वाशम्̐ श्वेतं चर्म विघ्नन्ति /
7.2.7.m: North of the pilgrimage path, having made room for withdrawal, they pierce a white bull's hide that has its neck turned upward.

7.2.7.s: yasyā rājabhaktis tasyās talpo rājaputro brāhmaṇo rājanyo vā /
7.2.7.d: यस्या राजभक्तिस् तस्यास् तल्पो राजपुत्रो ब्राह्मणो राजन्यो वा /
7.2.7.m: She who has love for the king has a king's son, a Brahmin, or a nobleman for her couch.

7.2.7.s: agreṇa yūpāvaṭam̐ saṃnahyati /
7.2.7.d: अग्रेण यूपावटम्̐ संनह्यति /
7.2.7.m: East of the post-hole he girds himself.

7.2.7.s: saṃnaddhakavacaḥ pradakṣiṇam̐ vihāraṃ parītya trir āyamya tri rāvadhyati bhasadi madhye grīvāsu / prāṅ udyamya caturtham astā nivartayati /
7.2.7.d: संनद्धकवचः प्रदक्षिणम्̐ विहारं परीत्य त्रिर् आयम्य त्रि रावध्यति भसदि मध्ये ग्रीवासु / प्राङ् उद्यम्य चतुर्थम् अस्ता निवर्तयति /
7.2.7.m: Having put on his armor and gone clockwise around the sacrificial enclosure, drawing [his bow] three times, he shoots three times: into the buttocks, into the middle, into the necks. Having raised [the bow] eastward, he shoots the fourth [arrow] and turns away.

7.2.7.s: phalakam āruhya pratigṛhṇāti tve kratum api vṛñjanti viśve \\ iti pūrvārdhāt \\ dvir yad ete trir bhavanty ūmās \\ iti dakṣiṇārdhāt svādoḥ svādīyaḥ svādunā sṛjā sam ity uttarārdhāt \\ adaḥ su madhu madhunābhi yodhīr iti paścārdhāt /
7.2.7.d: फलकम् आरुह्य प्रतिगृह्णाति त्वे क्रतुम् अपि वृञ्जन्ति विश्वे \\ इति पूर्वार्धात् \\ द्विर् यद् एते त्रिर् भवन्त्य् ऊमास् \\ इति दक्षिणार्धात् स्वादोः स्वादीयः स्वादुना सृजा सम् इत्य् उत्तरार्धात् \\ अदः सु मधु मधुनाभि योधीर् इति पश्चार्धात् /
7.2.7.m: Having mounted the plank, he receives: "Into you all turn their intention" from the front half; "When these become twofold, threefold, protectors" from the southern half; "Sweeter than the sweet, unite with the sweet" from the northern half; "Yonder honey, fight honey with honey" from the western half.

7.2.7.s: vṛṣṭigrahaṃ dadhigrahapātre 'vanayati /
7.2.7.d: वृष्टिग्रहं दधिग्रहपात्रे ऽवनयति /
7.2.7.m: He pours the rain cup into the curd-cup vessel.

7.2.7.s: āditye māhendreṇa hute dyugrahaṇam ātmanīne 'vanayati /
7.2.7.d: आदित्ये माहेन्द्रेण हुते द्युग्रहणम् आत्मनीने ऽवनयति /
7.2.7.m: When the āditya cup has been offered by the māhendra cup, he pours the day cup into the ātmanīna vessel.

7.2.7.s: āhrīyamāṇān bhakṣān pratyavarohanti //
7.2.7.d: आह्रीयमाणान् भक्षान् प्रत्यवरोहन्ति //
7.2.7.m: They descend towards the portions of food being brought.

7.2.7.s: mahas te bhakṣayāmi \ bhargas te bhakṣayāmi \ stomaṃ te bhakṣayāmi \ yaśas te bhakṣayāmi \\ annādyaṃ te bhakṣayāmi \\ ity ātmani taṃ bhakṣayataḥ /
7.2.7.d: महस् ते भक्षयामि \ भर्गस् ते भक्षयामि \ स्तोमं ते भक्षयामि \ यशस् ते भक्षयामि \\ अन्नाद्यं ते भक्षयामि \\ इत्य् आत्मनि तं भक्षयतः /
7.2.7.m: "I consume your greatness; I consume your splendor; I consume your stoma; I consume your renown; I consume your sustenance"—with this, both consume it into oneself.

7.2.7.s: vyākhyāto 'bhyastamite homaḥ /
7.2.7.d: व्याख्यातो ऽभ्यस्तमिते होमः /
7.2.7.m: The oblation at sunset has been explained.

7.2.8.s: dvādaśāhikānām ukto grahakalpaḥ /
7.2.8.d: द्वादशाहिकानाम् उक्तो ग्रहकल्पः /
7.2.8.m: The procedure of drawing cups for the twelve-day rites has been stated.

7.2.8.s: aindravāyavāgram̐ śukrāgram ity abhiplave 'bhyasyed āvṛtte śukraprabhṛti / svarasāmnāṃ prathamottamayor āyuṣi caindravāyavāgram̐ śukrāgramato 'nyat /
7.2.8.d: ऐन्द्रवायवाग्रम्̐ शुक्राग्रम् इत्य् अभिप्लवे ऽभ्यस्येद् आवृत्ते शुक्रप्रभृति / स्वरसाम्नां प्रथमोत्तमयोर् आयुषि चैन्द्रवायवाग्रम्̐ शुक्राग्रमतो ऽन्यत् /
7.2.8.m: Beginning with the Aindravāyava cup or beginning with the Śukra cup—thus in the Abhiplava he should repeat; when it turns back, beginning with the Śukra cup. For the first and the last of the Svarasāman days and for the Āyus day, beginning with the Aindravāyava cup; beginning with the Śukra cup for what is other than this.

7.2.8.s: paśukḷptiḥ /
7.2.8.d: पशुकॢप्तिः /

7.2.8.s: ekādaśināḥ prāyaṇīyodayanīyayor aindrāgnau 'ntardhāv api vā kratupaśavaḥ sarvasminn aindrāgno vā /
7.2.8.d: एकादशिनाः प्रायणीयोदयनीययोर् ऐन्द्राग्नौ ऽन्तर्धाव् अपि वा क्रतुपशवः सर्वस्मिन्न् ऐन्द्राग्नो वा /
7.2.8.m: The sets of eleven animals at the introductory and concluding days; at the interval, two animals to Indra and Agni, or the sacrificial animals for the ritual, or an animal to Indra and Agni in every [rite].

7.2.8.s: ṣaḍupālambhyā / bārhaspatyaḥ śitiprṣṭhas trayastrim̐śe 'hani dyāvāpṛthivīyā dhenuś chandome tasyā vatso vāyave dvitīye vāce pṛśnis tṛtīye 'dityai vaśāvivākye vaiśvakarmaṇa ṛṣabhas trirūpa eta ubhayato mahāvrate /
7.2.8.d: षडुपालम्भ्या / बार्हस्पत्यः शितिप्र्ष्ठस् त्रयस्त्रिम्̐शे ऽहनि द्यावापृथिवीया धेनुश् छन्दोमे तस्या वत्सो वायवे द्वितीये वाचे पृश्निस् तृतीये ऽदित्यै वशाविवाक्ये वैश्वकर्मण ऋषभस् त्रिरूप एत उभयतो महाव्रते /
7.2.8.m: Six animals are to be seized: a white-backed animal for Bṛhaspati on the thirty-third day; a milch cow for Heaven and Earth on the [first] Chandoma; her calf for Vāyu on the second; a speckled cow for Vāc on the third; a barren cow for Aditi on the Avivākya day; a three-colored bull for Viśvakarman—these on both sides at the Mahāvrata.

7.2.8.s: api vaikādaśinān vihṛtān abhyaset /
7.2.8.d: अपि वैकादशिनान् विहृतान् अभ्यसेत् /
7.2.8.m: Or he should repeat the sets of eleven animals distributed separately.

7.2.8.s: aikavim̐śās tato 'tiriktāḥ paśavo vaiṣṇavo vāmana ekavim̐śe triṇava upālambhya upām̐śudevata āgneyo 'jaḥ /
7.2.8.d: ऐकविम्̐शास् ततो ऽतिरिक्ताः पशवो वैष्णवो वामन एकविम्̐शे त्रिणव उपालम्भ्य उपाम्̐शुदेवत आग्नेयो ऽजः /
7.2.8.m: Belonging to twenty-one, the animals remaining beyond this: a dwarf animal for Viṣṇu on the twenty-first day; on the twenty-nine-fold day, an animal to be seized with a whispered deity, a goat for Agni.

7.2.8.s: utsṛjyamānānāṃ gavāmayane dvādaśotsarjanāni /
7.2.8.d: उत्सृज्यमानानां गवामयने द्वादशोत्सर्जनानि /
7.2.8.m: For those [days] that are omitted, there are twelve omissions in the Gavāmayana.

7.2.8.s: siddham ā trayastrim̐śāt /
7.2.8.d: सिद्धम् आ त्रयस्त्रिम्̐शात् /
7.2.8.m: The procedure up to the thirty-third day is established.

7.2.8.s: trayastrim̐śe 'hanīndrāya sāṃnāyyāya vatsān apākaroti /
7.2.8.d: त्रयस्त्रिम्̐शे ऽहनीन्द्राय सांनाय्याय वत्सान् अपाकरोति /
7.2.8.m: On the thirty-third day, he drives away the calves for the curd and milk offering for Indra.

7.2.8.s: purā vasatīvarīṇāṃ pariharaṇād dohayati /
7.2.8.d: पुरा वसतीवरीणां परिहरणाद् दोहयति /
7.2.8.m: Before carrying around the Vasatīvarī waters, he milks.

7.2.8.s: parihṛtāsu vasatīvarīṣu dvyahe sutyām āhvayaty upodayam̐ śvaḥsutyām udite /
7.2.8.d: परिहृतासु वसतीवरीषु द्व्यहे सुत्याम् आह्वयत्य् उपोदयम्̐ श्वःसुत्याम् उदिते /
7.2.8.m: When the Vasatīvarī waters have been carried around, on the two-day rite he invokes the soma-pressing ceremony; toward dawn [he invokes] the next day's soma-pressing ceremony; after sunrise [he invokes it].

7.2.8.s: vāgyatāḥ prājāpatyena sam̐sthāpayanti /
7.2.8.d: वाग्यताः प्राजापत्येन सम्̐स्थापयन्ति /
7.2.8.m: Restraining their speech, they conclude with [the rite] dedicated to Prajāpati.

7.2.8.s: siddham ā sāmidhenībhyaḥ / sāmitūṣṇīkena caikakapālena sāmidhenīr anuvācayati /
7.2.8.d: सिद्धम् आ सामिधेनीभ्यः / सामितूष्णीकेन चैककपालेन सामिधेनीर् अनुवाचयति /
7.2.8.m: The procedure up to the kindling verses is established. And he causes the kindling verses to be recited with a silent single potsherd.

7.2.8.s: upām̐śudevatasya vapayā pracaryāgnaye vasumate prātar aṣṭākapālaṃ nirvapati /
7.2.8.d: उपाम्̐शुदेवतस्य वपया प्रचर्याग्नये वसुमते प्रातर् अष्टाकपालं निर्वपति /
7.2.8.m: Having performed [the offering] with the omentum of [the victim of] the whispered deity, he apportions an eight-potsherd cake for Agni endowed with Vasus in the morning.

7.2.8.s: atapte prātardohe sāyaṃdoham ānīya samāsādya pracaraty uccaiḥ praiṣavadbhyām /
7.2.8.d: अतप्ते प्रातर्दोहे सायंदोहम् आनीय समासाद्य प्रचरत्य् उच्चैः प्रैषवद्भ्याम् /
7.2.8.m: Without heating the morning milking, having brought in the evening milking and placed it down together, he proceeds aloud with two calls.

7.2.8.s: āgnīdhrabhāgānte somapānaiś camasair dadhnas tṛtīyaṃ bhakṣayanti /
7.2.8.d: आग्नीध्रभागान्ते सोमपानैश् चमसैर् दध्नस् तृतीयं भक्षयन्ति /
7.2.8.m: At the end of the portion for the āgnīdhra priest, they consume a third of the curd with the cups used for drinking soma.

7.2.8.s: indrāya marutvata ekādaśakapālaṃ madhyaṃdine samāsādya pracaraty uccaiḥ praiṣavadbhyām /
7.2.8.d: इन्द्राय मरुत्वत एकादशकपालं मध्यंदिने समासाद्य प्रचरत्य् उच्चैः प्रैषवद्भ्याम् /
7.2.8.m: Having placed down an eleven-potsherd cake for Indra accompanied by the Maruts at midday, he proceeds aloud with two calls.

7.2.8.s: āgnīdhrabhāgānte somapānaiś camasair dadhna itarārdhaṃ bhakṣayanti /
7.2.8.d: आग्नीध्रभागान्ते सोमपानैश् चमसैर् दध्न इतरार्धं भक्षयन्ति /
7.2.8.m: At the end of the portion for the āgnīdhra priest, they consume the other half of the curd with the cups used for drinking soma.

7.2.8.s: viśvebhyo devebhyo dvādaśakapālam aparāhṇe samāsādya pracaraty uccaiḥ praiṣavadbhyām /
7.2.8.d: विश्वेभ्यो देवेभ्यो द्वादशकपालम् अपराह्णे समासाद्य प्रचरत्य् उच्चैः प्रैषवद्भ्याम् /
7.2.8.m: Having placed down a twelve-potsherd cake for the Viśve Devas in the afternoon, he proceeds aloud with two calls.

7.2.8.s: āgnīdhrabhāgānte somapānaiś camasair dadhnaḥ śeṣaṃ bhakṣayanti /
7.2.8.d: आग्नीध्रभागान्ते सोमपानैश् चमसैर् दध्नः शेषं भक्षयन्ति /
7.2.8.m: At the end of the portion for the āgnīdhra priest, they consume the remainder of the curd with the cups used for drinking soma.

7.2.8.s: patnīsam̐yājānte sam̐sthite śvaḥsutyām āhvayati /
7.2.8.d: पत्नीसम्̐याजान्ते सम्̐स्थिते श्वःसुत्याम् आह्वयति /
7.2.8.m: When it is concluded at the end of the Patnīsaṃyājas, he invokes the next day's soma-pressing ceremony.

7.2.8.s: śvobhūte sotum evopakramante /
7.2.8.d: श्वोभूते सोतुम् एवोपक्रमन्ते /
7.2.8.m: On the next day, they indeed commence pressing soma.

7.2.8.s: teṣām etat prathamam utsarjanam /
7.2.8.d: तेषाम् एतत् प्रथमम् उत्सर्जनम् /
7.2.8.m: This is their first omission.

7.2.8.s: tataś catvāri māsimāsi prāgabhijitaḥ ṣaṣṭham ūrdhvam̐ viśvajitaḥ saptamaṃ tato 'ṣṭāvim̐śatyahe tataś catvāri māsimāsi /
7.2.8.d: ततश् चत्वारि मासिमासि प्रागभिजितः षष्ठम् ऊर्ध्वम्̐ विश्वजितः सप्तमं ततो ऽष्टाविम्̐शत्यहे ततश् चत्वारि मासिमासि /
7.2.8.m: Then [there are] four, month after month, before the Abhijit; the sixth after the Viśvajit; the seventh then after twenty-eight days; then four, month after month.

7.2.8.s: tāni ced adhikāni syur amāvāsyāyāṃ dīkṣeran atha cet saṃpūraṇāni dvādaśyāṃ dvādaśyām /
7.2.8.d: तानि चेद् अधिकानि स्युर् अमावास्यायां दीक्षेरन् अथ चेत् संपूरणानि द्वादश्यां द्वादश्याम् /
7.2.8.m: If they are additional, they should undergo consecration on the new-moon day; but if they are completing [the number], on the twelfth [day], on the twelfth [day].

8.1.0.m: Now we shall explain the dispensations.
He may offer the evening oblation toward dawn, or the morning oblation toward sunset.

8.1.0.s: kālena kālaṃ nātikramed agnihotrasya darśapūrṇamāsayoś cāturmāsyaparvaṇāṃ paśubandhasyāgrāyaṇasya ca /
8.1.0.d: कालेन कालं नातिक्रमेद् अग्निहोत्रस्य दर्शपूर्णमासयोश् चातुर्मास्यपर्वणां पशुबन्धस्याग्रायणस्य च /
8.1.0.m: He must not let the proper time pass by the time of the Agnihotra, of the New- and Full-Moon sacrifices, of the seasonal festivals, of the animal sacrifice, and of the first-fruits offering.

8.1.0.s: varṣāsv abhrasaṃghāte yady anastamite juhuyāt punar astamite / yady avyuṣṭāyāṃ punar vyuṣṭāyām /
8.1.0.d: वर्षास्व् अभ्रसंघाते यद्य् अनस्तमिते जुहुयात् पुनर् अस्तमिते / यद्य् अव्युष्टायां पुनर् व्युष्टायाम् /
8.1.0.m: In the rainy season, when clouds mass together, if he should offer when [the sun] has not set, [he should offer] again when it has set; if [he should offer] when it has not dawned, [he should offer] again when it has dawned.

8.1.0.s: na skanden na vyathata iti ha vijñāyate /
8.1.0.d: न स्कन्देन् न व्यथत इति ह विज्ञायते /
8.1.0.m: "It does not fail, it does not waver," so indeed it is known.

8.1.0.s: ṛṣayo ha pra āsan prayogikā āsam̐s te 'rdhamāsāyārdhamāsāyāgnihotram ajuhavuḥ /
8.1.0.d: ऋषयो ह प्र आसन् प्रयोगिका आसम्̐स् ते ऽर्धमासायार्धमासायाग्निहोत्रम् अजुहवुः /
8.1.0.m: The ṛṣis indeed were roaming, they were constantly engaged in ritual practice; they offered the Agnihotra every half-month.

8.1.0.s: tasmād yāyāvara āmayāvyārto vā so 'rdhamāsāyārdhamāsāyāgnihotraṃ juhoti /
8.1.0.d: तस्माद् यायावर आमयाव्यार्तो वा सो ऽर्धमासायार्धमासायाग्निहोत्रं जुहोति /
8.1.0.m: Therefore, a wandering ascetic, or one who is diseased or afflicted, offers the Agnihotra every half-month.

8.1.0.s: caturdaśa caturgṛhītāni sakṛd unnayaty ekā samit sakṛd dhomaḥ / so 'rdhamāsāya kalpate /
8.1.0.d: चतुर्दश चतुर्गृहीतानि सकृद् उन्नयत्य् एका समित् सकृद् धोमः / सो ऽर्धमासाय कल्पते /
8.1.0.m: He draws up fourteen four-ladlings at one time; there is a single kindling stick, a single offering. It serves for half a month.

8.1.0.s: homān srucy unnayet sruvapūrṇām̐ś caturdaśa gārhapatyadakṣiṇāgnyos tathāparān /
8.1.0.d: होमान् स्रुच्य् उन्नयेत् स्रुवपूर्णाम्̐श् चतुर्दश गार्हपत्यदक्षिणाग्न्योस् तथापरान् /
8.1.0.m: He should draw up the oblations in the offering ladle, fourteen sruva-spoonfuls; likewise the other [oblations] for the gārhapatya fire and the southern fire.
The mantras and the offerings for the sabhya and āvasathya fires are just as revealed.
The morning offering is explained by this very same four-offering.

8.1.0.s: ṣaṇmāsāhute 'gnihotre darśapūrṇamāsābhyām aniṣṭvāgrāyaṇena paśunā vāgnaye tantumate 'gnaye pathikṛte 'ṣṭākapālau nirupyāgrāyaṇaṃ kurvīta /
8.1.0.d: षण्मासाहुते ऽग्निहोत्रे दर्शपूर्णमासाभ्याम् अनिष्ट्वाग्रायणेन पशुना वाग्नये तन्तुमते ऽग्नये पथिकृते ऽष्टाकपालौ निरुप्याग्रायणं कुर्वीत /
8.1.0.m: When the Agnihotra has not been offered for six months, not having sacrificed with the New- and Full-Moon sacrifices, with the first-fruits offering, or with an animal sacrifice, having apportioned two eight-potsherd cakes for Agdi the String-Holder and Agni the Path-Maker, he should perform the first-fruits offering.

8.1.0.s: sam̐vatsarāhute 'gnihotre darśapūrṇamāsābhyām aniṣṭvāgrāyaṇena paśunāgnaye tantumate 'gnaye pathikṛte 'ṣṭākapālāv agnaye vaiśvānarāya dvādaśakapālaṃ nirupyāntaritān homāñ juhuyād api vā pūrṇāhutim̐ hutvā nādriyeta homān /
8.1.0.d: सम्̐वत्सराहुते ऽग्निहोत्रे दर्शपूर्णमासाभ्याम् अनिष्ट्वाग्रायणेन पशुनाग्नये तन्तुमते ऽग्नये पथिकृते ऽष्टाकपालाव् अग्नये वैश्वानराय द्वादशकपालं निरुप्यान्तरितान् होमाञ् जुहुयाद् अपि वा पूर्णाहुतिम्̐ हुत्वा नाद्रियेत होमान् /
8.1.0.m: When the Agnihotra has not been offered for a year, not having sacrificed with the New- and Full-Moon sacrifices, with the first-fruits offering, or with an animal sacrifice, having apportioned two eight-potsherd cakes for Agni the String-Holder and Agni the Path-Maker, and a twelve-potsherd cake for Agni Vaiśvānara, he should offer the omitted oblations; or, having offered a full-spoon oblation, he may disregard the oblations.

8.1.0.s: agnihotraṃ darśapūrṇamāsau paśvāgrāyaṇam iti sarvam avāpnoti /
8.1.0.d: अग्निहोत्रं दर्शपूर्णमासौ पश्वाग्रायणम् इति सर्वम् अवाप्नोति /
8.1.0.m: He obtains everything: the Agnihotra, the New- and Full-Moon sacrifices, the animal sacrifice, and the first-fruits sacrifice.

8.1.0.s: āgrāyaṇaṃ kṛtvāhavanīye varaṃ dadyād gaur vāso vāśvasthāne vijñāyate /
8.1.0.d: आग्रायणं कृत्वाहवनीये वरं दद्याद् गौर् वासो वाश्वस्थाने विज्ञायते /
8.1.0.m: Having performed the first-fruits sacrifice, he should give a choice boon at the āhavanīya fire: a cow, a garment, or it is known [from tradition that one gives] in place of a horse.

8.1.0.s: indriyeṇa vā eṣa vīryeṇa vyṛdhyate yasya pitā pitāmaḥ somaṃ na pibed iti /
8.1.0.d: इन्द्रियेण वा एष वीर्येण व्यृध्यते यस्य पिता पितामः सोमं न पिबेद् इति /
8.1.0.m: "He indeed is deprived of power and vigor whose father and grandfather did not drink soma," so [it is said].

8.1.0.s: tasmād bhakṣāṇāṃ bhojyānāṃ mūlānāṃ phalānām api vā pūrṇapātraṃ dadyān na tv eva na yajeta /
8.1.0.d: तस्माद् भक्षाणां भोज्यानां मूलानां फलानाम् अपि वा पूर्णपात्रं दद्यान् न त्व् एव न यजेत /
8.1.0.m: Therefore, he should give a full vessel of foods, eatables, roots, or fruits, but he should certainly not neglect to sacrifice.

8.2.0.s: tadalābhe tailaṃ pratinidhis tadalābhe dadhi payo vā tadalābhe yavapiṣṭāni taṇḍulapiṣṭāni vā /
8.2.0.d: तदलाभे तैलं प्रतिनिधिस् तदलाभे दधि पयो वा तदलाभे यवपिष्टानि तण्डुलपिष्टानि वा /
8.2.0.m: If that is not available, sesame oil is a substitute; if that is not available, curds or milk; if that is not available, barley flour or rice flour.
Having mixed them with water, he should prepare the substitutes for clarified butter.

8.2.0.s: teṣām alābhe parvavatībhiḥ kāṇḍavatībhir auṣadhībhiḥ staraṇārthān kurvīta kaṭasīraśūṣaśuṇṭhanalaparivāhamūtapavalvajavarjam /
8.2.0.d: तेषाम् अलाभे पर्ववतीभिः काण्डवतीभिर् औषधीभिः स्तरणार्थान् कुर्वीत कटसीरशूषशुण्ठनलपरिवाहमूतपवल्वजवर्जम् /
8.2.0.m: In the absence of these, he should make the strewing materials with plants having joints and stems, except kaṭasīra, śūṣa, śuṇṭha, nala, parivāha, mūta, and pavalvaja.
The firewood sticks of the sacrificial fuel are two spans long.

8.2.0.s: araṇiś caturaṅgulotsedhā ṣaḍaṅgulavistārā caturvim̐śatyaṅguladīrghā / mūlād aṣṭāṅgulam utsṛjya bhūyaś cānyat tryaṅgulaṃ devayonir iti khyātā tatra manthed dhutāśanam /
8.2.0.d: अरणिश् चतुरङ्गुलोत्सेधा षडङ्गुलविस्तारा चतुर्विम्̐शत्यङ्गुलदीर्घा / मूलाद् अष्टाङ्गुलम् उत्सृज्य भूयश् चान्यत् त्र्यङ्गुलं देवयोनिर् इति ख्याता तत्र मन्थेद् धुताशनम् /
8.2.0.m: The fire-drill is four fingers high, six fingers wide, and twenty-four fingers long. Leaving eight fingers from the root and further another three fingers, that is known as the 'womb of the gods'; there he should churn the fire.

8.2.0.s: aratnimātrāḥ paridhayaḥ śākhāpavitraṃ ca prādeśamātrāvalam̐ vipāṇitalacaturbhāgas tu kapālapramāṇam /
8.2.0.d: अरत्निमात्राः परिधयः शाखापवित्रं च प्रादेशमात्रावलम्̐ विपाणितलचतुर्भागस् तु कपालप्रमाणम् /
8.2.0.m: The enclosing sticks and the strainer branch are a cubit long or a span long; but the measure of a potsherd is one-fourth of the palm of the hand.

8.2.0.s: tāny aṣṭau mṛdā sam̐sṛjya gārhapatye prathayati /
8.2.0.d: तान्य् अष्टौ मृदा सम्̐सृज्य गार्हपत्ये प्रथयति /
8.2.0.m: Combining those eight with clay, he spreads [the cake] on the gārhapatya fire.

8.2.0.s: etenaivā trayastrim̐śād ā trayastrim̐śād dhrasīyohrasīyaḥ kapālapramāṇam̐ varṣīyovarṣīyaḥ pratyupakarṣaḥ syāt /
8.2.0.d: एतेनैवा त्रयस्त्रिम्̐शाद् आ त्रयस्त्रिम्̐शाद् ध्रसीयोह्रसीयः कपालप्रमाणम्̐ वर्षीयोवर्षीयः प्रत्युपकर्षः स्यात् /
8.2.0.m: In this very manner, up to thirty-three [potsherds], the smaller and smaller the measure of the potsherd should be, the larger and larger should be the corresponding reduction.
He spreads all the potsherds to the size of a horse's hoof.

8.2.0.s: yad uktaṃ tad avyaktam uccāvacā hy aśvā bhavanti /
8.2.0.d: यद् उक्तं तद् अव्यक्तम् उच्चावचा ह्य् अश्वा भवन्ति /
8.2.0.m: What is said there is indefinite, for horses are of various sizes.

8.2.0.d: त्रिहायणस्यैवाश्वस्य चतुर्मुष्टिः पुरोडाशो भवति द्यावापृथिवीयो ऽपि /
8.2.0.m: The sacrificial cake is of four handfuls, precisely corresponding to a three-year-old horse, and so also that for Dyāvāpṛthivī.
Just so they deal with the remaining flour smearings.

8.2.0.s: tṛtīyādheye nājyabhāgā ijyete iti gautamas tau na śaunasoma iti vātsyaḥ /
8.2.0.d: तृतीयाधेये नाज्यभागा इज्येते इति गौतमस् तौ न शौनसोम इति वात्स्यः /
8.2.0.m: In the third establishment [of the fires], the two clarified butter portions are not offered, says Gautama; Śaunasoma says that the two are not [omitted], says Vātsya.

8.2.0.s: kriyate / cakṣuṣī vā ete yajñasya yad ājyabhāgau /
8.2.0.d: क्रियते / चक्षुषी वा एते यज्ञस्य यद् आज्यभागौ /
8.2.0.m: [The offering] is performed. These two clarified butter portions are indeed the two eyes of the sacrifice.

8.2.0.s: yad ājyabhāgāv antariyāc cakṣuṣī yajñasyāntariyād iti ha vijñāyate /
8.2.0.d: यद् आज्यभागाव् अन्तरियाच् चक्षुषी यज्ञस्यान्तरियाद् इति ह विज्ञायते /
8.2.0.m: It is known [from the Śruti]: 'If he were to omit the two clarified butter portions, he would omit the two eyes of the sacrifice.'

8.3.0.s: yadi vatseṣv apākṛteṣu gā rājā caurā avāharerann āvidyeran pramīyeran vā katham̐ sāṃnāyyasya pratīyād ity āhur ācāryāḥ /
8.3.0.d: यदि वत्सेष्व् अपाकृतेषु गा राजा चौरा अवाहरेरन्न् आविद्येरन् प्रमीयेरन् वा कथम्̐ सांनाय्यस्य प्रतीयाद् इत्य् आहुर् आचार्याः /
8.3.0.m: If, after the calves are separated, the king or thieves take away the cows, or they are lost, or they die, how should he proceed with the curd and milk offering? Thus the teachers ask.

8.3.0.s: prāg ardharātrāt sāyam̐doham ākāṅkṣet prāṅ madhyaṃdinād iti prātaḥ /
8.3.0.d: प्राग् अर्धरात्रात् सायम्̐दोहम् आकाङ्क्षेत् प्राङ् मध्यंदिनाद् इति प्रातः /
8.3.0.m: He should await the evening milking before midnight, and the morning [milking] before midday.

8.3.0.s: tāsām̐ yady āgachet tāṃ trir vigrāhaṃ dohayed dvitīyāṃ dvir vigrāhaṃ tṛtīyāṃ trir vigrāham /
8.3.0.d: तासाम्̐ यद्य् आगछेत् तां त्रिर् विग्राहं दोहयेद् द्वितीयां द्विर् विग्राहं तृतीयां त्रिर् विग्राहम् /
8.3.0.m: If [only one] of them returns, he should milk it with three interruptions; the second with two interruptions; the third with three interruptions.
If all return, [the milking is] as prescribed.

8.3.0.s: yadi naivāgachet kam̐ hana iti rājagṛhītāsu japed yāḥ senā iti cauragṛhītāsu vāg agregās \\ iti naṣṭāsu yamagāthāḥ pramītāsu /
8.3.0.d: यदि नैवागछेत् कम्̐ हन इति राजगृहीतासु जपेद् याः सेना इति चौरगृहीतासु वाग् अग्रेगास् \\ इति नष्टासु यमगाथाः प्रमीतासु /
8.3.0.m: If they do not return at all, he should mutter 'Whom do we kill…' if seized by the king; 'The armies which…' if seized by thieves; 'May Speech go ahead…' if lost; and the Yama songs if dead.

8.3.0.s: evaṃ kṛte ced āgachet tūṣṇīṃ dugdhvā brāhmaṇebhyaḥ payo dadyāt /
8.3.0.d: एवं कृते चेद् आगछेत् तूष्णीं दुग्ध्वा ब्राह्मणेभ्यः पयो दद्यात् /
8.3.0.m: If, having done so, they return, he should give the milk to the brahmins after milking silently.

8.3.0.d: यत् पयो ऽधिगछेत् त्रिर् विग्राहं दोहयेत् /
8.3.0.m: Whatever milk he obtains, he should milk it with three interruptions.

8.3.0.s: anadhigate cet payasy aindraṃ pañcaśarāvam odanaṃ piṣṭayavāgūr vā dravyam̐ syāt /
8.3.0.d: अनधिगते चेत् पयस्य् ऐन्द्रं पञ्चशरावम् ओदनं पिष्टयवागूर् वा द्रव्यम्̐ स्यात् /
8.3.0.m: If no milk is obtained, a boiled rice offering of five platters to Indra or a gruel of ground barley should be the substance.

8.3.0.s: vijñāyate ha paśūnām̐ vā etat payo yad vrīhiyavāv iti / tasmād etaj juhvati /
8.3.0.d: विज्ञायते ह पशूनाम्̐ वा एतत् पयो यद् व्रीहियवाव् इति / तस्माद् एतज् जुह्वति /
8.3.0.m: It is indeed known: 'Rice and barley are the milk of the cattle.' Therefore they offer this.

8.4.0.s: putre jāte 'śvatthasya śamīgarbhasyāraṇī āharati daśāṅgule dvādaśāṅgule vā /
8.4.0.d: पुत्रे जाते ऽश्वत्थस्य शमीगर्भस्यारणी आहरति दशाङ्गुले द्वादशाङ्गुले वा /
8.4.0.m: When a son is born, he brings two fire-drills of aśvattha wood grown out of a śamī tree, ten fingers or twelve fingers [long].

8.4.0.s: tābhyām agniṃ mathitvā tasya kumārasya jātakarma karoti /
8.4.0.d: ताभ्याम् अग्निं मथित्वा तस्य कुमारस्य जातकर्म करोति /
8.4.0.m: Having churned the fire with them, he performs the birth rite of that boy.

8.4.0.s: tasmin nāma kuryāt tasmim̐ś cūḍāṃ kārayet tasminn evopanayet tasmin vratacaryāṃ kurvīta tasmin bhāryām udvahet /
8.4.0.d: तस्मिन् नाम कुर्यात् तस्मिम्̐श् चूडां कारयेत् तस्मिन्न् एवोपनयेत् तस्मिन् व्रतचर्यां कुर्वीत तस्मिन् भार्याम् उद्वहेत् /
8.4.0.m: In that [fire] he should give him a name; in that he should have the tonsure performed; in that very fire he should initiate him; in that he should observe the student's vows; in that he should take a wife.

8.4.0.s: sa śālāgniḥ sa aupāsanīyaḥ pitur agnau vā sam̐skāraḥ /
8.4.0.d: स शालाग्निः स औपासनीयः पितुर् अग्नौ वा सम्̐स्कारः /
8.4.0.m: That is the hall-fire, that is the domestic fire, or the consecration takes place in the father's fire,
because of the text: 'You are indeed oneself named "son"'.
Having made it the one for the brahmins' boiled rice, they transfer it into the two fire-drills.
Having transferred it, they churn it again.
Having churned it, he should sacrifice there with unlimited sacrifices.

8.5.0.m: We shall explain the five-fire ritual.

8.5.0.s: sāyaṃprātarādhānavad agnipraṇayanam̐ śundhanasamindhanaparistaraṇaparyukṣaṇam̐ vyākhyātam̐ homaś ca //
8.5.0.d: सायंप्रातराधानवद् अग्निप्रणयनम्̐ शुन्धनसमिन्धनपरिस्तरणपर्युक्षणम्̐ व्याख्यातम्̐ होमश् च //
8.5.0.m: As in the evening and morning establishments, the bringing forward of the fires, the cleaning, the kindling, the strewing, the sprinkling around, and the oblation are explained.

8.5.0.s: agne sabhya pariṣadya juṣasva svāhā \\ iti sabhye juhoti \\ agna āvasathya pariṣadya juṣasva svāhā \\ ity āvasathye homaśeṣam /
8.5.0.d: अग्ने सभ्य परिषद्य जुषस्व स्वाहा \\ इति सभ्ये जुहोति \\ अग्न आवसथ्य परिषद्य जुषस्व स्वाहा \\ इत्य् आवसथ्ये होमशेषम् /
8.5.0.m: With 'O Agni of the assembly, sit in the assembly and be pleased, svāhā,' he offers in the sabhya fire; with 'O Agni of the hall, sit in the hall and be pleased, svāhā,' he offers the remainder of the oblation in the āvasathya fire.

8.5.0.s: vyāhṛtibhir yathāmnātam̐ hutvā \\ uta no 'hir budhnyas \\ iti sarvakāla āgrayaṇe ca sabhyāvasathyayor juhoti /
8.5.0.d: व्याहृतिभिर् यथाम्नातम्̐ हुत्वा \\ उत नो ऽहिर् बुध्न्यस् \\ इति सर्वकाल आग्रयणे च सभ्यावसथ्ययोर् जुहोति /
8.5.0.m: Having offered with the sacred utterances as prescribed, he offers in the sabhya and āvasathya fires at all times and at the first-fruits offering with 'And may Ahi Budhnya…'
When [the fire] is brought forward, he brings forward the sabhya and āvasathya fires; not in optional sacrifices.

8.5.0.s: vijñāyate ha pañca vā ete prāṇāpānasamānavyānodānās teṣām̐ vā ete dhṛtyai guptyai pañcāgnayaḥ praṇīyante /
8.5.0.d: विज्ञायते ह पञ्च वा एते प्राणापानसमानव्यानोदानास् तेषाम्̐ वा एते धृत्यै गुप्त्यै पञ्चाग्नयः प्रणीयन्ते /
8.5.0.m: It is indeed known: 'These are the five: prāṇa, apāna, samāna, vyāna, and udāna; for their support and protection these five fires are brought forward.'

8.5.0.s: pāṅkto yajño / yāvān eva yajñas tam ālabdha /
8.5.0.d: पाङ्क्तो यज्ञो / यावान् एव यज्ञस् तम् आलब्ध /
8.5.0.m: 'Fivefold is the sacrifice; as great as the sacrifice is, he took hold of it.'

8.6.0.m: Now, one likely to die should establish the fires.

8.6.0.s: nartu na nakṣatraṃ na joṣayituṃ na saṃbhārān ādriyeta /
8.6.0.d: नर्तु न नक्षत्रं न जोषयितुं न संभारान् आद्रियेत /
8.6.0.m: He should pay no regard to the season, nor to the lunar mansion, nor to approval, nor to the ritual requisites.

8.6.0.s: na sārparājñīr anvāha na gharmaśiraḥ prāha /
8.6.0.d: न सार्पराज्ञीर् अन्वाह न घर्मशिरः प्राह /
8.6.0.m: He does not recite the Sārparājñī verses, nor does he pronounce the Gharmaśiras formula.

8.6.0.s: ko ha tad veda yac chvo bhaviṣyatīti saṃbhārārthe valmīkavapāṃ darbhām̐ś ca nyupya mantrān āvartayet /
8.6.0.d: को ह तद् वेद यच् छ्वो भविष्यतीति संभारार्थे वल्मीकवपां दर्भाम्̐श् च न्युप्य मन्त्रान् आवर्तयेत् /
8.6.0.m: Saying 'Who knows what will happen tomorrow?', having thrown down an ant-hill crown and darbha grass for the sake of the requisites, he should repeat the mantras.

8.6.0.s: vijñāyate ha pṛthivī śamistasyā eṣa garbho yad aśvatthaḥ /
8.6.0.d: विज्ञायते ह पृथिवी शमिस्तस्या एष गर्भो यद् अश्वत्थः /
8.6.0.m: It is indeed known: 'The earth is the śamī; its embryo is the aśvattha.'

8.6.0.s: tasmād araṇī āhṛtya tābhyām agniṃ mathitvā bhūr iti gārhapatyam ādadhyād bhuvas \\ iti dakṣiṇāgnim \\ svar ity āhavanīyaṃ bhūr bhuvaḥ svar iti sabhyāvasathyau /
8.6.0.d: तस्माद् अरणी आहृत्य ताभ्याम् अग्निं मथित्वा भूर् इति गार्हपत्यम् आदध्याद् भुवस् \\ इति दक्षिणाग्निम् \\ स्वर् इत्य् आहवनीयं भूर् भुवः स्वर् इति सभ्यावसथ्यौ /
8.6.0.m: Therefore, having brought the two fire-drills and churned the fire with them, he should establish the gārhapatya with 'Bhūḥ', the southern fire with 'Bhuvaḥ', the āhavanīya with 'Svar', and the sabhya and āvasathya with 'Bhūr bhuvaḥ svar'.

8.6.0.s: yadi prāk pūrṇāhuteḥ pramīyeta hutvā pūrṇāhutim āhitāgnividhinā dāhayeyur yady ūrdhvam āgneyīm̐ sam̐sthāpya yady ūrdhvam āgneyyā iṣṭisam̐sthaṃ kuryād amriyamāṇe cāta ūrdhvam aparimitaiḥ kratubhir yajeta /
8.6.0.d: यदि प्राक् पूर्णाहुतेः प्रमीयेत हुत्वा पूर्णाहुतिम् आहिताग्निविधिना दाहयेयुर् यद्य् ऊर्ध्वम् आग्नेयीम्̐ सम्̐स्थाप्य यद्य् ऊर्ध्वम् आग्नेय्या इष्टिसम्̐स्थं कुर्याद् अम्रियमाणे चात ऊर्ध्वम् अपरिमितैः क्रतुभिर् यजेत /
8.6.0.m: If he should die before the full-spoon offering, they should burn him according to the rule for one who has established the fires after offering the full-spoon offering; if after, having concluded the rite to Agni; if after that to Agni, he should complete it with the offering; and if he does not die, he should sacrifice from that time on with unlimited sacrifices.

8.7.0.s: pravasantam eva samījyopādānam etān somārthān agnīn utpādya yajeta /
8.7.0.d: प्रवसन्तम् एव समीज्योपादानम् एतान् सोमार्थान् अग्नीन् उत्पाद्य यजेत /
8.7.0.m: Setting out on a journey, after concluding the sacrifice, taking these fires produced for the sake of Soma, he should sacrifice.

8.7.0.s: iṣṭvā vāgnīnām utsargo na vā śrutiprāmāṇyāt /
8.7.0.d: इष्ट्वा वाग्नीनाम् उत्सर्गो न वा श्रुतिप्रामाण्यात् /
8.7.0.m: After sacrificing, there is either abandonment of the fires or not, on the authority of the Śruti.

8.7.0.s: vīrahā vā eṣa devānām̐ yo 'gnim utsādayata iti / tasmān notsṛjet /
8.7.0.d: वीरहा वा एष देवानाम्̐ यो ऽग्निम् उत्सादयत इति / तस्मान् नोत्सृजेत् /
8.7.0.m: 'He is indeed a slayer of the heroes of the gods who puts out his fire,' [says the text]; therefore he should not abandon [them].

8.7.0.s: pūrveṣv agniṣūttarān sahāraṇikān bhavataṃ naḥ samanasau \\ ity anuprahṛtyāgnaye 'gnimate 'ṣṭākapālaṃ nirvapet /
8.7.0.d: पूर्वेष्व् अग्निषूत्तरान् सहारणिकान् भवतं नः समनसौ \\ इत्य् अनुप्रहृत्याग्नये ऽग्निमते ऽष्टाकपालं निर्वपेत् /
8.7.0.m: Throwing the later [fires] along with the fire-drills into the earlier fires with 'Be of one mind with us…', he should apportion an eight-potsherd cake to Agni with fire.

8.8.0.s: agnihotrāṇy agnihotreṇaiva yajeta na somair na haviryajñaiḥ /
8.8.0.d: अग्निहोत्राण्य् अग्निहोत्रेणैव यजेत न सोमैर् न हविर्यज्ञैः /
8.8.0.m: He should perform the agnihotra offerings with the agnihotra alone, not with Soma sacrifices, nor with havis-sacrifices.

8.8.0.s: tasyāgrāyaṇaṃ / gārhapatya odanam̐ śrapayitvāgrāyaṇadevatābhyo hutvā prāśnīyād api vā naveṣu gām utsṛjya tasyāḥ payasāgnihotraṃ juhuyāt /
8.8.0.d: तस्याग्रायणं / गार्हपत्य ओदनम्̐ श्रपयित्वाग्रायणदेवताभ्यो हुत्वा प्राश्नीयाद् अपि वा नवेषु गाम् उत्सृज्य तस्याः पयसाग्निहोत्रं जुहुयात् /
8.8.0.m: His first-fruits offering [is as follows]: having cooked boiled rice on the gārhapatya fire and offered to the deities of the first-fruits offering, he should eat it; or, letting loose a cow among the new crops, he should offer the agnihotra with her milk.
That [cow] is the sacrificial gift, or a first-born calf.

8.9.0.m: In spring, he should apportion a boiled oblation to Soma made of bamboo grains.

8.9.0.s: grāmyā vā anyā oṣadhaya āraṇyā anyāḥ /
8.9.0.d: ग्राम्या वा अन्या ओषधय आरण्या अन्याः /
8.9.0.m: Some cultivated plants, indeed, are domesticated; others are wild.

8.9.0.s: yady oṣadhayo na pacyerann api vā naveṣu gām utsṛjya tasyāḥ payasāgnihotraṃ juhuyāt /
8.9.0.d: यद्य् ओषधयो न पच्येरन्न् अपि वा नवेषु गाम् उत्सृज्य तस्याः पयसाग्निहोत्रं जुहुयात् /
8.9.0.m: If the plants do not ripen, or letting loose a cow among the new [crops], he should offer the agnihotra with her milk.
That is the sacrificial gift, or a first-born calf.

8.10.0.s: payasā juhoti yavāgvā vājyena vā dadhnā vā tilair vā taṇḍulairv ā puṣpair vādbhir vā mām̐sena vā somena vā /
8.10.0.d: पयसा जुहोति यवाग्वा वाज्येन वा दध्ना वा तिलैर् वा तण्डुलैर्व् आ पुष्पैर् वाद्भिर् वा माम्̐सेन वा सोमेन वा /
8.10.0.m: He offers with milk, or with barley gruel, or with clarified butter, or with curds, or with sesame, or with rice grains, or with flowers, or with water, or with meat, or with soma.

8.10.0.s: dadhyājyatilataṇḍulapuṣpaphalasomānām adhiśrayaṇaṃ na syād abhighāraṇaṃ ca /
8.10.0.d: दध्याज्यतिलतण्डुलपुष्पफलसोमानाम् अधिश्रयणं न स्याद् अभिघारणं च /
8.10.0.m: For curds, clarified butter, sesame, rice grains, flowers, fruit, and soma, there should be no putting on the fire and no basting with clarified butter.

8.10.0.s: nāsomayājinaḥ somaṃ juhuyāt phalair araṇyavāsināṃ badarakuvalakarkandhuvarjam /
8.10.0.d: नासोमयाजिनः सोमं जुहुयात् फलैर् अरण्यवासिनां बदरकुवलकर्कन्धुवर्जम् /
8.10.0.m: One should not offer soma for someone who has not performed a soma sacrifice; [one should offer] with the fruits of forest-dwellers, except for jujube, wild jujube, and thorny jujube.

8.10.0.s: yadi sarvaṃ na vindec chundhanādi yathālābhaṃ kṛtvāhavanīye satye styaṃ juhomi svāhā \\ ity evaṃ brūyān na tv eva na yajeta /
8.10.0.d: यदि सर्वं न विन्देच् छुन्धनादि यथालाभं कृत्वाहवनीये सत्ये स्त्यं जुहोमि स्वाहा \\ इत्य् एवं ब्रूयान् न त्व् एव न यजेत /
8.10.0.m: If he cannot find everything, having performed purification and the rest according to what is available, he should say in the āhavanīya fire: 'In the truth I offer truth, svāhā'; but he should never fail to sacrifice.

8.11.0.m: Desiring heaven, he should sacrifice with the fifteen-day Dākṣāyaṇa sacrifice.

8.11.0.s: tatrobhāv ijyākālau dve paurṇamāsyau dve cāmāvāsye /
8.11.0.d: तत्रोभाव् इज्याकालौ द्वे पौर्णमास्यौ द्वे चामावास्ये /
8.11.0.m: There are two sacrifice times in it: two full-moon days and two new-moon days.

8.11.0.s: tatra yā pūrvā paurṇamāsī sānumatir yottarā sā rākā yā pūrvāmāvāsyā sā sinīvālī yottarā sā kuhūḥ /
8.11.0.d: तत्र या पूर्वा पौर्णमासी सानुमतिर् योत्तरा सा राका या पूर्वामावास्या सा सिनीवाली योत्तरा सा कुहूः /
8.11.0.m: There, the earlier full-moon day is Anumati, the later is Rākā; the earlier new-moon day is Sinīvālī, the later is Kuhū.

8.11.0.s: tāsv āgneyaḥ puroḍāśo 'gnīṣomīyo dvitīyaḥ pūrvāsyāṃ paurṇamāsyām aindrāgnī 'māvāsyāyām aindraṃ dadhy uttarasyāṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ maitrāvaruṇy āmikṣottarasyām amāvāsyāyām //
8.11.0.d: तास्व् आग्नेयः पुरोडाशो ऽग्नीषोमीयो द्वितीयः पूर्वास्यां पौर्णमास्याम् ऐन्द्राग्नी ऽमावास्यायाम् ऐन्द्रं दध्य् उत्तरस्यां पौर्णमास्यां मैत्रावरुण्य् आमिक्षोत्तरस्याम् अमावास्यायाम् //
8.11.0.m: On these, a sacrificial cake to Agni [is offered], and a second to Agni-Soma on the earlier full-moon day; an [offering] to Indra-Agni on the [earlier] new-moon day; curds to Indra on the later full-moon day; a curd offering to Mitra-Varuṇa on the later new-moon day.

8.11.0.s: indram̐ vo viśvatas pari \\ ā te śuṣmas \\ iti dadhnas \\ ā no mitrāvaruṇā \ pra bāhavā \\ ity āmikṣām̐ vaiśvadevaṃ ca vājinam /
8.11.0.d: इन्द्रम्̐ वो विश्वतस् परि \\ आ ते शुष्मस् \\ इति दध्नस् \\ आ नो मित्रावरुणा \ प्र बाहवा \\ इत्य् आमिक्षाम्̐ वैश्वदेवं च वाजिनम् /
8.11.0.m: 'Indra from all around you…', 'To thee vigor…' [are the verses] for the curds; 'Come to us, Mitra and Varuṇa…', 'Stretch forth both arms…' [for] the curd offering and the whey for the Viśvedevas.

8.12.0.m: Now we shall explain the rule for the sacrificial post hole.

8.12.0.s: sthūlaḥ kubjo bahulo vipulo vyāvṛttaḥ kuṭiskandhaḥ sṛkakubjo galulaḥ śuṣkāgro vallyāveṣṭitaḥ suṣiro lohito layajagdho ghuṇajagdho 'lpasāro 'mbusāra ity aniṣṭāḥ / dhanuḥprakāro 'nupūrvyā samo bahuśākho bahuparṇa iti praśastāḥ /
8.12.0.d: स्थूलः कुब्जो बहुलो विपुलो व्यावृत्तः कुटिस्कन्धः सृककुब्जो गलुलः शुष्काग्रो वल्ल्यावेष्टितः सुषिरो लोहितो लयजग्धो घुणजग्धो ऽल्पसारो ऽम्बुसार इत्य् अनिष्टाः / धनुःप्रकारो ऽनुपूर्व्या समो बहुशाखो बहुपर्ण इति प्रशस्ताः /
8.12.0.m: Thick, hunchbacked, swollen, broad, twisted, crooked-shouldered, hook-curved, bulbous, dry-topped, entwined with creepers, hollow, red, eaten by termites, eaten by wood-borers, poor in sap, having watery sap—these are undesired. Bow-shaped, regular, smooth, many-branched, many-leaved—these are praised.
We shall explain the consequences of these in regular order.
Death, affliction by heart disease, excessive rain; through milk yield his dwelling perishes.

8.12.0.s: prajā yuvamaraṇikā bhavanti / kuṣṭho gaṇḍamālā śrāmayāvyaḥ /
8.12.0.d: प्रजा युवमरणिका भवन्ति / कुष्ठो गण्डमाला श्रामयाव्यः /
8.12.0.m: His offspring die young. Leprosy, scrofula, consumption.

8.12.0.s: śrāddhakalpān iti pūrveṣūttareṣu pratiṣṭhākāmam̐ yogakṣemaṃ brahmavarcasam̐ svargagamanam ity uttareṣu sarveṣu vāpi svargagamanam /
8.12.0.d: श्राद्धकल्पान् इति पूर्वेषूत्तरेषु प्रतिष्ठाकामम्̐ योगक्षेमं ब्रह्मवर्चसम्̐ स्वर्गगमनम् इत्य् उत्तरेषु सर्वेषु वापि स्वर्गगमनम् /
8.12.0.m: [These are the consequences] in the former cases, [while] the rules of ancestral rites [apply]; in the subsequent cases, desire for stability, security, spiritual lustre, going to heaven; or in all the subsequent cases, going to heaven.

8.13.0.m: Now we shall speak of the cutting of the sacrificial post.

8.13.0.s: yady ūrdhvam utpatet patny anyasmin manaḥ kariṣyatīti vidyād yadi mūle suṣira udarābādho yadi tale śiraso yady anuveṣṭitaḥ pārśvāv abādho yady agniṣṭhā vichidyeta pramāyuko yajamānaḥ syād yadi pṛṣṭhyā patnī yadi dakṣiṇā jyeṣṭhaḥ putro yady uttarānujyeṣṭho yadi dakṣiṇapūrvā brahmā yadi dakṣiṇāparodgātā yady uttarāparā hotā yady uttarapūrvādhvaryuḥ /
8.13.0.d: यद्य् ऊर्ध्वम् उत्पतेत् पत्न्य् अन्यस्मिन् मनः करिष्यतीति विद्याद् यदि मूले सुषिर उदराबाधो यदि तले शिरसो यद्य् अनुवेष्टितः पार्श्वाव् अबाधो यद्य् अग्निष्ठा विछिद्येत प्रमायुको यजमानः स्याद् यदि पृष्ठ्या पत्नी यदि दक्षिणा ज्येष्ठः पुत्रो यद्य् उत्तरानुज्येष्ठो यदि दक्षिणपूर्वा ब्रह्मा यदि दक्षिणापरोद्गाता यद्य् उत्तरापरा होता यद्य् उत्तरपूर्वाध्वर्युः /
8.13.0.m: If it should spring upward, he should know that the wife will set her mind on another. If it is hollow at the base, [there will be] stomach affliction; if at the foot, of the head; if it is wrapped around, affliction in the sides; if the side facing the fire should snap, the sacrificer will be prone to death; if the back side, the wife; if the south side, the eldest son; if the north side, the next-youngest son; if the southeast, the brahman priest; if the southwest, the udgātṛ; if the northwest, the hotṛ priest; if the northeast, the adhvaryu priest.

8.13.0.s: yajamānam anāmnātam̐ vā juhuyāt trātāram iti kājavaṃ tvaṃ no agne \ sa tvaṃ no agne \\ ity anāmnātam /
8.13.0.d: यजमानम् अनाम्नातम्̐ वा जुहुयात् त्रातारम् इति काजवं त्वं नो अग्ने \ स त्वं नो अग्ने \\ इत्य् अनाम्नातम् /
8.13.0.m: He should offer for the sacrificer, or [offer] what is not prescribed: 'The protector…' is the Kājaveya mantra; 'Thou to us, Agni…', 'So thou to us, Agni…' is what is not prescribed.

8.13.0.s: yadi yūpāvaṭe khāyamāne 'sthibhasmatuṣakapālakeśā vā vidyerann idam aham̐ yajñasya duriṣṭaṃ niṣkṛntāmi \\ ity utkare nivaped anyatra vā /
8.13.0.d: यदि यूपावटे खायमाने ऽस्थिभस्मतुषकपालकेशा वा विद्येरन्न् इदम् अहम्̐ यज्ञस्य दुरिष्टं निष्कृन्तामि \\ इत्य् उत्करे निवपेद् अन्यत्र वा /
8.13.0.m: If, while digging the post hole, bone, ashes, chaff, potsherds, or hair should be found, he should throw them out on the rubbish heap or elsewhere, with: 'Here I cut off the ill-offered part of the sacrifice.'

8.13.0.s: nātisthūlaḥ kāryaḥ kṣudhaṃ prajānīyur no 'tyaṇur ubhayam evāntarā yajñena vai devā anukramiṣyāmaḥ /
8.13.0.d: नातिस्थूलः कार्यः क्षुधं प्रजानीयुर् नो ऽत्यणुर् उभयम् एवान्तरा यज्ञेन वै देवा अनुक्रमिष्यामः /
8.13.0.m: It should not be made too thick, lest they know hunger, nor too thin; between the two [extremes] indeed. By means of the sacrifice we shall follow the gods.

8.13.0.s: yajamānasyāṅguliparigraho raśanābandhane / śulbena tiryaṅ nimāya na śulbena tiryaṅ nimāya na śulbam aṅguliparvabhir mimīte /
8.13.0.d: यजमानस्याङ्गुलिपरिग्रहो रशनाबन्धने / शुल्बेन तिर्यङ् निमाय न शुल्बेन तिर्यङ् निमाय न शुल्बम् अङ्गुलिपर्वभिर् मिमीते /
8.13.0.m: The span of the sacrificer's fingers is used for binding the cord. Having measured across with the cord—he does not measure across with the cord, [rather] he measures the cord with finger joints.

8.13.0.s: antābhyām aṅguliparvaṇi daśabhāgam adhastād raśanāratnyantare lakṣaṇasyāpacaya evam evopariṣṭād raśanāratnyantare lakṣaṇasyāpacayaḥ /
8.13.0.d: अन्ताभ्याम् अङ्गुलिपर्वणि दशभागम् अधस्ताद् रशनारत्न्यन्तरे लक्षणस्यापचय एवम् एवोपरिष्टाद् रशनारत्न्यन्तरे लक्षणस्यापचयः /
8.13.0.m: From both ends at the finger joint, a tenth part below: there is diminution of the mark in the space of a cubit of the cord; likewise above: diminution of the mark in the space of a cubit of the cord.
He makes a mound measured by the leprosy [rule?].
The act of the pit has been explained.

8.13.0.s: yady avadāya punar uddhriyeta pramāyuko yajamānaḥ syāt /
8.13.0.d: यद्य् अवदाय पुनर् उद्ध्रियेत प्रमायुको यजमानः स्यात् /
8.13.0.m: If having cut it out it should be lifted up again, the sacrificer will be prone to death.

8.13.0.s: punar anyathāvasyan idaṃ japen mā yajñam̐ him̐siṣṭam iti /
8.13.0.d: पुनर् अन्यथावस्यन् इदं जपेन् मा यज्ञम्̐ हिम्̐सिष्टम् इति /
8.13.0.m: When setting it down differently again, he should murmur: 'Do not harm the sacrifice.'

8.13.0.s: pañcabhāgoparā yūpā bhavanty uttarā ṣaḍ vā vibhajyanta ā dvādaśaratnes triratnir ity uttareṣām /
8.13.0.d: पञ्चभागोपरा यूपा भवन्त्य् उत्तरा षड् वा विभज्यन्त आ द्वादशरत्नेस् त्रिरत्निर् इत्य् उत्तरेषाम् /
8.13.0.m: The sacrificial posts have five-part underground portions, or six upper portions are divided; up to twelve cubits, three cubits is [the division] of the upper ones.

8.14.0.s: alekho hotṛścamasa utsṛṣṭo brahmaṇaḥ smṛto 'vamṛṣṭa udgātṝṇāṃ pārśvāvamṛṣṭo yajamānasyaikalekho maitrāvaruṇasya dvilekho brāhmaṇācham̐sinas trilekhaḥ potur mayūkho neṣṭur ajapādo 'chāvākasyābhrir āgnīdhrasya /
8.14.0.d: अलेखो होतृश्चमस उत्सृष्टो ब्रह्मणः स्मृतो ऽवमृष्ट उद्गातॄणां पार्श्वावमृष्टो यजमानस्यैकलेखो मैत्रावरुणस्य द्विलेखो ब्राह्मणाछम्̐सिनस् त्रिलेखः पोतुर् मयूखो नेष्टुर् अजपादो ऽछावाकस्याभ्रिर् आग्नीध्रस्य /
8.14.0.m: Unmarked is the cup of the hotṛ; left aside, of the brahman priest; traditionally touched, of the udgātṛs; touched at the side, of the sacrificer; with one mark, of the maitrāvaruṇa; with two marks, of the brāhmaṇācchaṃsin; with three marks, of the potṛ; a peg, of the neṣṭṛ; a goat's foot, of the acchāvāka; a spade, of the āgnīdhra.

8.15.0.s: atha sāvanasya paśor uddhṛtavapāvadānasya vibhāgam̐ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ /
8.15.0.d: अथ सावनस्य पशोर् उद्धृतवपावदानस्य विभागम्̐ व्याख्यास्यामः /
8.15.0.m: Now we shall explain the distribution of the animal of the pressing after the portions of omentum have been extracted.

8.15.0.s: hanū sajihve prastotuḥ kaṇṭhaḥ kākud āgnīdhrasya śyenam̐ vakṣa udgātur dakṣiṇaṃ pārśvam adhvaryoḥ savyaṃ pratiprasthātur dakṣiṇa ūrur brahmaṇaḥ savyaḥ sadasyānām ubhau matasnau neṣṭur achāvākasya cauṣṭha enayoḥ sādhāraṇaḥ pādau gṛhapater avākskandhāś ca maṇikās tisraś ca kīkasā [ ardham̐ vaikartaṃ ca ] hotus tisraś ca kīkasā ardham̐ vaikartaṃ connetu[s tisraś ca kīkasā ] ardham̐ vaikartaṃ ca śamituḥ /
8.15.0.d: हनू सजिह्वे प्रस्तोतुः कण्ठः काकुद् आग्नीध्रस्य श्येनम्̐ वक्ष उद्गातुर् दक्षिणं पार्श्वम् अध्वर्योः सव्यं प्रतिप्रस्थातुर् दक्षिण ऊरुर् ब्रह्मणः सव्यः सदस्यानाम् उभौ मतस्नौ नेष्टुर् अछावाकस्य चौष्ठ एनयोः साधारणः पादौ गृहपतेर् अवाक्स्कन्धाश् च मणिकास् तिस्रश् च कीकसा [ अर्धम्̐ वैकर्तं च ] होतुस् तिस्रश् च कीकसा अर्धम्̐ वैकर्तं चोन्नेतु[स् तिस्रश् च कीकसा ] अर्धम्̐ वैकर्तं च शमितुः /
8.15.0.m: The jaws together with the tongue belong to the prastotṛ; the throat and palate to the āgnīdhra; the hawk-like breast to the udgātṛ; the right flank to the adhvaryu; the left to the pratiprasthātṛ; the right thigh to the brahman; the left to the sadasyas; both kidneys to the neṣṭṛ and the acchāvāka, and the lip is common to both of them; the feet to the householder; the downward-turning shoulders and the ankles and three ribs [and half the vaakarta] to the hotṛ; three ribs and half the vaakarta to the unnetṛ; [three ribs] and half the vaakarta to the slaughterer.

8.15.0.s: tac chamitā brāhmaṇāya dadyād yo 'brāhmaṇaḥ syāt /
8.15.0.d: तच् छमिता ब्राह्मणाय दद्याद् यो ऽब्राह्मणः स्यात् /
8.15.0.m: The slaughterer should give that to a brahmin, if he should be a non-brahmin.

8.15.0.s: jāghanī patnyās tām̐ sā brāhmaṇāya dadyāt /
8.15.0.d: जाघनी पत्न्यास् ताम्̐ सा ब्राह्मणाय दद्यात् /
8.15.0.m: The hindquarters belong to the wife; she should give them to a brahmin.
The head belongs to the subrahmaṇya. When he declares the next day's pressing, the skin [belongs] to him.

8.15.0.s: tā evaitāḥ ṣaṭtrim̐śatam ekapadā yajñam̐ vahanti ṣaṭtrim̐śadakṣarā bṛhatī bārhatāḥ paśavo bārhataḥ puruṣo ya evam̐ vidvān vibhajet /
8.15.0.d: ता एवैताः षट्त्रिम्̐शतम् एकपदा यज्ञम्̐ वहन्ति षट्त्रिम्̐शदक्षरा बृहती बार्हताः पशवो बार्हतः पुरुषो य एवम्̐ विद्वान् विभजेत् /
8.15.0.m: These thirty-six single-word portions carry the sacrifice; the Bṛhatī has thirty-six syllables, animals belong to the Bṛhatī, man belongs to the Bṛhatī—whoever, knowing thus, divides [it].
[…] just as goblins or butchers […], such [it is].

8.15.0.s: ...dyavadāya vāyavyāyāmānuṣaḥ purovāca / tata idaṃ manuṣyā viduḥ /
8.15.0.d: ...द्यवदाय वायव्यायामानुषः पुरोवाच / तत इदं मनुष्या विदुः /
8.15.0.m: […] having apportioned for the Vāyavya cup, the human said formerly; hence humans know this.

8.16.0.m: The formula of six Hotṛs, the Grahas, the animal victim, the introductory offering, the giving of the sacrificial gift—these should cease when they are subordinate limbs.

8.16.0.s: pṛṣṭhyābarhiḥ saṃnahyātithyabarhiḥ śulbaprabhṛtimantravat saṃnahyatīdhmaṃ ca tatparidhim /
8.16.0.d: पृष्ठ्याबर्हिः संनह्यातिथ्यबर्हिः शुल्बप्रभृतिमन्त्रवत् संनह्यतीध्मं च तत्परिधिम् /
8.16.0.m: Having tied the sacrificial grass for the spinal line, he ties the sacrificial grass for the guest-offering with the mantras beginning with the cord, and the sacrificial fuel with its enclosing sticks.
If there is a curd offering as the concluding animal victim, the offering of the chip takes place at the pressing.
Rising from the purificatory bath, the pointing out of the sacrificial posts [takes place].

8.16.0.s: yaḥ kāmayeta sarvo me yajñaḥ syāt sarasā iti sa etās tisro vaśā ālabheta yajñasya sarvatvāyātho sarasatvāya maitrāvaruṇyai ca /
8.16.0.d: यः कामयेत सर्वो मे यज्ञः स्यात् सरसा इति स एतास् तिस्रो वशा आलभेत यज्ञस्य सर्वत्वायाथो सरसत्वाय मैत्रावरुण्यै च /
8.16.0.m: He who desires, 'May my sacrifice be whole, full of sap', should seize these three barren cows for the wholeness of the sacrifice, and also for its sap-richness, and for the curd offering to Mitra-Varuṇa.

8.16.0.s: uttarato gārhapatyasya pātrebhyaḥ sam̐stīrya pātrāṇi prayunakti /
8.16.0.d: उत्तरतो गार्हपत्यस्य पात्रेभ्यः सम्̐स्तीर्य पात्राणि प्रयुनक्ति /
8.16.0.m: To the north of the gārhapatya fire, having spread out [grass] for the utensils, he arranges the utensils.

8.16.0.s: sruksruvam ājyasthālīṃ dohapātrāṇi camasān sam̐sādya prokṣya pātrāṇi dohaṃ dohayitvājyaṃ nirupya paryagniṃ kṛtvā sruksruvaṃ pramṛjyotpūya payasyām abhighāryodvāsyālaṃkṛtya paścād uttaravedyāḥ sādayati /
8.16.0.d: स्रुक्स्रुवम् आज्यस्थालीं दोहपात्राणि चमसान् सम्̐साद्य प्रोक्ष्य पात्राणि दोहं दोहयित्वाज्यं निरुप्य पर्यग्निं कृत्वा स्रुक्स्रुवं प्रमृज्योत्पूय पयस्याम् अभिघार्योद्वास्यालंकृत्य पश्चाद् उत्तरवेद्याः सादयति /
8.16.0.m: Having arranged the offering ladle and the dipping spoon, the butter-pot, the milking vessels, and the cups; having sprinkled the vessels; having caused the milk to be milked; having apportioned the clarified butter; having carried fire around; having wiped and purified the offering ladle and the dipping spoon; having basted the curd offering with clarified butter; having taken it off the fire and decorated it, he sets it down behind the high altar.

8.16.0.s: ājyabhāgābhyāṃ pracarya payasyayānubandhyādevatā yajaty ājyena devikāḥ /
8.16.0.d: आज्यभागाभ्यां प्रचर्य पयस्ययानुबन्ध्यादेवता यजत्य् आज्येन देविकाः /
8.16.0.m: Having performed the two clarified butter portions, he sacrifices to the deities of the anubandhyā with the curd offering, and to the Devikās with clarified butter.

8.17.0.m: Now the Kāmalāyins teach the procedure of double sacrifice.

8.17.0.s: vasante vaiśvadeveneṣṭvā grīṣme punar vaiśvadevena yajeta /
8.17.0.d: वसन्ते वैश्वदेवेनेष्ट्वा ग्रीष्मे पुनर् वैश्वदेवेन यजेत /
8.17.0.m: Having sacrificed with the Vaiśvadeva in spring, he should sacrifice again with the Vaiśvadeva in summer.

8.17.0.s: varṣāsu varuṇapraghāsair iṣṭvā śaradi punar varuṇapraghāsair yajeta /
8.17.0.d: वर्षासु वरुणप्रघासैर् इष्ट्वा शरदि पुनर् वरुणप्रघासैर् यजेत /
8.17.0.m: Having sacrificed with the Varuṇapraghāsas in the rainy season, he should sacrifice again with the Varuṇapraghāsas in autumn.

8.17.0.s: hemante sākamedhair iṣṭvā śiśire punaḥ sākamedhair yajeta /
8.17.0.d: हेमन्ते साकमेधैर् इष्ट्वा शिशिरे पुनः साकमेधैर् यजेत /
8.17.0.m: Having sacrificed with the Sākamedhas in the cold season, he should sacrifice again with the Sākamedhas in winter.
On the next day the Śunāsīrīya [offering is performed], or on the same day.

8.17.0.s: atha pariplavair yajeta / tasya haviṣām ekaikenāharaho yajeta /
8.17.0.d: अथ परिप्लवैर् यजेत / तस्य हविषाम् एकैकेनाहरहो यजेत /
8.17.0.m: Now he may sacrifice with the Pariplavas; he should sacrifice day by day with one each of its oblations.

8.17.0.s: prakārāntare prātarāhutim̐ hutvā pūrvāhṇe vaiśvadevena yajeta madhyāhne varuṇapraghāsair aparāhṇe sākamedhaiḥ / śvobhūte śunāsīryam̐ sadyo vā /
8.17.0.d: प्रकारान्तरे प्रातराहुतिम्̐ हुत्वा पूर्वाह्णे वैश्वदेवेन यजेत मध्याह्ने वरुणप्रघासैर् अपराह्णे साकमेधैः / श्वोभूते शुनासीर्यम्̐ सद्यो वा /
8.17.0.m: According to another method: having made the morning offering, he should sacrifice in the forenoon with the Vaiśvadeva, at midday with the Varuṇapraghāsas, [and] in the afternoon with the Sākamedhas. On the next day the Śunāsīrīya [is performed], or on the same day.

8.17.0.s: śvobhūte vaiśvadevam̐ śvobhūte varuṇapraghāsā dvyaham̐ sākamedhāḥ śvobhūte śunāsīryam̐ sadyo vāñjasā vā /
8.17.0.d: श्वोभूते वैश्वदेवम्̐ श्वोभूते वरुणप्रघासा द्व्यहम्̐ साकमेधाः श्वोभूते शुनासीर्यम्̐ सद्यो वाञ्जसा वा /
8.17.0.m: On the next day the Vaiśvadeva; on the next day the Varuṇapraghāsas; the Sākamedhas for two days; on the next day the Śunāsīrīya, or on the same day, or immediately.

8.17.0.s: eṣa yathā svargalokam eti yaḥ samastaiś cāturmāsyair yajeta /
8.17.0.d: एष यथा स्वर्गलोकम् एति यः समस्तैश् चातुर्मास्यैर् यजेत /
