8.17.0.m: Thus goes he to the heavenly world who sacrifices with the Cāturmāsyas combined.

8.17.0.s: sa etair iṣṭyantaiḥ paśvantaiḥ somāntair vā yajeta /
8.17.0.d: स एतैर् इष्ट्यन्तैः पश्वन्तैः सोमान्तैर् वा यजेत /
8.17.0.m: He may sacrifice with these [rites] concluding with an iṣṭi, concluding with an animal sacrifice, or concluding with a Soma sacrifice.

8.17.0.s: api vā varuṇapraghāsānte vaiśvānarapārjanyādīnāṃ ca vim̐śatihaviṣām iṣṭiṃ nirvapati /
8.17.0.d: अपि वा वरुणप्रघासान्ते वैश्वानरपार्जन्यादीनां च विम्̐शतिहविषाम् इष्टिं निर्वपति /
8.17.0.m: Or else, at the conclusion of the Varuṇapraghāsas, he apportions an iṣṭi of twenty oblations beginning with those to Vaiśvānara and Parjanya.
Except for the Tryambaka [offerings] and the repetitions, the final purification bath is the same.

8.17.0.s: pitṛyajñaś ca sākamedhikas tantrāvayavaḥ / sadyaḥ samāpnuyāt /
8.17.0.d: पितृयज्ञश् च साकमेधिकस् तन्त्रावयवः / सद्यः समाप्नुयात् /
8.17.0.m: And the Pitṛyajña connected with the Sākamedhas is a part of the ritual framework; he should conclude it on the same day.

8.18.0.d: व्याख्यातो ऽश्वमेधः पुरुषमेधश् च / सर्वमेधम्̐ व्याख्यास्यामः /
8.18.0.m: The Aśvamedha and the Puruṣamedha have been explained; we shall explain the Sarvamedha.

8.18.0.s: tasyāhargaṇas trīṇy āśvamedhikāni pañca pauruṣamedhikāni vājapeyo 'ptoryāmaḥ /
8.18.0.d: तस्याहर्गणस् त्रीण्य् आश्वमेधिकानि पञ्च पौरुषमेधिकानि वाजपेयो ऽप्तोर्यामः /
8.18.0.m: Its series of days [consists of]: three [days] pertaining to the Aśvamedha, five pertaining to the Puruṣamedha, a Vājapeya, [and] an Aptoryāma.

8.18.0.s: yad ahar aptoryāmas tad ahaḥ sarvāṇi /
8.18.0.d: यद् अहर् अप्तोर्यामस् तद् अहः सर्वाणि /
8.18.0.m: On the day that is the Aptoryāma, all [takes place] on that day.

8.18.0.s: sarvāṇām̐ vanaspatīnāṃ purastāt sviṣṭakṛto rasaṃ juhoty eṣa eva nirargalaḥ /
8.18.0.d: सर्वाणाम्̐ वनस्पतीनां पुरस्तात् स्विष्टकृतो रसं जुहोत्य् एष एव निरर्गलः /
8.18.0.m: Before the Sviṣṭakṛt offering, he offers the sap of all trees; this is indeed the Nirargala.
At the time of the sacrificial gift, he should give away his entire property.
Having taken leave of his kinsmen, he should mount the fires onto himself.

8.18.0.s: vijñāyate haitad vā agnidhānam̐ hastasya yat pāṇis tasmāt pāṇau samāropayet /
8.18.0.d: विज्ञायते हैतद् वा अग्निधानम्̐ हस्तस्य यत् पाणिस् तस्मात् पाणौ समारोपयेत् /
8.18.0.m: It is indeed known [from the scriptures]: 'This palm of the hand is indeed the setting-place of the fire'; therefore he should mount them onto his palm.

8.18.0.s: vijñāyate ha yasya vā amuṣya diśi yady agnayas tām abhimukho japet /
8.18.0.d: विज्ञायते ह यस्य वा अमुष्य दिशि यद्य् अग्नयस् ताम् अभिमुखो जपेत् /
8.18.0.m: It is indeed known: 'In whichever direction that person's fires are, facing that [direction] he should mutter [the mantra].'

8.18.0.s: vijñāyate yatra vā etat kvaca yajamānam̐ santam̐ yajñasyāśīr gached iti śrutiḥ /
8.18.0.d: विज्ञायते यत्र वा एतत् क्वच यजमानम्̐ सन्तम्̐ यज्ञस्याशीर् गछेद् इति श्रुतिः /
8.18.0.m: 'Wherever the sacrificer may be, the blessing of the sacrifice reaches him,' so says the śruti.

8.18.0.s: tatra yāni sām̐sparśikāni na tāni kriyeran dharmapātrāṇi /
8.18.0.d: तत्र यानि साम्̐स्पर्शिकानि न तानि क्रियेरन् धर्मपात्राणि /
8.18.0.m: There, whatever vessels are touched [in common] should not be made [into] sacred vessels.

8.18.0.d: देवता द्रव्यम् इति सामान्यसंनिपाते ऽक्षरसामान्याद् विशेषः /
8.18.0.m: When deity and substance coincide in common, a distinction [is made] through similarity of syllables.

8.19.0.s: athāhitāgneḥ pramītasya vidhim̐ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ /
8.19.0.d: अथाहिताग्नेः प्रमीतस्य विधिम्̐ व्याख्यास्यामः /
8.19.0.m: Now we shall explain the rule for an āhitāgni who has died.

8.19.0.s: abhivānyānyasyā gor vatsena yā gaur duhyate sābhivānyā gauḥ /
8.19.0.d: अभिवान्यान्यस्या गोर् वत्सेन या गौर् दुह्यते साभिवान्या गौः /
8.19.0.m: An abhivānyā is a cow that is milked with the calf of another cow; that is an abhivānyā cow.

8.19.0.s: dugdham adhastāt srugdaṇḍe samidhaṃ dhārayamāṇo hṛtvā juhoti /
8.19.0.d: दुग्धम् अधस्तात् स्रुग्दण्डे समिधं धारयमाणो हृत्वा जुहोति /
8.19.0.m: Holding a piece of kindling stick on the handle of the ladle below the milk, he carries it and offers it.

8.19.0.s: yadi naktaṃ pramīyeta prātarāhutiṃ prapādyāparapakṣe pramīyetāgnihotradarśābhyāṃ pūrvapakṣam̐ saṃpādayet /
8.19.0.d: यदि नक्तं प्रमीयेत प्रातराहुतिं प्रपाद्यापरपक्षे प्रमीयेताग्निहोत्रदर्शाभ्यां पूर्वपक्षम्̐ संपादयेत् /
8.19.0.m: If he should die at night, having performed the morning offering; if he should die in the dark fortnight, he should complete the bright fortnight with the Agnihotra and the New-Moon sacrifice.

8.19.0.s: yadi dakṣiṇāyane pramīyetāgnihotreṇa darśapūrṇamāsābhyām iṣṭvā śarīradāhād ahatena vāsasā paḍatodaśena prachādya prehi prehi \\ iti dakṣiṇapūrvasyāṃ diśi nāyayet /
8.19.0.d: यदि दक्षिणायने प्रमीयेताग्निहोत्रेण दर्शपूर्णमासाभ्याम् इष्ट्वा शरीरदाहाद् अहतेन वाससा पडतोदशेन प्रछाद्य प्रेहि प्रेहि \\ इति दक्षिणपूर्वस्यां दिशि नाययेत् /
8.19.0.m: If he should die during the southern course of the sun, having sacrificed with the Agnihotra and the New- and Full-Moon sacrifices, before the cremation of the body, having covered it with an unwashed cloth having tassels at the feet, he should have it carried toward the south-east direction with [the mantra]: 'Go forth, go forth...'

8.19.0.s: cakrīvatā vāhayec chiram agrato nayati /
8.19.0.d: चक्रीवता वाहयेच् छिरम् अग्रतो नयति /
8.19.0.m: He should have it conveyed by a wheeled cart; he leads the head forward.

8.19.0.s: tasya vartmānunayanty agrato vihārān nāyayed yajñapātrāṇi paścād jñātayo 'nveyuḥ /
8.19.0.d: तस्य वर्त्मानुनयन्त्य् अग्रतो विहारान् नाययेद् यज्ञपात्राणि पश्चाद् ज्ञातयो ऽन्वेयुः /
8.19.0.m: They follow his track; he should carry the sacrificial vessels ahead out of the sacrificial enclosure; the relatives should follow behind.

8.19.0.s: paścāc catvāra ṛtvija uṣṇīṣiṇo 'hatāni vāsām̐sy apasavyam āvṛtya dakṣiṇapūrvasyāṃ diśy agniṃ praṇīyeṣṭiṃ kurvanti /
8.19.0.d: पश्चाच् चत्वार ऋत्विज उष्णीषिणो ऽहतानि वासाम्̐स्य् अपसव्यम् आवृत्य दक्षिणपूर्वस्यां दिश्य् अग्निं प्रणीयेष्टिं कुर्वन्ति /
8.19.0.m: Behind, four officiating priests, wearing turbans and unwashed garments, having turned [their sacred threads] over the right shoulder, having brought forward the fire in the south-east direction, perform an iṣṭi.

8.19.0.s: somāya pitṛmate ṣaṭkapālaḥ puroḍāśa uttānāni kapālāni / tūṣṇīṃ tam anavekṣamāṇāḥ pracareyur yathā pitryāyām /
8.19.0.d: सोमाय पितृमते षट्कपालः पुरोडाश उत्तानानि कपालानि / तूष्णीं तम् अनवेक्षमाणाः प्रचरेयुर् यथा पित्र्यायाम् /
8.19.0.m: A six-potsherd sacrificial cake is for Soma accompanied by the fathers; the potsherds are [placed] turned upward. Silently, not looking at him, they should proceed as in the rite for the fathers.

8.19.0.s: lupyeta yājamānam̐ sapatnīkam āvir bhūyāsam uttaram iti ceḍāntā saṃtiṣṭhate /
8.19.0.d: लुप्येत याजमानम्̐ सपत्नीकम् आविर् भूयासम् उत्तरम् इति चेडान्ता संतिष्ठते /
8.19.0.m: The sacrificer's portion along with the wife's is omitted; with 'May I become manifest above,' it concludes with the iḍā portion.

8.19.0.s: agreṇa gārhapatyam apareṇāhavanīyam̐ yajamānamātrīṃ karṣū khātvā tasyāṃ citiṃ cinvīta /
8.19.0.d: अग्रेण गार्हपत्यम् अपरेणाहवनीयम्̐ यजमानमात्रीं कर्षू खात्वा तस्यां चितिं चिन्वीत /
8.19.0.m: In front of the gārhapatya [and] to the west of the āhavanīya, having dug a furrow of the measure of the sacrificer, he should pile up a pyre in it.

8.19.0.s: kṛṣṇājinam āstīrya tilair avakīryātīrthena śarīraṃ prapādya cityām āropya tilair avakīrya \\ asau svargāya lokāya svāhā \\ iti manasā pūrṇāhutiṃ juhuyāt /
8.19.0.d: कृष्णाजिनम् आस्तीर्य तिलैर् अवकीर्यातीर्थेन शरीरं प्रपाद्य चित्याम् आरोप्य तिलैर् अवकीर्य \\ असौ स्वर्गाय लोकाय स्वाहा \\ इति मनसा पूर्णाहुतिं जुहुयात् /
8.19.0.m: Having spread out a black antelope skin, having scattered sesame seeds, having brought the body in by a non-standard passage, having placed it on the pyre, [and] having scattered sesame seeds, he should mentally offer a full offering with: 'To so-and-so for the heavenly world, svāhā.'

8.19.0.s: chidreṣu hiraṇyaśakalān apyasyati \\ ṛce tvā \\ iti dakṣiṇasmin karṇachidre ruce tvā \\ iti savye bhāse tvā \\ iti dakṣiṇasminn akṣichidre jyotiṣe tvā \\ iti savye \\ abhūd idam iti dakṣiṇasmin nāsikāchidre \\ agner vaiśvānarasya \\ iti savye \\ agnis tejasā \\ ity āsye //
8.19.0.d: छिद्रेषु हिरण्यशकलान् अप्यस्यति \\ ऋचे त्वा \\ इति दक्षिणस्मिन् कर्णछिद्रे रुचे त्वा \\ इति सव्ये भासे त्वा \\ इति दक्षिणस्मिन्न् अक्षिछिद्रे ज्योतिषे त्वा \\ इति सव्ये \\ अभूद् इदम् इति दक्षिणस्मिन् नासिकाछिद्रे \\ अग्नेर् वैश्वानरस्य \\ इति सव्ये \\ अग्निस् तेजसा \\ इत्य् आस्ये //
8.19.0.m: He throws gold pieces into the apertures: 'For the ṛc, to you,' into the right ear-hole; 'For splendour, to you,' into the left; 'For radiance, to you,' into the right eye-hole; 'For light, to you,' into the left; 'This has come into being,' into the right nostril; 'Of Agni Vaiśvānara,' into the left; 'Agni with brilliance,' into the mouth.

8.19.0.s: hiraṇyagarbhas \\ ity āsye juhuyād vyāhṛtibhiś ca /
8.19.0.d: हिरण्यगर्भस् \\ इत्य् आस्ये जुहुयाद् व्याहृतिभिश् च /
8.19.0.m: He should offer [ghee] into the mouth with [the verse]: 'The golden embryo...' and with the sacred utterances.

8.19.0.s: āsecanavanti pātrāṇi payasaḥ pūrayitvā dakṣiṇasminn am̐se juhūm̐ sahaprastarām̐ sādayati savya upabhṛtam urasi dhruvāṃ mukhe 'gnihotrahavanīṃ nāsikayoḥ sruvau lalāṭe prāśitraharaṇam̐ śirasi kapālāny ājyadhānīm̐ vedaṃ cāsye sahiraṇyaśakalaṃ puroḍāśaṃ kukṣyoḥ sāṃnāyyadhānyāv upasthe 'raṇī vakṣasi śamyāṃ pārśvayoḥ sphyopaveṣāv udara iḍāpātrīm ūrvor ulūkhalaṃ musalaṃ pādayoḥ śakaṭam antarorū itarāṇi yajñāṅgāni /
8.19.0.d: आसेचनवन्ति पात्राणि पयसः पूरयित्वा दक्षिणस्मिन्न् अम्̐से जुहूम्̐ सहप्रस्तराम्̐ सादयति सव्य उपभृतम् उरसि ध्रुवां मुखे ऽग्निहोत्रहवनीं नासिकयोः स्रुवौ ललाटे प्राशित्रहरणम्̐ शिरसि कपालान्य् आज्यधानीम्̐ वेदं चास्ये सहिरण्यशकलं पुरोडाशं कुक्ष्योः सांनाय्यधान्याव् उपस्थे ऽरणी वक्षसि शम्यां पार्श्वयोः स्फ्योपवेषाव् उदर इडापात्रीम् ऊर्वोर् उलूखलं मुसलं पादयोः शकटम् अन्तरोरू इतराणि यज्ञाङ्गानि /
8.19.0.m: Having filled the pouring vessels with milk, he places the juhū spoon together with the sacred grass bundle on the right shoulder, the upabhṛt spoon on the left, the dhruvā ladle on the chest, the agnihotrahavanī ladle on the mouth, the two sruva ladles at the nostrils, the prāśitra vessel on the forehead, the potsherds, the clarified butter pot, and the grass broom on the head, the sacrificial cake containing a gold piece in the mouth, the two sāṃnāyya vessels on the sides of the belly, the two kindling sticks on the lap, the yoke-pin on the chest, the wooden sword and the poker on the sides, the iḍā vessel on the belly, the mortar and pestle on the thighs, the cart at the feet, [and] the other limbs of the sacrifice between the thighs.

8.19.0.s: agnicitiś ced ekavim̐śatim iṣṭakāḥ kṛṣṇāḥ samantād upadadhyād atha vā lohitāḥ /
8.19.0.d: अग्निचितिश् चेद् एकविम्̐शतिम् इष्टकाः कृष्णाः समन्ताद् उपदध्याद् अथ वा लोहिताः /
8.19.0.m: If he was a builder of the fire altar, he should place twenty-one black bricks all around, or else red ones.

8.19.0.s: ajāṃ gām̐ vaikavarṇāṃ dakṣiṇāparasyāṃ diśi śavanirharaṇasya prathinā ghātayet /
8.19.0.d: अजां गाम्̐ वैकवर्णां दक्षिणापरस्यां दिशि शवनिर्हरणस्य प्रथिना घातयेत् /
8.19.0.m: Along the path of carrying out the corpse, in the south-western direction, he should cause a goat or a cow of a single colour to be killed.

8.19.0.s: tasyā vapām utkhidya mukhaṃ prachādya tilair avakīryāṅgeṣv aṅgāny abhividadhāti dakṣiṇeṣu dakṣiṇāni savyeṣu savyāni śirasi śiraś carmaṇā prachādya /
8.19.0.d: तस्या वपाम् उत्खिद्य मुखं प्रछाद्य तिलैर् अवकीर्याङ्गेष्व् अङ्गान्य् अभिविदधाति दक्षिणेषु दक्षिणानि सव्येषु सव्यानि शिरसि शिरश् चर्मणा प्रछाद्य /
8.19.0.m: Having extracted its omentum, covered the face [with it], and scattered sesame seeds, he arranges the limbs onto the limbs—the right [animal limbs] on the right, the left on the left, [and] the head on the head, having covered [the body] with the hide.

8.19.0.s: yadi tāṃ na ghātayed gārhapatye payaḥ śrapayitvā tasya santānam uddhṛtya mukhaṃ prachādya tilair avakīryolaparājībhis tisṛbhir ādīpayet /
8.19.0.d: यदि तां न घातयेद् गार्हपत्ये पयः श्रपयित्वा तस्य सन्तानम् उद्धृत्य मुखं प्रछाद्य तिलैर् अवकीर्योलपराजीभिस् तिसृभिर् आदीपयेत् /
8.19.0.m: If he does not kill it, having boiled milk on the gārhapatya fire, having removed its cream, covered the face [with it], and scattered sesame seeds, he should set [the pyre] alight with three streaks of dried grass.

8.19.0.s: yadi gārhapatyāt prathamaḥ śarīraṃ prāpnuyād devalokaṃ gamiṣyatīti vidyād yadi dakṣiṇāgneḥ pitṛlokam̐ yady āhavanīyād brahmalokam̐ yadi yugapat sarvām̐l lokān gamiṣyatīti vidyāt /
8.19.0.d: यदि गार्हपत्यात् प्रथमः शरीरं प्राप्नुयाद् देवलोकं गमिष्यतीति विद्याद् यदि दक्षिणाग्नेः पितृलोकम्̐ यद्य् आहवनीयाद् ब्रह्मलोकम्̐ यदि युगपत् सर्वाम्̐ल् लोकान् गमिष्यतीति विद्यात् /
8.19.0.m: If [the fire] from the gārhapatya fire reaches the body first, he should know: 'He will go to the world of the gods'; if from the southern fire: 'To the world of the fathers'; if from the āhavanīya fire: 'To the world of Brahman'; if simultaneously: he should know: 'He will go to all worlds.'

8.19.0.s: hiraṇyena śakalena parilikhet tām̐ hiraṇyalekhāṃ manasādhvaryus triḥ pariṣiñced yathā pitryāyām //
8.19.0.d: हिरण्येन शकलेन परिलिखेत् ताम्̐ हिरण्यलेखां मनसाध्वर्युस् त्रिः परिषिञ्चेद् यथा पित्र्यायाम् //
8.19.0.m: With a gold piece he should draw a line around [it]; the adhvaryu should mentally sprinkle water three times around that golden line, as in the rite for the fathers.

8.19.0.s: tūṣṇīṃ pratiparītya pādato 'vasthāya namo mahimne \\ iti pañcabhir upatiṣṭhate /
8.19.0.d: तूष्णीं प्रतिपरीत्य पादतो ऽवस्थाय नमो महिम्ने \\ इति पञ्चभिर् उपतिष्ठते /
8.19.0.m: Having walked round silently and standing at the feet, he attends [the fire] with the five [mantras beginning with], 'Homage to greatness'.

8.20.0.m: Now we shall explain the rule for one who has died without having set up the sacred fires.
The burning is with the domestic fire or with fire produced by friction.

8.20.0.s: bālaś cet pramīyeta pṛthivī śarīram asi \\ iti manasā bhūmyām̐ śarīraṃ nikhaned araṇī ca / prāk cūḍākaraṇāt snātvā sadyaḥ śaucam̐ yajñādhyayanāni ca /
8.20.0.d: बालश् चेत् प्रमीयेत पृथिवी शरीरम् असि \\ इति मनसा भूम्याम्̐ शरीरं निखनेद् अरणी च / प्राक् चूडाकरणात् स्नात्वा सद्यः शौचम्̐ यज्ञाध्ययनानि च /
8.20.0.m: If a child dies, one should bury the body in the ground silently with the thought, 'You are the earth, the body', and the two churning sticks as well. Prior to the tonsure ceremony, having bathed, there is immediate purification, as well as for sacrifice and recitation [of the Veda].

8.20.0.s: vratopetaś cet pramīyeta vratam̐ visṛjya kāṣṭhānāṃ citim̐ saṃpūryāpasavyam ādāhaṃ kṛtvānapekṣamāṇāḥ pratyāyanti /
8.20.0.d: व्रतोपेतश् चेत् प्रमीयेत व्रतम्̐ विसृज्य काष्ठानां चितिम्̐ संपूर्यापसव्यम् आदाहं कृत्वानपेक्षमाणाः प्रत्यायन्ति /
8.20.0.m: If one has died who has undertaken a vow, having discharged the vow, having completed a pyre of logs, and having performed the burning counter-clockwise, they return without looking back.

8.20.0.s: sthirodakenopaspṛśya yatrauṣadhayo bahulā abhijāyante tatropaviśya yamagāthāṃ gāyanti /
8.20.0.d: स्थिरोदकेनोपस्पृश्य यत्रौषधयो बहुला अभिजायन्ते तत्रोपविश्य यमगाथां गायन्ति /
8.20.0.m: Having touched standing water and sitting where plants grow abundantly, they sing a verse to Yama.

8.20.0.s: dūrvākāṇḍapravālānām̐ śamīvaṭāpāmārgapravālānāṃ mūrdhani kṛtvā gavāṃ pṛṣṭhato grāmaṃ praviśeyuḥ /
8.20.0.d: दूर्वाकाण्डप्रवालानाम्̐ शमीवटापामार्गप्रवालानां मूर्धनि कृत्वा गवां पृष्ठतो ग्रामं प्रविशेयुः /
8.20.0.m: Having placed sprouts of dūrvā stalks and sprouts of śamī, vaṭa, and apāmārga on their heads, they should enter the village behind the cows.

8.20.0.s: goṣṭhadvāry akṣatam aśmānam agnim upaspṛśya praviśeyuḥ /
8.20.0.d: गोष्ठद्वार्य् अक्षतम् अश्मानम् अग्निम् उपस्पृश्य प्रविशेयुः /
8.20.0.m: At the door of the cow-pen, having touched unhusked grain, a stone, and fire, they should enter.

8.20.0.s: bahirdvāri karṣū khātvāśmānaṃ pratiṣṭhāpya payo 'dbhiḥ sam̐sṛjya pretasya nāmagotre gṛhītvā \\ atra piba snāyasva \\ iti ca brūyād yathākālaṃ ca piṇḍanidhānaṃ / dvādaśe 'hani śrāddhaṃ kurvīta /
8.20.0.d: बहिर्द्वारि कर्षू खात्वाश्मानं प्रतिष्ठाप्य पयो ऽद्भिः सम्̐सृज्य प्रेतस्य नामगोत्रे गृहीत्वा \\ अत्र पिब स्नायस्व \\ इति च ब्रूयाद् यथाकालं च पिण्डनिधानं / द्वादशे ऽहनि श्राद्धं कुर्वीत /
8.20.0.m: Having dug a furrow outside the door, having set up a stone, having mixed milk with water, and having uttered the deceased's name and clan, one should say, 'Drink here, bathe here', and the laying down of rice-balls is according to the proper time. On the twelfth day he should perform a śrāddha.
He should prepare many varieties of food, one for each [brahmin].
He should perform an rite directed to an individual (uddiṣṭa); he should not perform it in the fire.

8.20.0.s: abhiramyatām iti visargo māsimāsi niyataṃ brāhmaṇaṃ bhojayed ā sapiṇḍīkaraṇāt /
8.20.0.d: अभिरम्यताम् इति विसर्गो मासिमासि नियतं ब्राह्मणं भोजयेद् आ सपिण्डीकरणात् /
8.20.0.m: The dismissal is with the words, 'May you take your pleasure'; month by month he should regularly feed a brahmin until the sapindisation rite (sapiṇḍīkaraṇa).

8.21.0.s: deśāntarasthe prete saṃgrāmahate vā śarīram āhṛtya vidhinā dāhayet /
8.21.0.d: देशान्तरस्थे प्रेते संग्रामहते वा शरीरम् आहृत्य विधिना दाहयेत् /
8.21.0.m: If the deceased died in another land or was killed in battle, having fetched the body, he should burn it according to the rule.

8.21.0.s: yadi tan na vinded asthīny āhṛtya taiḥ puruṣākṛtiṃ kṛtvā madhusarpiṣābhyajya cityām āropya vidhinā dāhayet /
8.21.0.d: यदि तन् न विन्देद् अस्थीन्य् आहृत्य तैः पुरुषाकृतिं कृत्वा मधुसर्पिषाभ्यज्य चित्याम् आरोप्य विधिना दाहयेत् /
8.21.0.m: If he does not find that, having brought the bones, having made a human shape with them, having anointed them with honey and clarified butter, and having mounted them on the pyre, he should burn them according to the rule.

8.21.0.s: yadi sarvaṃ na vinded iṣṭaṃ kṛtvā kakṣam ādīpayed yajñapātrāṇi ca /
8.21.0.d: यदि सर्वं न विन्देद् इष्टं कृत्वा कक्षम् आदीपयेद् यज्ञपात्राणि च /
8.21.0.m: If he does not find everything, having performed the sacrifice, he should set fire to dry grass and the sacrificial vessels.

8.21.0.s: sarve jñātaya udakaṃ kurvanti / dauhitrān apy eke /
8.21.0.d: सर्वे ज्ञातय उदकं कुर्वन्ति / दौहित्रान् अप्य् एके /
8.21.0.m: All kinsmen offer water. Some say even daughter's sons do so.

8.21.0.s: savyakaniṣṭhikayā darbhāntarhitayā \\ amuṣmai prayachāmi \\ ity udakānte 'ñjaliṃ ninayed ekam ekasyāṃ catuś caturthām̐ sapta saptamyāṃ daśa dásamyām /
8.21.0.d: सव्यकनिष्ठिकया दर्भान्तर्हितया \\ अमुष्मै प्रयछामि \\ इत्य् उदकान्ते ऽञ्जलिं निनयेद् एकम् एकस्यां चतुश् चतुर्थाम्̐ सप्त सप्तम्यां दश द्áसम्याम् /
8.21.0.m: With the left little finger wrapped with darbha grass, with the formula, 'To such-and-such a one I offer', he should pour a handful of water at the water's edge: one on the first [day], four on the fourth, seven on the seventh, and ten on the tenth.

8.21.0.s: daśarātram āśaucavatāṃ guptāśanam̐ saṃcayanaṃ ca caturthyām /
8.21.0.d: दशरात्रम् आशौचवतां गुप्ताशनम्̐ संचयनं च चतुर्थ्याम् /
8.21.0.m: For ten nights those under ritual impurity eat concealed food, and the gathering of bones takes place on the fourth [day].
He should feed an odd number of brahmins.

8.21.0.s: daśādamavakām̐ śamīm̐ vastrāvakṛtya ca haridraṃ kṣīrodakenāsthīny abhiṣicya savyakaniṣṭhikayā palāśavṛntena cāsthīni pattrapuṭe prasyati /
8.21.0.d: दशादमवकाम्̐ शमीम्̐ वस्त्रावकृत्य च हरिद्रं क्षीरोदकेनास्थीन्य् अभिषिच्य सव्यकनिष्ठिकया पलाशवृन्तेन चास्थीनि पत्त्रपुटे प्रस्यति /
8.21.0.m: Having torn away a cloth with ten threads [of] avakā, śamī, and turmeric, and having sprinkled the bones with milk and water, he places the bones into a leaf receptacle with the left little finger and a palāśa petiole.

8.21.0.s: dakṣiṇapūrvasyāṃ diśi karṣū khātvā vāg iti nivapet /
8.21.0.d: दक्षिणपूर्वस्यां दिशि कर्षू खात्वा वाग् इति निवपेत् /
8.21.0.m: Having dug a furrow in the south-eastern direction, he should scatter them with the word, 'Vāc'.

8.21.0.s: dakṣiṇāṃ dadāti daśa dhenūr daśānaḍuho daśa vāsām̐si daśa kām̐syāni /
8.21.0.d: दक्षिणां ददाति दश धेनूर् दशानडुहो दश वासाम्̐सि दश काम्̐स्यानि /
8.21.0.m: He gives the sacrificial gift: ten milch-cows, ten draft-oxen, ten garments, ten bronze vessels.

8.21.0.s: prāṇāpānābhyām̐ vā ete vṛdhyante ye mṛtāya kurvanti /
8.21.0.d: प्राणापानाभ्याम्̐ वा एते वृध्यन्ते ये मृताय कुर्वन्ति /
8.21.0.m: Verily, those who perform rites for the dead are separated from the in-breath and out-breath.

8.21.0.s: tasmāt sam̐vatsaraṃ tapaś ca yogaśīlaḥ syāt ṣaṇmāsam ity eke /
8.21.0.d: तस्मात् सम्̐वत्सरं तपश् च योगशीलः स्यात् षण्मासम् इत्य् एके /
8.21.0.m: Therefore, he should practice asceticism and yoga for a year; some say for six months.
Having officiated for a father, a brother, or a teacher, one becomes tainted.

8.21.0.s: evaṃ kṛte ced āgached agnīn utpādyāyuṣyair iṣṭvāta ūrdhvam aparimitaiḥ kratubhir yajeta /
8.21.0.d: एवं कृते चेद् आगछेद् अग्नीन् उत्पाद्यायुष्यैर् इष्ट्वात ऊर्ध्वम् अपरिमितैः क्रतुभिर् यजेत /
8.21.0.m: If he returns after this has been done, having produced the fires and having sacrificed with longevity offerings, he should thereafter sacrifice with unlimited sacrificial rites.

8.22.0.s:
aśītyardham̐ śirasi dadyād grīvāyāṃ tu daśaiva tu /
bāhvos tu śataṃ dadyād aṅgulīṣu daśaiva tu /
urasi vim̐śatiṃ dadyāt trim̐śatiṃ jaghanodare /
aṣṭārdham̐ vṛṣaṇyor dadyād dvādaśārdham̐ prajanane /
ūrvos tu śataṃ dadyāt ṣaṣṭyardhaṃ jānujaṅghayoḥ /
pādāṅgulīṣu daśaiva eṣa pretavidhiḥ smṛtaḥ /
8.22.0.d:
अशीत्यर्धम्̐ शिरसि दद्याद् ग्रीवायां तु दशैव तु /
बाह्वोस् तु शतं दद्याद् अङ्गुलीषु दशैव तु /
उरसि विम्̐शतिं दद्यात् त्रिम्̐शतिं जघनोदरे /
अष्टार्धम्̐ वृषण्योर् दद्याद् द्वादशार्धम्̐ प्रजनने /
ऊर्वोस् तु शतं दद्यात् षष्ट्यर्धं जानुजङ्घयोः /
पादाङ्गुलीषु दशैव एष प्रेतविधिः स्मृतः /
8.22.0.m: He should give forty [stalks] on the head, but exactly ten on the neck; / on the arms he should give a hundred, and on the fingers exactly ten; / on the chest he should give twenty, thirty on the hips and belly; / half of eight on the testicles, half of twelve on the generative organ; / on the thighs he should give a hundred, thirty on the knees and shanks; / and ten on the toes of the feet. This is handed down as the rule for the deceased.

8.23.0.s: patyau prete 'nagnikāyāyājyā strīti śākalyaḥ /
8.23.0.d: पत्यौ प्रेते ऽनग्निकायायाज्या स्त्रीति शाकल्यः /
8.23.0.m: When the husband is dead, a woman without sacred fires cannot be an offering-priestess: thus says Śākalya.

8.23.0.s: sā kathaṃ pañcabhāgaṃ paricaret paricaryayety āha mārukaḥ /
8.23.0.d: सा कथं पञ्चभागं परिचरेत् परिचर्ययेत्य् आह मारुकः /
8.23.0.m: 'How could she attend to the fifth portion by attendance?' says Māruka.

8.23.0.s: yadi vicāritā suvratā syād adhvaryuḥ patnīm anubrūyād āvasathyam imaṃ paricaret /
8.23.0.d: यदि विचारिता सुव्रता स्याद् अध्वर्युः पत्नीम् अनुब्रूयाद् आवसथ्यम् इमं परिचरेत् /
8.23.0.m: If, upon examination, she is of good conduct, the adhvaryu priest should say to the wife, 'Let her attend to this domestic fire (āvasathya)'.

8.23.0.s: yadi vittā suvrateti citraseno vātsyāyana ācāryaḥ pretapatnyā vicāre /
8.23.0.d: यदि वित्ता सुव्रतेति चित्रसेनो वात्स्यायन आचार्यः प्रेतपत्न्या विचारे /
8.23.0.m: 'If she is known to be of good conduct'—this is the teacher Citrasena Vātsyāyana's view regarding the examination of the deceased's wife.

8.23.0.s: patitve prayuktā tadvratā tadduḥkhā tadācārā maladigdhaikaveṇī śucivāsā /
8.23.0.d: पतित्वे प्रयुक्ता तद्व्रता तद्दुःखा तदाचारा मलदिग्धैकवेणी शुचिवासा /
8.23.0.m: Devoted to her state of wifehood, observing his vows, sharing his sorrow, keeping his conduct, wearing a single braid soiled with dirt, wearing pure clothes;

8.23.0.s: notsaveṣu gachen nākāle snāyān na hṛṣyed ekakālam aśnīta paricarec chvaśrūm̐ śvaśuraṃ gurum /
8.23.0.d: नोत्सवेषु गछेन् नाकाले स्नायान् न हृष्येद् एककालम् अश्नीत परिचरेच् छ्वश्रूम्̐ श्वशुरं गुरुम् /
8.23.0.m: She should not go to festivals, not bathe at improper times, not rejoice, eat once a day, and attend to her mother-in-law, father-in-law, and teacher.

8.23.0.s: sugandhasragvivarjitāvasathyaṃ paricaret pākayajñadharmeṇa /
8.23.0.d: सुगन्धस्रग्विवर्जितावसथ्यं परिचरेत् पाकयज्ञधर्मेण /
8.23.0.m: Free from fragrant garlands, she should attend to the domestic fire according to the rule of domestic cooked offerings (pākayajña).

8.23.0.s: paurṇamāsyām amāvāsyāyām āgneyaḥ sthālīpākaḥ sāyaṃprātarhomaḥ / parvakāle cemā devatā yajeta somaṃ tvaṣṭāraṃ devānāṃ patnī rākām̐ sinīvālīm agniṃ gṛhapatim /
8.23.0.d: पौर्णमास्याम् अमावास्यायाम् आग्नेयः स्थालीपाकः सायंप्रातर्होमः / पर्वकाले चेमा देवता यजेत सोमं त्वष्टारं देवानां पत्नी राकाम्̐ सिनीवालीम् अग्निं गृहपतिम् /
8.23.0.m: On the full-moon day and the new-moon day, there is a boiled oblation in a pot for Agni, and the evening and morning libations. And at the time of a junction, she should sacrifice to these deities: Soma, Tvaṣṭṛ, the Wives of the Gods, Rākā, Sinīvālī, and Agni Gṛhapati.

8.23.0.s: ājyenaiva juhuyāt /
8.23.0.d: आज्येनैव जुहुयात् /

8.23.0.s: sahāvad etau mithunau saṃbhavataḥ sahāgnīn ādhattaḥ saha prajāḥ prajanayataḥ /
8.23.0.d: सहावद् एतौ मिथुनौ संभवतः सहाग्नीन् आधत्तः सह प्रजाः प्रजनयतः /
8.23.0.m: These two, coming together as a pair, set up the fires together and bring forth offspring together.

8.23.0.s: pūrvo yajamānasya loko 'paraḥ patnyāḥ /
8.23.0.d: पूर्वो यजमानस्य लोको ऽपरः पत्न्याः /
8.23.0.m: The former world is the sacrificer's; the latter is the wife's.

8.23.0.s: dakṣiṇārdhyā yasmāt proṣitasyāśaktivato patnī vrataṃ dhārayet tasmād ardhabhāginī bhavati /
8.23.0.d: दक्षिणार्ध्या यस्मात् प्रोषितस्याशक्तिवतो पत्नी व्रतं धारयेत् तस्माद् अर्धभागिनी भवति /
8.23.0.m: Because the wife on the right-hand half observes the vow when he is away on a journey and unable, therefore she is an equal sharer of half.

8.23.0.s: yājyāḥ striyo 'rdhabhāk patnī yajñe yajamānasya /
8.23.0.d: याज्याः स्त्रियो ऽर्धभाक् पत्नी यज्ञे यजमानस्य /
8.23.0.m: Women are entitled to sacrificial rites; the wife is a sharer in half of the sacrificer's sacrifice.

8.23.0.s: yad āhavanīye juhoti tad iṣṭam̐ yajñam̐ yajamānasya gārhapatye hutaṃ patnyāḥ /
8.23.0.d: यद् आहवनीये जुहोति तद् इष्टम्̐ यज्ञम्̐ यजमानस्य गार्हपत्ये हुतं पत्न्याः /
8.23.0.m: What he offers in the āhavanīya fire, that is the sacrificer's offered sacrifice; what is offered in the gārhapatya fire belongs to the wife.

8.23.0.s: samavāye ca saṃ patnī patyā sukṛteṣu gachatām iti /
8.23.0.d: समवाये च सं पत्नी पत्या सुकृतेषु गछताम् इति /
8.23.0.m: And in conjunction: 'May the wife go together with her husband to good deeds.'

8.23.0.s: saha saṃbandhadarśanān mithunasya striyā vikṛtatvān mantrabrāhmaṇakalpeṣv evam eva darśayati śrutiḥ /
8.23.0.d: सह संबन्धदर्शनान् मिथुनस्य स्त्रिया विकृतत्वान् मन्त्रब्राह्मणकल्पेष्व् एवम् एव दर्शयति श्रुतिः /
8.23.0.m: Because of seeing the mutual connection of the couple, even though the woman is altered [by widowhood], the revealed text (śruti) shows it thus in mantras, Brāhmaṇas, and manual rules.

8.23.0.s: tatraike mṛtāṃ patnīm̐ śalāgninā dahanti nirmanthenānye sarvair agnibhir apare / tan na sūktam /
8.23.0.d: तत्रैके मृतां पत्नीम्̐ शलाग्निना दहन्ति निर्मन्थेनान्ये सर्वैर् अग्निभिर् अपरे / तन् न सूक्तम् /
8.23.0.m: Here some burn a deceased wife with the domestic fire; others with fire produced by friction; others with all the fires. That is not correct.

8.23.0.s:
yo dahed agnihotreṇa \ svena bhāryāṃ kathaṃcana /
sa strī saṃpadyate tena \ bhāryā cāsya pumān bhavet //
8.23.0.d:
यो दहेद् अग्निहोत्रेण \ स्वेन भार्यां कथंचन /
स स्त्री संपद्यते तेन \ भार्या चास्य पुमान् भवेत् //
8.23.0.m:
Whoever burns his wife / with his own agnihotra fire in any way,

thereby he becomes a woman, / and his wife becomes a man.

8.23.0.s: gārhapatyam upasamādhāya tasminn ukhām ādadhīta /
8.23.0.d: गार्हपत्यम् उपसमाधाय तस्मिन्न् उखाम् आदधीत /
8.23.0.m: Having added fuel to the gārhapatya fire, he should place an ukhā pot upon it.

8.23.0.s: taptāyāṃ kārpāsaṃ gośakṛccūrṇaṃ muñjāvalopam̐ śaṇam̐ śareṣikāḥ kramukam̐ sarpiḥ kṣipram agnijananyā vāpyaukhyam agnim avatārayet //
8.23.0.d: तप्तायां कार्पासं गोशकृच्चूर्णं मुञ्जावलोपम्̐ शणम्̐ शरेषिकाः क्रमुकम्̐ सर्पिः क्षिप्रम् अग्निजनन्या वाप्यौख्यम् अग्निम् अवतारयेत् //
8.23.0.m: When it is heated, he should bring down the fire of the pot (aukhya) onto cotton, powdered cow dung, shreds of muñja grass, hemp, reed-stalks, areca nut, and clarified butter, or quickly with a fire-producing stick.

8.23.0.s: yā te agne yogavatī priyā tanūḥ svarśokhārādvākhāta tayeda pātramārohati tasmai te namaḥ svāhā \\ iti hutvaukhyena vidhinā dāhayet /
8.23.0.d: या ते अग्ने योगवती प्रिया तनूः स्वर्शोखाराद्वाखात तयेद पात्रमारोहति तस्मै ते नमः स्वाहा \\ इति हुत्वौख्येन विधिना दाहयेत् /
8.23.0.m: Having offered with the formula, 'Agni, that dear, union-possessing body of yours... to you homage, svāhā', he should burn [her] according to the rule with the pot-fire.

8.23.0.s: atha yadi yajamānaḥ pūrvaṃ pramīyetādhānānupūrveṇa pañcadhāgnīn vihṛtyāvasathyaḥ patnyai pradeyaḥ /
8.23.0.d: अथ यदि यजमानः पूर्वं प्रमीयेताधानानुपूर्वेण पञ्चधाग्नीन् विहृत्यावसथ्यः पत्न्यै प्रदेयः /
8.23.0.m: Now, if the sacrificer dies first, having divided the fires into five according to the order of their establishment, the domestic fire (āvasathya) is to be given to the wife.

8.23.0.s: āvasathyaś cen na syād gārhapatyāt pañcabhāgaḥ pradeyaḥ /
8.23.0.d: आवसथ्यश् चेन् न स्याद् गार्हपत्यात् पञ्चभागः प्रदेयः /
8.23.0.m: If there should not be a domestic fire, the fifth portion is to be given from the gārhapatya fire.

8.23.0.s: nāraṇī striyo hy evāpatyāḥ /
8.23.0.d: नारणी स्त्रियो ह्य् एवापत्याः /
8.23.0.m: The two churning sticks are not [given to her], for women are indeed non-churning [of fire].

8.23.0.s: tam agnim upasamādhāya \\ ayaṃ no agnir varivas kṛṇotu \\ iti bhūṣaṇāni niṣṭapeyuḥ /
8.23.0.d: तम् अग्निम् उपसमाधाय \\ अयं नो अग्निर् वरिवस् कृणोतु \\ इति भूषणानि निष्टपेयुः /
8.23.0.m: Having added fuel to that fire, they should heat her ornaments with the formula, 'May this Agni grant us wide space'.

8.23.0.s:
niṣṭapteṣu
viśvaṃ jātam̐ viśvaṃ janitram \\ vaiśvānaram̐ viśvakarman huvema /
sabhyāvasathyau bahudhā nilīnau \ yoṣāgnayaḥ saṃbhavanti prātarkāḥ //
svāhā \\ iti juhoti /
8.23.0.d:
निष्टप्तेषु
विश्वं जातम्̐ विश्वं जनित्रम् \\ वैश्वानरम्̐ विश्वकर्मन् हुवेम /
सभ्यावसथ्यौ बहुधा निलीनौ \ योषाग्नयः संभवन्ति प्रातर्काः //
स्वाहा \\ इति जुहोति /
8.23.0.m:
[with the verses,] 'Everything born, every origin, / Vaiśvānara, Viśvakarman we invoke;

The sabhya and āvasathya fires, deeply hidden in many places, / the woman-fires that arise in the morning,'

8.23.0.s: svayamanugate sarva āyanti //
8.23.0.d: स्वयमनुगते सर्व आयन्ति //
8.23.0.m: When it has gone out of itself, all return.

8.23.0.s: ojo 'si \ saho 'si \ balam asi \ bhrājo 'si \\ iti svānisvāni bhūṣaṇāni punaragnikāle śālāgnau niṣṭapeyuḥ /
8.23.0.d: ओजो ऽसि \ सहो ऽसि \ बलम् असि \ भ्राजो ऽसि \\ इति स्वानिस्वानि भूषणानि पुनरग्निकाले शालाग्नौ निष्टपेयुः /
8.23.0.m: With "You are vigor, you are overpowering power, you are strength, you are brilliance," they should warm their respective ornaments over the hall fire at the time of the renewed fire.

8.23.0.s: yas tato 'bhisaṃkrāmet tam agnim upasamādhāya paricaret /
8.23.0.d: यस् ततो ऽभिसंक्रामेत् तम् अग्निम् उपसमाधाय परिचरेत् /
8.23.0.m: Whichever [fire] he moves toward from there, having built up that fire, he should attend upon it.

8.23.0.s: mṛtāyām̐ yāmyaś caruḥ saumyo nairṛto vā /
8.23.0.d: मृतायाम्̐ याम्यश् चरुः सौम्यो नैरृतो वा /
8.23.0.m: When a woman has died, there is a boiled oblation for Yama, or for Soma, or for Nirṛti.

8.24.0.s: athātas trayodaśe divase tripakṣe sam̐vatsare vṛddhau vā śrāddha ekodapātrasya sapiṇḍīkaraṇakalpam̐ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ /
8.24.0.d: अथातस् त्रयोदशे दिवसे त्रिपक्षे सम्̐वत्सरे वृद्धौ वा श्राद्ध एकोदपात्रस्य सपिण्डीकरणकल्पम्̐ व्याख्यास्यामः /
8.24.0.m: Now, therefore, we shall explain the procedure for the sapiṇḍīkaraṇa of the single water vessel, [performed] on the thirteenth day, after three fortnights, after a year, or at a rite of prosperity [in] the ancestral rite.

8.24.0.s: paścād agneḥ sameṣu darbheṣu catvāry udapātrāṇi prayunakti /
8.24.0.d: पश्चाद् अग्नेः समेषु दर्भेषु चत्वार्य् उदपात्राणि प्रयुनक्ति /
8.24.0.m: Behind the fire, on even darbha blades, he arranges four water vessels.
Among them, one vessel is for the deceased, and three are for the fathers.

8.24.0.s: tat pretapātraṃ pitṛpātreṣv āsiñcati ye samānāḥ samanasas \\ iti dvābhyām /
8.24.0.d: तत् प्रेतपात्रं पितृपात्रेष्व् आसिञ्चति ये समानाः समनसस् \\ इति द्वाभ्याम् /
8.24.0.m: He pours that vessel of the deceased into the vessels of the fathers with the two [verses]: "They who are equals, harmonious...".
In this very way, the procedure has been explained by the ancestral ball-offering.

8.25.0.m: Now, therefore, we shall explain the rule for renunciation.

8.25.0.s: gṛhasthe prayogo 'patyam utpādya dṛṣṭvāpatye 'patyāni vā teṣām̐ vṛttiṃ kalpayitvā guṇavati putre kuṭumbam āveśyāthāsyāgniviniyogaḥ /
8.25.0.d: गृहस्थे प्रयोगो ऽपत्यम् उत्पाद्य दृष्ट्वापत्ये ऽपत्यानि वा तेषाम्̐ वृत्तिं कल्पयित्वा गुणवति पुत्रे कुटुम्बम् आवेश्याथास्याग्निविनियोगः /
8.25.0.m: The performance for a householder: having begotten offspring, or having seen offspring upon offspring, having secured their livelihood, having entrusted the household to a virtuous son, then [takes place] his disposal of the fires.

8.25.0.s: agnaye pathikṛte 'ṣṭākapālam agnaye vaiśvānarāya dvādaśakapālaṃ nirvapet /
8.25.0.d: अग्नये पथिकृते ऽष्टाकपालम् अग्नये वैश्वानराय द्वादशकपालं निर्वपेत् /
8.25.0.m: He should apportion [the havis for] an eight-potsherd [cake] for Agni Pathikṛt and a twelve-potsherd [cake] for Agni Vaiśvānara.
The performance is explained; the apportioning is established.
At the time of the sacrificial gift, he should give away his entire property.

8.25.0.s: sakulyān āmantryātmany agnīn samāropayet sakhā hy agnir vai sākṣī sukṛtasya duṣkṛtasyety ayam arthaḥ //
8.25.0.d: सकुल्यान् आमन्त्र्यात्मन्य् अग्नीन् समारोपयेत् सखा ह्य् अग्निर् वै साक्षी सुकृतस्य दुष्कृतस्येत्य् अयम् अर्थः //
8.25.0.m: Having taken leave of his kinsmen, he should deposit the fires into himself; for the fire is a friend, a witness of good deeds and evil deeds—this is the meaning.

8.25.0.s: ayaṃ te yonir ṛtviyas \\ ity āhavanīye gārhapatye dakṣiṇāgnau cātmānaṃ pratāpayet /
8.25.0.d: अयं ते योनिर् ऋत्वियस् \\ इत्य् आहवनीये गार्हपत्ये दक्षिणाग्नौ चात्मानं प्रतापयेत् /
8.25.0.m: With "This is your seasonal womb...", he should warm himself over the āhavanīya fire, the gārhapatya fire, and the southern fire.

8.25.0.s: sarvāṇi yajñapātrāṇy antarvedi puruṣākṛtiṃ kṛtvolaparajībhis tisṛbhir ādīpayet /
8.25.0.d: सर्वाणि यज्ञपात्राण्य् अन्तर्वेदि पुरुषाकृतिं कृत्वोलपरजीभिस् तिसृभिर् आदीपयेत् /
8.25.0.m: Having arranged all the sacrificial vessels in the shape of a man within the altar, he should set them on fire with three bundles of reed grass.
"Today, here, let me speak with the threefold speech."

8.25.0.s: yo no agnir \ mayi gṛhṇāmi \\ ity āhavanīyād gārhapatyād dakṣiṇāgneś ca bhasmamuṣṭiṃ gṛhṇāti / yathāyaṃ bhasmamuṣṭir digbhya āhṛto digbhya eva gachaty evam //
8.25.0.d: यो नो अग्निर् \ मयि गृह्णामि \\ इत्य् आहवनीयाद् गार्हपत्याद् दक्षिणाग्नेश् च भस्ममुष्टिं गृह्णाति / यथायं भस्ममुष्टिर् दिग्भ्य आहृतो दिग्भ्य एव गछत्य् एवम् //
8.25.0.m: With "The fire which to us...", "I take into myself...", he takes a handful of ashes from the āhavanīya fire, from the gārhapatya fire, and from the southern fire. Just as this handful of ashes was brought from the quarters, in the same way it goes back to the quarters.

8.25.0.s: atha bhava \\ ity ante 'pividhyaty anapekṣamāṇo vrajati /
8.25.0.d: अथ भव \\ इत्य् अन्ते ऽपिविध्यत्य् अनपेक्षमाणो व्रजति /
8.25.0.m: With "Now become...", he casts it [into water] at the end, and walks away without looking back.

8.25.0.s: yat sāyaṃ prāśnāti so 'sya sāyam̐homo yat prātaḥ so 'sya prātarhomo yad darśe tad vā darśam̐ yat pūrṇamāse tat paurṇamāsyam /
8.25.0.d: यत् सायं प्राश्नाति सो ऽस्य सायम्̐होमो यत् प्रातः सो ऽस्य प्रातर्होमो यद् दर्शे तद् वा दर्शम्̐ यत् पूर्णमासे तत् पौर्णमास्यम् /
8.25.0.m: What he eats in the evening, that is his evening offering; what [he eats] in the morning, that is his morning offering; what [he eats] on the new moon, that is his New-Moon sacrifice; what [he eats] on the full moon, that is his Full-Moon sacrifice.

8.25.0.s: yan navasyāśnāti tenāsyāgrāyaṇam avāpnoti / yad vasante keśaśmaśru vāpayate so 'syāgniṣṭomaḥ /
8.25.0.d: यन् नवस्याश्नाति तेनास्याग्रायणम् अवाप्नोति / यद् वसन्ते केशश्मश्रु वापयते सो ऽस्याग्निष्टोमः /
8.25.0.m: What he eats of the new [grain], through that he attains his first-fruits offering. When he has his hair and beard shaved in the spring, that is his Agniṣṭoma.

8.25.0.d: एष संन्यासो ऽरण्यम्̐ व्रजति मूलफलभक्षो ऽत्यन्तभैक्षभक्षो वा /
8.25.0.m: This is renunciation: he departs to the wilderness, subsisting on roots and fruits, or subsisting purely on alms.

8.25.0.s: ata ūrdhvam agnipraveśanam̐ vīrādhvānam anāśakam̐ vā vṛddhāśramam̐ vāgachati /
8.25.0.d: अत ऊर्ध्वम् अग्निप्रवेशनम्̐ वीराध्वानम् अनाशकम्̐ वा वृद्धाश्रमम्̐ वागछति /
8.25.0.m: From then on, he undertakes entering into fire, the hero's path, fasting unto death, or the stage of the aged.

8.25.0.s: na punar āgachati / yady āgachati vīrahā bhavati /
8.25.0.d: न पुनर् आगछति / यद्य् आगछति वीरहा भवति /
8.25.0.m: He does not return again. If he returns, he becomes a slayer of heroes.

8.26.0.m: Now, therefore, we shall explain the movement through the passages.

8.26.0.s: āhavanīyotkarāv antarā tīrthaṃ cātvālotkarāv antarā dvitīyaṃ cātvālāhavanīyāv antarā tṛtīyam āhavanīyam̐ srucaś cāntareṇa caturthaṃ dakṣiṇasmin paridhisaṃdhau pañcamam /
8.26.0.d: आहवनीयोत्कराव् अन्तरा तीर्थं चात्वालोत्कराव् अन्तरा द्वितीयं चात्वालाहवनीयाव् अन्तरा तृतीयम् आहवनीयम्̐ स्रुचश् चान्तरेण चतुर्थं दक्षिणस्मिन् परिधिसंधौ पञ्चमम् /
8.26.0.m: Between the āhavanīya fire and the rubbish heap is a passage; between the pit and the rubbish heap is the second; between the pit and the āhavanīya fire is the third; between the āhavanīya fire and the srucs is the fourth; at the southern joint of the enclosing sticks is the fifth.

8.26.0.s: āgneyaṃ prathamam̐ vāruṇaṃ dvitīyam̐ vāyavyaṃ tṛtīyam āśvinaṃ caturtham̐ vaiṣṇavaṃ pañcamam /
8.26.0.d: आग्नेयं प्रथमम्̐ वारुणं द्वितीयम्̐ वायव्यं तृतीयम् आश्विनं चतुर्थम्̐ वैष्णवं पञ्चमम् /
8.26.0.m: The first belongs to Agni, the second to Varuṇa, the third to Vāyu, the fourth to the Aśvins, the fifth to Viṣṇu.
We shall explain their operations in order.

8.26.0.s: āhavanīyotkarāv antarā pātrāṇāṃ patnīnāṃ kanyānām udakānām ājyānām̐ haviṣām̐ samidhām̐ sam̐skārasamāharaṇadohanatīrtham /
8.26.0.d: आहवनीयोत्कराव् अन्तरा पात्राणां पत्नीनां कन्यानाम् उदकानाम् आज्यानाम्̐ हविषाम्̐ समिधाम्̐ सम्̐स्कारसमाहरणदोहनतीर्थम् /
8.26.0.m: Between the āhavanīya fire and the rubbish heap is the passage for the vessels, the wives, the young women, the waters, the clarified butter portions, the oblations, the firewood, the ritual preparation, the bringing together, and the milking.

8.26.0.s: cātvālotkarāv anatarartvijāṃ praveśanam̐ yajamānasya ca sadasaś copagamanam /
8.26.0.d: चात्वालोत्कराव् अनतरर्त्विजां प्रवेशनम्̐ यजमानस्य च सदसश् चोपगमनम् /
8.26.0.m: Between the pit and the rubbish heap is the entry of the officiating priests and the sacrificer, and the approaching of the sadas.

8.26.0.s: cātvālāhavanīyāv antarā jāghanīparikramaṇaṃ paśuparikramaṇam̐ vapāyā yūpasya cānvāhāram /
8.26.0.d: चात्वालाहवनीयाव् अन्तरा जाघनीपरिक्रमणं पशुपरिक्रमणम्̐ वपाया यूपस्य चान्वाहारम् /
8.26.0.m: Between the pit and the āhavanīya fire is the circumambulation with the tail, the circumambulation with the animal, and the bringing up of the omentum and of the sacrificial post.

8.26.0.s: āhavanīyam̐ srucaś cāntareṇādhvaryuyajamānayor dakṣiṇātikramaṇaṃ pratikramaṇam anuvyākhyātam /
8.26.0.d: आहवनीयम्̐ स्रुचश् चान्तरेणाध्वर्युयजमानयोर् दक्षिणातिक्रमणं प्रतिक्रमणम् अनुव्याख्यातम् /
8.26.0.m: Between the āhavanīya fire and the srucs is explained the stepping across to the south and the returning of the adhvaryu priest and the sacrificer.
At the southern joint of the enclosing sticks is the world-passage for the āśrāvaṇa call, the direction, the svāhā-call, the vaṣaṭ-call, the homage, and the firewood offering.
These, indeed, are the five passages.

8.26.0.s: ye pañca sam̐vatsarās tīrtheṣu pratiṣṭhitāḥ paṅktiriti vijñāyate /
8.26.0.d: ये पञ्च सम्̐वत्सरास् तीर्थेषु प्रतिष्ठिताः पङ्क्तिरिति विज्ञायते /
8.26.0.m: It is known: "The five years that are established in the passages are a paṅkti."

8.26.0.s: atīrthaprapannā ṛtvijaḥ purāyuṣaḥ pramāyukā bhavanti / tīrthaprapannāḥ sarvam āyur yanti /
8.26.0.d: अतीर्थप्रपन्ना ऋत्विजः पुरायुषः प्रमायुका भवन्ति / तीर्थप्रपन्नाः सर्वम् आयुर् यन्ति /
8.26.0.m: The officiating priests who proceed along non-passages are liable to die before their full lifespan. Those who proceed along the passages reach their full lifespan.

8.26.0.s: ya evam̐ vidvān pracaret sarve kāmā asya samṛdhyante /
8.26.0.d: य एवम्̐ विद्वान् प्रचरेत् सर्वे कामा अस्य समृध्यन्ते /
8.26.0.m: For him who operates knowing thus, all desires are fulfilled.

8.26.0.s: ato yad anyathā pracared ardham asya yajñasya varuṇapāśair badhyate / nāsya yajño devaṃgamo bhavati nāsya yajño devaṃgamo bhavatīti /
8.26.0.d: अतो यद् अन्यथा प्रचरेद् अर्धम् अस्य यज्ञस्य वरुणपाशैर् बध्यते / नास्य यज्ञो देवंगमो भवति नास्य यज्ञो देवंगमो भवतीति /
8.26.0.m: If he operates otherwise than this, half of his sacrifice is bound by Varuṇa's fetters. His sacrifice does not go to the gods; his sacrifice does not go to the gods.

9.1.1.s: atha rājasūyasūtraprārambhaḥ / rājā rājyakāmo rājasūyena yajeta /
9.1.1.d: अथ राजसूयसूत्रप्रारम्भः / राजा राज्यकामो राजसूयेन यजेत /
9.1.1.m: Now begins the sūtra of the Rājasūya: A king desiring sovereignty should sacrifice with the Rājasūya.

9.1.1.s: bhārgavo hotā /
9.1.1.d: भार्गवो होता /

9.1.1.s: āśvayujyāmamāvāsyāyām̐ vā yajanīye 'hany agniṣṭomāya jyotiṣṭomāya dīkṣate /
9.1.1.d: आश्वयुज्याममावास्यायाम्̐ वा यजनीये ऽहन्य् अग्निष्टोमाय ज्योतिष्टोमाय दीक्षते /
9.1.1.m: On the full-moon day of Āśvayuja or on the new-moon day, on the day of sacrifice, he undergoes consecration for an Agniṣṭoma or a Jyotiṣṭoma.

9.1.1.s: sa siddhaḥ saṃtiṣṭhate /
9.1.1.d: स सिद्धः संतिष्ठते /
9.1.1.m: It is completed in the established manner.

9.1.1.s: śvobhūte 'numatyā aṣṭākapālaṃ nirvapati /
9.1.1.d: श्वोभूते ऽनुमत्या अष्टाकपालं निर्वपति /
9.1.1.m: On the next day, he apportions an eight-potsherd [cake] for Anumati.

9.1.1.s: siddham ādhivapanāt /
9.1.1.d: सिद्धम् आधिवपनात् /

9.1.1.s: prāgadhivapanāt śamyāśiṣṭaṃ dṛṣadā samaṃ kuryāt /
9.1.1.d: प्रागधिवपनात् शम्याशिष्टं दृषदा समं कुर्यात् /
9.1.1.m: Before placing [the grains], he should make level with the upper mill-stone that which is left by the peg.

9.1.1.s: ye pratyañcaḥ śamyām atiśīyante tan nairṛtam ekakapālam /
9.1.1.d: ये प्रत्यञ्चः शम्याम् अतिशीयन्ते तन् नैरृतम् एककपालम् /
9.1.1.m: Those [grains] that fall beyond the peg to the west form the one-potsherd [cake] for Nirṛti.

9.1.1.s: tūṣṇīṃ dakṣiṇāgnau śrapayaty ānumataṃ gārhapatya / ubhau saha śṛtau kurvanti /
9.1.1.d: तूष्णीं दक्षिणाग्नौ श्रपयत्य् आनुमतं गार्हपत्य / उभौ सह शृतौ कुर्वन्ति /
9.1.1.m: He bakes it silently on the southern fire, and that for Anumati on the gārhapatya fire; they cook both together.

9.1.1.s: siddham ā pracaraṇāt /
9.1.1.d: सिद्धम् आ प्रचरणात् /

9.1.1.s: ājyabhāgābhyāṃ pracarya vīhi svāhāhutiṃ juṣāṇas \\ iti dakṣiṇāgnau juṣaṃ juhoti /
9.1.1.d: आज्यभागाभ्यां प्रचर्य वीहि स्वाहाहुतिं जुषाणस् \\ इति दक्षिणाग्नौ जुषं जुहोति /
9.1.1.m: Having proceeded with the two clarified butter portions, he offers the pleasing offering on the southern fire with "Enjoy, pleasing, the svāhā-offering...".

9.1.1.s: dakṣiṇā paretya svakṛta iriṇa ekolmukaṃ nidhāya visram̐sikāyāḥ kāṇḍābhyāṃ juhoti juṣāṇā nirṛtir vetu svāhā \\ iti juhoti /
9.1.1.d: दक्षिणा परेत्य स्वकृत इरिण एकोल्मुकं निधाय विस्रम्̐सिकायाः काण्डाभ्यां जुहोति जुषाणा निरृतिर् वेतु स्वाहा \\ इति जुहोति /
9.1.1.m: Having gone away to the south, having placed a single firebrand on a naturally formed barren ground, he offers with two reeds of visraṃsikā-grass; he offers with "May Nirṛti, pleased, accept, svāhā!".

9.1.1.s: vāsaḥ kṛṣṇaṃ bhinnāntaṃ dakṣiṇā //
9.1.1.d: वासः कृष्णं भिन्नान्तं दक्षिणा //
9.1.1.m: A black garment with torn edges is the sacrificial gift.

9.1.1.s: svāhā namo ya idaṃ cakāra \\ iti gārhapatye hutvānumatena pracaranti /
9.1.1.d: स्वाहा नमो य इदं चकार \\ इति गार्हपत्ये हुत्वानुमतेन प्रचरन्ति /
9.1.1.m: Having offered in the gārhapatya fire with "Svāhā! Homage to him who has done this!", they proceed with that [cake] for Anumati.

9.1.1.s: dakṣiṇākāle dhenur dakṣiṇā /
9.1.1.d: दक्षिणाकाले धेनुर् दक्षिणा /
9.1.1.m: At the time of the sacrificial gift, a milch cow is the sacrificial gift.

9.1.1.s: siddham ā vedastaraṇāt /
9.1.1.d: सिद्धम् आ वेदस्तरणात् /
9.1.1.m: [The rite is] established up to the strewing of the altar.

9.1.1.s: atha ya udañcaḥ śamyām atiśīyante tān udak paretya valmīkavapām uddhṛtya \\ idam aham amuṣyāmuṣyāyaṇasya kṣetriyam avayaje \\ ity uktvā juhoti \\ idam aham amuṣyāmuṣyāyaṇasya kṣetriyam apidadhāmi \\ iti loṣṭenāpidadhāti /
9.1.1.d: अथ य उदञ्चः शम्याम् अतिशीयन्ते तान् उदक् परेत्य वल्मीकवपाम् उद्धृत्य \\ इदम् अहम् अमुष्यामुष्यायणस्य क्षेत्रियम् अवयजे \\ इत्य् उक्त्वा जुहोति \\ इदम् अहम् अमुष्यामुष्यायणस्य क्षेत्रियम् अपिदधामि \\ इति लोष्टेनापिदधाति /
9.1.1.m: Now, those [grains] that fall beyond the peg to the north: having gone away to the north with them, having extracted the heart of an ant-hill, having said, "Here I sacrifice away the hereditary disease of so-and-so, descendant of so-and-so," he offers; with "Here I cover up the hereditary disease of so-and-so, descendant of so-and-so," he covers it with a clod of earth.

9.1.1.s: śvobhūta ādityebhyo bhuvadvadbhyo ghṛte carur itiprabhṛti yathāmnātam /
9.1.1.d: श्वोभूत आदित्येभ्यो भुवद्वद्भ्यो घृते चरुर् इतिप्रभृति यथाम्नातम् /
9.1.1.m: On the next day, a boiled oblation in clarified butter for the prosperous Ādityas, and so forth, as handed down by tradition.

9.1.1.s: śvobhūta āgrāyaṇo / vatsaḥ prathamajo dakṣiṇā /
9.1.1.d: श्वोभूत आग्रायणो / वत्सः प्रथमजो दक्षिणा /
9.1.1.m: On the next day, the first-fruits sacrifice; a first-born calf is the sacrificial gift.

9.1.1.s: śvobhūte cāturmāsyāni paurṇamāsyām ārabhya sam̐vatsare 'pavarjayet /
9.1.1.d: श्वोभूते चातुर्मास्यानि पौर्णमास्याम् आरभ्य सम्̐वत्सरे ऽपवर्जयेत् /
9.1.1.m: On the next day, having begun the four-month sacrifices on a full-moon day, he should conclude them after a year.

9.1.1.s: śvobhūta indraturīyam āgneyo 'ṣṭākapālo vāruṇo yavamayaś carū raudro gāvīdhukaś carur aindraṃ dadhi / dhenur anaḍvāhī dakṣiṇā /
9.1.1.d: श्वोभूत इन्द्रतुरीयम् आग्नेयो ऽष्टाकपालो वारुणो यवमयश् चरू रौद्रो गावीधुकश् चरुर् ऐन्द्रं दधि / धेनुर् अनड्वाही दक्षिणा /
9.1.1.m: On the next day, the Indraturīya [offering]: an eight-potsherd [cake] for Agni, a barley boiled oblation for Varuṇa, a gāvīdhuka boiled oblation for Rudra, and curds for Indra; a draft cow is the sacrificial gift.

9.1.1.s: apāṃ nyayanād apāmārgān āharanti / tān saktūn kṛtvā śvobhūte prāgudayād apāmārgeṇa pracaranti /
9.1.1.d: अपां न्ययनाद् अपामार्गान् आहरन्ति / तान् सक्तून् कृत्वा श्वोभूते प्रागुदयाद् अपामार्गेण प्रचरन्ति /
9.1.1.m: They bring apāmārga plants from a confluence of waters; having made them into groats, they proceed with the apāmārga offering on the next day before sunrise.

9.1.1.s: dakṣiṇā paretya svakṛta iriṇa ekolmukaṃ nidhāya parṇamayena sruveṇa devasya tvā savituḥ prasave \\ iti juhoti //
9.1.1.d: दक्षिणा परेत्य स्वकृत इरिण एकोल्मुकं निधाय पर्णमयेन स्रुवेण देवस्य त्वा सवितुः प्रसवे \\ इति जुहोति //
9.1.1.m: Having gone toward the south, having placed a single firebrand on a naturally barren piece of land, he offers with a sruva ladle made of palāśa wood: 'At the impulse of the divine Savitṛ...'

9.1.1.s: hatam̐ rakṣas \\ avadhiṣma rakṣas \\ ity anūpatiṣṭhate / varo dakṣiṇā /
9.1.1.d: हतम्̐ रक्षस् \\ अवधिष्म रक्षस् \\ इत्य् अनूपतिष्ठते / वरो दक्षिणा /
9.1.1.m: He stands worshipping with: 'Slain is the rakṣas,' 'We have slain the rakṣas.' A chosen wish is the sacrificial gift.

9.1.1.s: sāyaṃ pañcedhmīyān avanīya pañcadhā vyudūhyedhmān ādadhāti //
9.1.1.d: सायं पञ्चेध्मीयान् अवनीय पञ्चधा व्युदूह्येध्मान् आदधाति //
9.1.1.m: In the evening, having poured out five [portions of water] suitable for kindling sticks, having divided the kindling sticks into five parts, he lays them on.

9.1.1.s: ye devāḥ puraḥsadas \\ iti pūrvārdhe juhoti pradakṣiṇam uttarair anuparikrāmaṃ na pratiparikramya pañcamena madhye //
9.1.1.d: ये देवाः पुरःसदस् \\ इति पूर्वार्धे जुहोति प्रदक्षिणम् उत्तरैर् अनुपरिक्रामं न प्रतिपरिक्रम्य पञ्चमेन मध्ये //
9.1.1.m: With: 'Whichever gods sit in front...' he offers in the eastern half, moving around clockwise with the following [mantras] without turning back, [and offers] in the middle with the fifth.

9.1.1.s: idam aham̐ rakṣo 'bhisamūhāmi \\ itiprabhṛtibhir āhavanīyam̐ samūhya \\ agnaye puraḥsade svāhā \\ iti pūrvārdhe juhoti pradakṣiṇam uttarair anuparikrāmaṃ na pratiparikramya pañcamena madhye /
9.1.1.d: इदम् अहम्̐ रक्षो ऽभिसमूहामि \\ इतिप्रभृतिभिर् आहवनीयम्̐ समूह्य \\ अग्नये पुरःसदे स्वाहा \\ इति पूर्वार्धे जुहोति प्रदक्षिणम् उत्तरैर् अनुपरिक्रामं न प्रतिपरिक्रम्य पञ्चमेन मध्ये /
9.1.1.m: Having swept together the āhavanīya fire with [the mantras] beginning with: 'Here I sweep together the rakṣas,' he offers in the eastern half with: 'To Agni who sits in front, svāhā,' moving around clockwise with the following [mantras] without turning back, [and offers] in the middle with the fifth.

9.1.1.s: rathaḥ pañcavāhī dakṣiṇā /
9.1.1.d: रथः पञ्चवाही दक्षिणा /
9.1.1.m: The sacrificial gift is a chariot drawn by five horses.

9.1.1.s: amāvāsyāyāṃ niśi pañcedhmīyena yajeta yo rakṣobhyo bibhīyāt piśācebhyo vā /
9.1.1.d: अमावास्यायां निशि पञ्चेध्मीयेन यजेत यो रक्षोभ्यो बिभीयात् पिशाचेभ्यो वा /
9.1.1.m: One who fears the Rakṣases or the Piśācas should sacrifice with [the rite of] five bundles of sacrificial fuel on the night of the new-moon day.

9.1.1.s: śvobhūte devikāpaṣṭhauhī dakṣiṇā /
9.1.1.d: श्वोभूते देविकापष्ठौही दक्षिणा /
9.1.1.m: On the next day, [the rite of] the Devikās [is performed]; a two-year-old cow is the sacrificial gift.

9.1.1.s: śvobhūte triṣam̐yuktam āgnāvaiṣṇava ekādaśakapāla aindrāvaiṣṇavaś carur vaiṣṇavas trikapālo vāmano dakṣiṇā /
9.1.1.d: श्वोभूते त्रिषम्̐युक्तम् आग्नावैष्णव एकादशकपाल ऐन्द्रावैष्णवश् चरुर् वैष्णवस् त्रिकपालो वामनो दक्षिणा /
9.1.1.m: On the next day, the triple-combined [offering is performed]: an eleven-potsherd [cake] to Agni and Viṣṇu, a boiled oblation to Indra and Viṣṇu, and a three-potsherd [cake] to Viṣṇu; a dwarf [animal] is the sacrificial gift.

9.1.1.s: śvobhūta uttaram̐ somāpauṣṇa ekādaśakapāla aindrāpauṣṇaś caruḥ pauṣṇaś caruḥ / śyāmo dakṣiṇā /
9.1.1.d: श्वोभूत उत्तरम्̐ सोमापौष्ण एकादशकपाल ऐन्द्रापौष्णश् चरुः पौष्णश् चरुः / श्यामो दक्षिणा /
9.1.1.m: On the next day, the subsequent [triple offering is performed]: an eleven-potsherd [cake] to Soma and Pūṣan, a boiled oblation to Indra and Pūṣan, and a boiled oblation to Pūṣan; a dark-grey [animal] is the sacrificial gift.

9.1.1.s: śvobhūte vaiśvānaram̐ vāruṇam agnaye vaiśvānarāya dvādaśakapāla iyān vāruṇo yavamayaś carur hiraṇyaṃ cāśvaś ca dakṣiṇā /
9.1.1.d: श्वोभूते वैश्वानरम्̐ वारुणम् अग्नये वैश्वानराय द्वादशकपाल इयान् वारुणो यवमयश् चरुर् हिरण्यं चाश्वश् च दक्षिणा /
9.1.1.m: On the next day, [the offering] to Vaiśvānara and Varuṇa: a twelve-potsherd [cake] to Agni Vaiśvānara, and this much boiled oblation made of barley to Varuṇa; gold and a horse are the sacrificial gift.

9.1.1.s: śvobhūte bārhaspatyaś carur brahmaṇo gṛha itiprabhṛtayo ratninaḥ /
9.1.1.d: श्वोभूते बार्हस्पत्यश् चरुर् ब्रह्मणो गृह इतिप्रभृतयो रत्निनः /
9.1.1.m: On the next day, a boiled oblation to Bṛhaspati at the house of the brahman priest, and so forth: [these are the offerings to] the jewel-holders.

9.1.1.s: ta iṣṭipariveṣaṃ dadyur yeṣāṃ gṛheṣv anvaham̐ yajeta /
9.1.1.d: त इष्टिपरिवेषं दद्युर् येषां गृहेष्व् अन्वहम्̐ यजेत /
9.1.1.m: Those in whose houses he sacrifices day after day should give the meal for the sacrifice.

9.1.1.s: aṅguṣṭhaparvamātro nairṛtaś carur nakhanirbhinnānāṃ tūṣṇīṃ dakṣiṇāgnau śrapayati /
9.1.1.d: अङ्गुष्ठपर्वमात्रो नैरृतश् चरुर् नखनिर्भिन्नानां तूष्णीं दक्षिणाग्नौ श्रपयति /
9.1.1.m: A boiled oblation to Nirṛti the size of a thumb-joint, prepared from grains split by fingernails, he cooks silently on the southern fire.

9.1.1.s: dakṣiṇā paretya svakṛta iriṇa ekolmukaṃ nidhāya pradare vā nirṛtyai svāhā \\ iti juhoti /
9.1.1.d: दक्षिणा परेत्य स्वकृत इरिण एकोल्मुकं निधाय प्रदरे वा निरृत्यै स्वाहा \\ इति जुहोति /
9.1.1.m: Going away toward the south, having placed a single firebrand in a natural salt-bed or in a cleft [in the ground], he offers [it with]: "To Nirṛti, svāhā!"

9.1.1.s: ratnibhya ūrdhvaḥ punar aindra ekādaśakapālo rājño gṛha ṛṣabho dakṣiṇā /
9.1.1.d: रत्निभ्य ऊर्ध्वः पुनर् ऐन्द्र एकादशकपालो राज्ञो गृह ऋषभो दक्षिणा /
9.1.1.m: After the jewel-holders, there is again an eleven-potsherd [cake] to Indra at the house of the king; a bull is the sacrificial gift.

9.1.1.s: śvobhūte prayogāv indrāyām̐homuca ekādaśakapālaṃ nirvaped indrāya sutrāmṇa ekādaśakapālam ṛṣabho dakṣiṇā /
9.1.1.d: श्वोभूते प्रयोगाव् इन्द्रायाम्̐होमुच एकादशकपालं निर्वपेद् इन्द्राय सुत्राम्ण एकादशकपालम् ऋषभो दक्षिणा /
9.1.1.m: On the next day, the two Prayoga offerings: he should apportion an eleven-potsherd [cake] to Indra Aṃhomuc [and] an eleven-potsherd [cake] to Indra Sutrāman; a bull is the sacrificial gift.

9.1.1.s: anvaham̐ yajeta /
9.1.1.d: अन्वहम्̐ यजेत /

9.1.1.s: pārvaṇaḥ parvaṇi /
9.1.1.d: पार्वणः पर्वणि /

9.1.1.s: traidhātavyayānyat sahasraṃ dakṣiṇā /
9.1.1.d: त्रैधातव्ययान्यत् सहस्रं दक्षिणा /
9.1.1.m: With the Traidhātavīyā [offering, he performs] another [rite]; a thousand [cows are] the sacrificial gift.

9.1.2.m: [The offering] to Mitra and Bṛhaspati is [performed] during the initiatory offering of the consecration ceremony.
A vessel of a naturally broken branch of an aśvattha tree is [used].
In the east they milk a white [cow] having a white calf.

9.1.2.s: tat svayaṃ mūrchati svayaṃ mathyate svayam̐vilīnam ājyaṃ bhavati /
9.1.2.d: तत् स्वयं मूर्छति स्वयं मथ्यते स्वयम्̐विलीनम् आज्यं भवति /
9.1.2.m: It coagulates by itself, is churned by itself, and becomes clarified butter melted by itself.
Then he apportions the oblation to Mitra and Bṛhaspati.

9.1.2.s: ardhaṃ barhiṣo lunāty ardham̐ svayam̐lūnam ardham idhmasya karoty ardham̐ svayaṃkṛtam ardham̐ vedyāḥ karoty ardham̐ svayaṃkṛtam /
9.1.2.d: अर्धं बर्हिषो लुनात्य् अर्धम्̐ स्वयम्̐लूनम् अर्धम् इध्मस्य करोत्य् अर्धम्̐ स्वयंकृतम् अर्धम्̐ वेद्याः करोत्य् अर्धम्̐ स्वयंकृतम् /
9.1.2.m: He cuts half of the sacrificial grass, and half is naturally cut; he prepares half of the sacrificial fuel, and half is naturally prepared; he prepares half of the altar, and half is naturally prepared.

9.1.2.s: ye kṣodiṣṭhās taṇḍulās taṃ bārhaspatyaṃ carum̐ śṛtaṃ kurvanti /
9.1.2.d: ये क्षोदिष्ठास् तण्डुलास् तं बार्हस्पत्यं चरुम्̐ शृतं कुर्वन्ति /
9.1.2.m: The grains of rice that are the smallest they cook as that boiled oblation to Bṛhaspati.

9.1.2.s: tatrājyam ādhāya svayam̐vilīnam āsicya sthaviṣṭhān āvapanti /
9.1.2.d: तत्राज्यम् आधाय स्वयम्̐विलीनम् आसिच्य स्थविष्ठान् आवपन्ति /
9.1.2.m: Having placed clarified butter there, having poured in [that which is] naturally melted, they throw in the largest [grains].
Bringing both together, they cook them at the same time.
On the unraised [portion] he places [the oblation] for Mitra; on the raised [portion, that] for Bṛhaspati.
They proceed with the [oblation] for Mitra first.

9.1.2.s: aśvo maitrasya dakṣiṇā śitipṛṣṭho bārhaspatyasya śvetā vā savatsobhayoḥ /
9.1.2.d: अश्वो मैत्रस्य दक्षिणा शितिपृष्ठो बार्हस्पत्यस्य श्वेता वा सवत्सोभयोः /
9.1.2.m: A horse is the sacrificial gift for the [offering] to Mitra; a white-backed [animal] for that to Bṛhaspati; or a white [cow] with its calf for both.

9.1.2.s: saha somau krīṇanty abhiṣecanīyadeśe yathoddeśair vatsataraiḥ sāṇḍaiḥ /
9.1.2.d: सह सोमौ क्रीणन्त्य् अभिषेचनीयदेशे यथोद्देशैर् वत्सतरैः साण्डैः /
9.1.2.m: They buy both Somas together at the place of the consecration rite with uncastrated young bulls as specified.
He deposits the [Soma] for the Dāśapeya in the house of the brahman priest.

9.1.2.s: agnaye gṛhapataya āpatantānām ity aṣṭau devasuvām̐ havīm̐ṣy agnīṣomīyasya paśupuroḍāśam anunirvapati /
9.1.2.d: अग्नये गृहपतय आपतन्तानाम् इत्य् अष्टौ देवसुवाम्̐ हवीम्̐ष्य् अग्नीषोमीयस्य पशुपुरोडाशम् अनुनिर्वपति /
9.1.2.m: With "To Agni, lord of the house..." he apportions after the animal cake of the [offering to] Agni and Soma the eight oblations to the divine quickeners that fall [in the prescribed order].
He proceeds [with them] in the same manner as with the Devikā oblations.

9.1.2.s: prāk sviṣṭakṛtaḥ savitā tvā prasavānām̐ suvatām iti brahmaṇo hastam ālabhya yajamānam āśravayanti //
9.1.2.d: प्राक् स्विष्टकृतः सविता त्वा प्रसवानाम्̐ सुवताम् इति ब्रह्मणो हस्तम् आलभ्य यजमानम् आश्रवयन्ति //
9.1.2.m: Before the Sviṣṭakṛt offering, with "May Savitṛ quicken you among the quickeners...", having taken the hand of the brahman priest, they make [the assembly] listen to [the proclamation of] the sacrificer.

9.1.2.s: amum iti nāma gṛhṇāti \\ āmuṣyāyaṇam iti gotram amuṣyāḥ putram iti mātur amuṣyām̐ viśi \\ iti svārājyam āśāsate viśi mahate kṣatrāya mahate jānarājyāya \\ iti sarvatrānuṣajati /
9.1.2.d: अमुम् इति नाम गृह्णाति \\ आमुष्यायणम् इति गोत्रम् अमुष्याः पुत्रम् इति मातुर् अमुष्याम्̐ विशि \\ इति स्वाराज्यम् आशासते विशि महते क्षत्राय महते जानराज्याय \\ इति सर्वत्रानुषजति /
9.1.2.m: He mentions the name: "So-and-so"; the lineage: "of the lineage of so-and-so"; the mother: "the son of so-and-so"; they pray for self-rule among the people: "in the clan of so-and-so"; he appends everywhere: "for great dominion, for great sovereign rule over the people!"
On the next day is the consecration rite, a seventeen-fold ukthya with the bṛhat as pṛṣṭha-sāman.
[The procedure is] established up to the apportioning of the midday [oblations].
Having apportioned the midday [oblations], he apportions a twenty-one-potsherd [cake] to the Maruts.

9.1.2.s: śukrajyotiś ca citrajyotiś ca \\ itiprabhṛtibhir gaṇair ekavim̐śatiṃ kapālāny upadadhāti vaiśvadevīṃ ca payasīṃ tūṣṇīm̐ sam̐skaroti /
9.1.2.d: शुक्रज्योतिश् च चित्रज्योतिश् च \\ इतिप्रभृतिभिर् गणैर् एकविम्̐शतिं कपालान्य् उपदधाति वैश्वदेवीं च पयसीं तूष्णीम्̐ सम्̐स्करोति /
9.1.2.m: With the groups [of mantras] beginning with "Śukrajyotis and Citrajyotis...", he places twenty-one potsherds and silently prepares the curd offering to the All-Gods.
[The procedure is] established up to the time for the sacrificial gifts.

9.1.2.s: evam asaṃmitā dakṣiṇā dadāty ayutam̐ vā /
9.1.2.d: एवम् असंमिता दक्षिणा ददात्य् अयुतम्̐ वा /
9.1.2.m: In this manner he gives an immeasurable sacrificial gift, or ten thousand [cows].

9.1.2.s: marutvatīyaiḥ pracarya mārutena pracarati payasyā ca //
9.1.2.d: मरुत्वतीयैः प्रचर्य मारुतेन प्रचरति पयस्या च //
9.1.2.m: Having proceeded with the [offerings] to the Marutvats, he proceeds with the [offering] to the Maruts and with the curd offering.

9.1.2.s: devīr āpo apāṃ napād ity abhihavam apāṃ ca trīṇi gṛhṇāti //
9.1.2.d: देवीर् आपो अपां नपाद् इत्य् अभिहवम् अपां च त्रीणि गृह्णाति //
9.1.2.m: With "O divine waters, offspring of the waters...", he takes [water for] consecration and three [measures] of water.

9.1.2.s: devīr āpo apāṃ napād iti sārasvatīnām̐ // rāṣṭradā stha rāṣṭram amuṣmai datta \\ iti sarvatrānuṣajati //
9.1.2.d: देवीर् आपो अपां नपाद् इति सारस्वतीनाम्̐ // राष्ट्रदा स्थ राष्ट्रम् अमुष्मै दत्त \\ इति सर्वत्रानुषजति //
9.1.2.m: With "O divine waters, offspring of the waters..." [he takes the water] of the Sarasvatī; he appends everywhere: "You are bestowal of kingship; bestow kingship upon so-and-so!"

9.1.2.s: vṛṣormir asi \\ iti pratīpasāriṇīnām \\ vṛṣaseno 'si \\ ity anvīpasāriṇīnām apāṃ patir asi \\ iti nadād aprahāvarī stha \\ iti sthāvarāṇām \\ parivāhiṇī stha \\ iti vāhinīnām ojasvinī stha \\ iti yā uñśīya dhāveyur māndā stha \\ iti mandam̐ vahantīnām \\ vrajakṣita stha \\ iti kūpyānām \\ sūryavarcasa stha sūryatvacasa stha \\ iti yā ātapati varṣati yāś ca paridadṛśre marutām oja stha \\ iti hrādunīnām \\ vaśā stha \\ iti puṣpāṇām \\ śakvarī stha \\ iti gorulbyānām \\ viśvabhṛta stha janabhṛtas \\ iti dadhnaḥ ślakṣṇasya \\ anādhṛṣṭāsi \\ iti ghṛtasya \\ apām oṣadhīnām̐ rasas \\ iti madhunaḥ //
9.1.2.d: वृषोर्मिर् असि \\ इति प्रतीपसारिणीनाम् \\ वृषसेनो ऽसि \\ इत्य् अन्वीपसारिणीनाम् अपां पतिर् असि \\ इति नदाद् अप्रहावरी स्थ \\ इति स्थावराणाम् \\ परिवाहिणी स्थ \\ इति वाहिनीनाम् ओजस्विनी स्थ \\ इति या उञ्शीय धावेयुर् मान्दा स्थ \\ इति मन्दम्̐ वहन्तीनाम् \\ व्रजक्षित स्थ \\ इति कूप्यानाम् \\ सूर्यवर्चस स्थ सूर्यत्वचस स्थ \\ इति या आतपति वर्षति याश् च परिददृश्रे मरुताम् ओज स्थ \\ इति ह्रादुनीनाम् \\ वशा स्थ \\ इति पुष्पाणाम् \\ शक्वरी स्थ \\ इति गोरुल्ब्यानाम् \\ विश्वभृत स्थ जनभृतस् \\ इति दध्नः श्लक्ष्णस्य \\ अनाधृष्टासि \\ इति घृतस्य \\ अपाम् ओषधीनाम्̐ रसस् \\ इति मधुनः //
9.1.2.m: "You are a bull-like wave," [he takes] of flowing waters running upstream; "You are a bull-like troop," of those running downstream; "You are the lord of waters," from a roaring river; "You are unhurried," of standing waters; "You are overflowing," of streaming waters; "You are vigorous," of those that run springing up; "You are sluggish," of those flowing slowly; "You are settled in the pen," of well-waters; "You have the lustre of the sun, you have the skin of the sun," of those that [fall] while the sun shines and rains, and which are seen around; "You are the strength of the Maruts," of hail-waters; "You are the barren cows," of dew on flowers; "You are the capable ones," of the afterbirth of a cow; "You are all-nourishing, people-nourishing," of smooth curds; "You are unassailable," of clarified butter; "The sap of waters and plants," of honey.

9.1.2.s: devīr āpo madhumatīḥ sam̐sṛjyadhvam iti vistṛte pātre sam̐sṛjyottareṇa hotrīyaṃ parikramya \\ anādhṛṣṭāḥ sīdata \\ iti paścāt potur dhiṣṇyasya sādayati /
9.1.2.d: देवीर् आपो मधुमतीः सम्̐सृज्यध्वम् इति विस्तृते पात्रे सम्̐सृज्योत्तरेण होत्रीयं परिक्रम्य \\ अनाधृष्टाः सीदत \\ इति पश्चात् पोतुर् धिष्ण्यस्य सादयति /
9.1.2.m: With "O divine waters, rich in honey, mingle together...", having mingled [them] in a broad vessel, having walked around north of the hotṛ's hearth, he places [them] behind the potṛ's hearth with "Sit down, unassailable ones!"

9.1.3.s: darbhayoḥ pratimucya \\ anibhṛṣṭam asi \\ iti rukmam ādatte //
9.1.3.d: दर्भयोः प्रतिमुच्य \\ अनिभृष्टम् असि \\ इति रुक्मम् आदत्ते //
9.1.3.m: Fastening two darbha-blades [to it], he takes the gold ornament with "You are uninjured."

9.1.3.s: śukrā vaḥ śukreṇa punāmi \\ iti rukmeṇotpunāti //
9.1.3.d: शुक्रा वः शुक्रेण पुनामि \\ इति रुक्मेणोत्पुनाति //
9.1.3.m: With "Bright ones, I purify you with the bright," he purifies [the waters] with the gold ornament.

9.1.3.s: svāhā rājasūyās \\ iti rukmam anvavasṛjati //
9.1.3.d: स्वाहा राजसूयास् \\ इति रुक्मम् अन्ववसृजति //
9.1.3.m: With "Svāhā to the consecration waters!" he drops the gold ornament in [the waters].

9.1.3.s: sadhamādo dyumnyā ūrjā ekās \\ iti vyānayati pālāśāśvatthaudumbaranaiyagrodhaiḥ //
9.1.3.d: सधमादो द्युम्न्या ऊर्जा एकास् \\ इति व्यानयति पालाशाश्वत्थौदुम्बरनैयग्रोधैः //
9.1.3.m: With 'Feasting together, splendid, with nourishment, single', he separates [the waters] with [cups made of] parṇa, aśvattha, udumbara, and nyagrodha wood.

9.1.3.s: rudra yat te giriparaṃ nāma \\ iti śeṣam āgnīdhrīye juhoti //
9.1.3.d: रुद्र यत् ते गिरिपरं नाम \\ इति शेषम् आग्नीध्रीये जुहोति //
9.1.3.m: With 'O Rudra, whatever is your name that is beyond the mountain', he offers the remainder in the āgnīdhra fire.

9.1.3.s: somā indro varuṇas \\ iti yajamānam̐ vācayati /
9.1.3.d: सोमा इन्द्रो वरुणस् \\ इति यजमानम्̐ वाचयति /
9.1.3.m: He has the sacrificer recite, 'Soma, Indra, Varuṇa'.

9.1.3.s: dadhi madhu śaṣpāṇy audumbare yajamānam āśayati //
9.1.3.d: दधि मधु शष्पाण्य् औदुम्बरे यजमानम् आशयति //
9.1.3.m: He feeds the sacrificer curd, honey, and young sprouting grass in an udumbara [vessel].

9.1.3.s: kṣatrasya yonir asi \\ iti tārpyeṇa dīkṣitavasanam abhidhatte // kṣatrasyolbam asi \\ iti pāṇḍaram̐ sam̐śuddham //
9.1.3.d: क्षत्रस्य योनिर् असि \\ इति तार्प्येण दीक्षितवसनम् अभिधत्ते // क्षत्रस्योल्बम् असि \\ इति पाण्डरम्̐ सम्̐शुद्धम् //
9.1.3.m: With 'You are the womb of royal power', he puts on the consecrated cloth over the tārpya garment; with 'You are the amnion of royal power', a white, well-cleaned [cloth];

9.1.3.s: kṣatrasya nābhir asi \\ ity uṣṇīṣeṇa saṃnahyati /
9.1.3.d: क्षत्रस्य नाभिर् असि \\ इत्य् उष्णीषेण संनह्यति /
9.1.3.m: with 'You are the navel of royal power', he binds on the turban.

9.1.3.s: navanītena saṃdhāpya pañcāśatā dakṣiṇam akṣi cāṅkta ekapañcāśatā /
9.1.3.d: नवनीतेन संधाप्य पञ्चाशता दक्षिणम् अक्षि चाङ्क्त एकपञ्चाशता /
9.1.3.m: Having anointed [his body] with butter, he anoints his right eye with fifty [strokes/splints] and [the left] with fifty-one.

9.1.3.s: apa upaspṛśya \\ āvitto agnir gṛhapatir iti gārhapatyānte yajamānam āvedayati \\ eṣa te janate rājā \\ iti yajamānam āha // somo 'smākaṃ brāhmaṇānām̐ rājā \\ iti japati //
9.1.3.d: अप उपस्पृश्य \\ आवित्तो अग्निर् गृहपतिर् इति गार्हपत्यान्ते यजमानम् आवेदयति \\ एष ते जनते राजा \\ इति यजमानम् आह // सोमो ऽस्माकं ब्राह्मणानाम्̐ राजा \\ इति जपति //
9.1.3.m: Having touched water, he proclaims the sacrificer at the border of the gārhapatya fire with 'Agni the householder has been proclaimed!'; he says to the people, 'This is your king, O people!'; he whispers, 'Soma is the king of us Brahmins.'

9.1.3.s: indrasya vajro 'si vārtraghnas \\ ity adhijyaṃ dhanuḥ prayachati //
9.1.3.d: इन्द्रस्य वज्रो ऽसि वार्त्रघ्नस् \\ इत्य् अधिज्यं धनुः प्रयछति //
9.1.3.m: With 'You are Indra's vajra, slayer of Vṛtra', he hands over the strung bow.

9.1.3.s: śatrubādhanā stha \\ iti trīn vāṇavataḥ pradāya pāta prāñcam \\ pāta pratyañcam iti japati //
9.1.3.d: शत्रुबाधना स्थ \\ इति त्रीन् वाणवतः प्रदाय पात प्राञ्चम् \\ पात प्रत्यञ्चम् इति जपति //
9.1.3.m: Having handed over three barbed arrows with 'You are repressors of enemies', he whispers, 'Protect toward the east; protect toward the west.'

9.1.3.s: mitro 'si \\ iti dakṣiṇam upāvaharati varuṇo 'si \\ iti savyam̐ saheṣubhiḥ //
9.1.3.d: मित्रो ऽसि \\ इति दक्षिणम् उपावहरति वरुणो ऽसि \\ इति सव्यम्̐ सहेषुभिः //
9.1.3.m: With 'You are Mitra', he brings down the right [arm]; with 'You are Varuṇa', the left, together with the arrows.

9.1.3.s: hiraṇyavarṇam uṣaso vyuṣṭā ity etābhir abhimantrayeta //
9.1.3.d: हिरण्यवर्णम् उषसो व्युष्टा इत्य् एताभिर् अभिमन्त्रयेत //
9.1.3.m: He should address [the quarters] with 'Golden-colored', [and] 'At the breakings of dawn'.

9.1.3.s: samidham ā tiṣṭha \\ itiprabhṛtibhir diśo 'nunikrāmati manasā na padābhyām /
9.1.3.d: समिधम् आ तिष्ठ \\ इतिप्रभृतिभिर् दिशो ऽनुनिक्रामति मनसा न पदाभ्याम् /
9.1.3.m: Beginning with 'Mount upon the fuel', he steps along the quarters in mind, not with his feet.

9.1.3.s: agreṇa sadaḥ somasya tviṣir asi \\ iti vyāghracarma viveṣṭya prāggrīvalomam āstṛṇāti /
9.1.3.d: अग्रेण सदः सोमस्य त्विषिर् असि \\ इति व्याघ्रचर्म विवेष्ट्य प्राग्ग्रीवलोमम् आस्तृणाति /
9.1.3.m: In front of the sadas, with 'You are Soma's luster', having rolled out a tiger skin, he spreads it out with the neck and hair turned to the east.

9.1.3.s: tad āruhya japati yajamānaḥ pratyastaṃ namuceḥ śiras \\ iti padā sīsaṃ paṇḍagāya pratyasyati \\ aveṣṭā dandaśūkās \\ iti lohitāyasaṃ keśavāpāya //
9.1.3.d: तद् आरुह्य जपति यजमानः प्रत्यस्तं नमुचेः शिरस् \\ इति पदा सीसं पण्डगाय प्रत्यस्यति \\ अवेष्टा दन्दशूकास् \\ इति लोहितायसं केशवापाय //
9.1.3.m: Having mounted it, the sacrificer whispers; with 'Cast back is the head of Namuci', he casts back a piece of lead to a eunuch with his foot; with 'Warded off are the biting serpents', a piece of copper to the barber.

9.1.3.s: mṛtyoḥ pāhi \\ iti rājatam̐ rukmam adhastāt pādayor upakarṣati sauvarṇam̐ rukmam //
9.1.3.d: मृत्योः पाहि \\ इति राजतम्̐ रुक्मम् अधस्तात् पादयोर् उपकर्षति सौवर्णम्̐ रुक्मम् //
9.1.3.m: With 'Protect from death', he slides a silver gold-plate under the [sacrificer's] feet, [and holds over his head] a golden gold-plate.

9.1.3.s: agnaye svāhā somāya svāhā \\ iti ṣaṭ pārthāni juhoti //
9.1.3.d: अग्नये स्वाहा सोमाय स्वाहा \\ इति षट् पार्थानि जुहोति //
9.1.3.m: With 'To Agni svāhā! To Soma svāhā!', he offers the six pärtha offerings.

9.1.3.s: somasya tvā dyumnena \\ iti samayā sauvarṇam abhiṣiñcati pālāśena dakṣiṇato brahmāśvatthena paścād vaiśya audumbareṇottarato bhrātṛvyaḥ purastād yo janyo mitram̐ sa naiyagrodhena /
9.1.3.d: सोमस्य त्वा द्युम्नेन \\ इति समया सौवर्णम् अभिषिञ्चति पालाशेन दक्षिणतो ब्रह्माश्वत्थेन पश्चाद् वैश्य औदुम्बरेणोत्तरतो भ्रातृव्यः पुरस्ताद् यो जन्यो मित्रम्̐ स नैयग्रोधेन /
9.1.3.m: With 'With Soma's brilliance I [anoint] you', he anoints [him] through the golden [plate]—the brahman priest from the south with a parṇa vessel, the vaiśya from behind with an aśvattha vessel, the rival kinsman from the north with an udumbara vessel, and he who is a friendly foreigner from the front with a nyagrodha vessel.

9.1.3.s: pālāśe saṃpātān avanīyāgnīdhre sādayati //
9.1.3.d: पालाशे संपातान् अवनीयाग्नीध्रे सादयति //
9.1.3.m: Having poured the remnants into the parṇa [vessel], he sets it down in the āgnīdhra fire-shed.

9.1.3.s: indrāya svāhā \\ iti ṣaṭ pārthāni juhoti //
9.1.3.d: इन्द्राय स्वाहा \\ इति षट् पार्थानि जुहोति //
9.1.3.m: With 'To Indra svāhā!', he offers the six pärtha offerings.

9.1.3.s: indrasya yonir asi \\ iti viṣāṇām anumantrayate samāvavṛtrann adharāg udaktās \\ ity abhiṣekam ūrdhvaṃ nābhes triḥ //
9.1.3.d: इन्द्रस्य योनिर् असि \\ इति विषाणाम् अनुमन्त्रयते समाववृत्रन्न् अधराग् उदक्तास् \\ इत्य् अभिषेकम् ऊर्ध्वं नाभेस् त्रिः //
9.1.3.m: With 'You are Indra's womb', he accompanies the [antelope] horn [with a mantra]; with 'Turned downward and upward, they have returned together', [he wipes] the unction three times upward from the navel.

9.1.3.s: indrasya vajro 'si vājasanir iti cātvālānte ratham upāvaharati mitrāvaruṇayos tvā praśāstroḥ praśiṣā yunajmi \\ iti yunakti //
9.1.3.d: इन्द्रस्य वज्रो ऽसि वाजसनिर् इति चात्वालान्ते रथम् उपावहरति मित्रावरुणयोस् त्वा प्रशास्त्रोः प्रशिषा युनज्मि \\ इति युनक्ति //
9.1.3.m: With 'You are Indra's vajra, winner of booty', he brings down the chariot at the border of the pit (cātvāla); with 'By the direction of Mitra and Varuṇa, the two directors, I yoke you', he yokes [it].

9.1.3.s: viṣṇoḥ kramo 'si \\ iti cakre pādam ādadhāti sapatnahā \\ ity ārohati //
9.1.3.d: विष्णोः क्रमो ऽसि \\ इति चक्रे पादम् आदधाति सपत्नहा \\ इत्य् आरोहति //
9.1.3.m: With 'You are the stride of Viṣṇu', he places his foot on the wheel; with 'Slayer of rivals', he mounts [the chariot].

9.1.3.s: marutāṃ prasave jaya \\ iti yāntam anumantrayate /
9.1.3.d: मरुतां प्रसवे जय \\ इति यान्तम् अनुमन्त्रयते /
9.1.3.m: With 'Conquer in the impulse of the Maruts!', he addresses [him] as he drives forth.

9.1.3.s:
asāvi devaṃ goṛjīkam andhas\ ny asminn indro januṣem uvāca /
bodhāmasi tvā haryaśva yajñair \ bodhā na stomam andhaso madeṣu //
ity aindryā triṣṭubhā brahmānveti /
9.1.3.d:
असावि देवं गोऋजीकम् अन्धस्\ न्य् अस्मिन्न् इन्द्रो जनुषेम् उवाच /
बोधामसि त्वा हर्यश्व यज्ञैर् \ बोधा न स्तोमम् अन्धसो मदेषु //
इत्य् ऐन्द्र्या त्रिष्टुभा ब्रह्मान्वेति /
9.1.3.m:
'The divine soma-juice, mixed with milk, has been pressed out; Indra has declared it in this one since his birth.'

'We perceive you, O bay-horsed one, with sacrifices; perceive our song of praise in the exhilarations of the soma-juice!'

With this triṣṭubh verse addressed to Indra, the brahman priest follows.

9.1.3.s: rājanyaṃ jināti / tasmai tām iṣum asyati /
9.1.3.d: राजन्यं जिनाति / तस्मै ताम् इषुम् अस्यति /
9.1.3.m: He overpowers a rājanya; he shoots that arrow at him.

9.1.3.s: vrataṃ gṛhītvā \\ āptaṃ manaḥ \ sam indriyeṇa \\ ity uktvā vartate //
9.1.3.d: व्रतं गृहीत्वा \\ आप्तं मनः \ सम् इन्द्रियेण \\ इत्य् उक्त्वा वर्तते //
9.1.3.m: Having taken the vow, having said, 'Attained is the mind, together with the faculties', he turns back.

9.1.3.s: eṣa vajro vājasātamas tena nau putro vājam̐ set \\ iti patnyai dhanvāni prayachati /
9.1.3.d: एष वज्रो वाजसातमस् तेन नौ पुत्रो वाजम्̐ सेत् \\ इति पत्न्यै धन्वानि प्रयछति /
9.1.3.m: With 'This is the vajra, most winning of booty; with it may our son win booty', he gives the bows to his wife.

9.1.3.s: tāny añjalinā pratigṛhṇāti /
9.1.3.d: तान्य् अञ्जलिना प्रतिगृह्णाति /
9.1.3.m: She receives them with cupped hands.

9.1.3.s: mārutasya payasyāś ca samavadāyāniruktena sviṣṭakṛtā pracarya rukmān anumantrayata /
9.1.3.d: मारुतस्य पयस्याश् च समवदायानिरुक्तेन स्विष्टकृता प्रचर्य रुक्मान् अनुमन्त्रयत /
9.1.3.m: Having cut portions together from the [offering] to the Maruts and from the curd offering, and having performed [the rite] with the unexpressed Sviṣṭakṛt, he accompanies the gold-plates with a mantra.

9.1.4.s: iyad asi \\ iti rājatam̐ sauvarṇam̐ sūtram̐ yuṅṅ asi \\ iti sauvarṇam̐ sūtram ūrg asi \\ ity audumbaram̐ haritasūtram //
9.1.4.d: इयद् असि \\ इति राजतम्̐ सौवर्णम्̐ सूत्रम्̐ युङ्ङ् असि \\ इति सौवर्णम्̐ सूत्रम् ऊर्ग् असि \\ इत्य् औदुम्बरम्̐ हरितसूत्रम् //
9.1.4.m: With 'So much you are', [he ties on] the silver plate with a golden thread; with 'You are joined', the golden plate with a [golden] thread; with 'You are food', the udumbara plate with a green thread.

9.1.4.s: mitro 'si \\ iti dakṣiṇam upāvaharati varuṇo 'si \\ iti savyam /
9.1.4.d: मित्रो ऽसि \\ इति दक्षिणम् उपावहरति वरुणो ऽसि \\ इति सव्यम् /
9.1.4.m: With 'You are Mitra', he lowers the right [arm]; with 'You are Varuṇa', the left.

9.1.4.s: sahāyudhaṃ pratyañcaṃ kṛtvā pratihitāya prayachati //
9.1.4.d: सहायुधं प्रत्यञ्चं कृत्वा प्रतिहिताय प्रयछति //
9.1.4.m: Having made it face west together with the weapon, he hands it over to the substitute (pratihita).

9.1.4.s: sad asi \ sam aham̐ viśvair devair iti hastāv āmikṣām abhyavaharati /
9.1.4.d: सद् असि \ सम् अहम्̐ विश्वैर् देवैर् इति हस्ताव् आमिक्षाम् अभ्यवहरति /
9.1.4.m: With 'You are the seat; united am I with all the gods', he brings his two hands down into the curd (āmikṣā).

9.1.4.s: tatra te hiraṇye dadāty audumbaram̐ vābadhnīte //
9.1.4.d: तत्र ते हिरण्ये ददात्य् औदुम्बरम्̐ वाबध्नीते //
9.1.4.m: There he gives those two pieces of gold; or he ties on the udumbara [amulet].

9.1.4.s: namo mātre pṛthivyai \\ iti vārāhī upānahā abhyavarohati //
9.1.4.d: नमो मात्रे पृथिव्यै \\ इति वाराही उपानहा अभ्यवरोहति //
9.1.4.m: With 'Homage to Mother Earth!', he steps down onto boar-skin sandals.

9.1.4.s: paśūnāṃ manyur asi \ taveva me manyur bhūyād iti pratimuñcati //
9.1.4.d: पशूनां मन्युर् असि \ तवेव मे मन्युर् भूयाद् इति प्रतिमुञ्चति //
9.1.4.m: With 'You are the anger of animals; may my anger be like yours', he puts them on.

9.1.4.s: prati tyan nāma rājyam adhāyi \\ iti japati //
9.1.4.d: प्रति त्यन् नाम राज्यम् अधायि \\ इति जपति //
9.1.4.m: He whispers, 'That celebrated royal power has been assumed.'

9.1.4.s: syonāsi suṣadā \\ ity uttarata āhavanīyasyāsandīm avasthāpayati syonām āsīda \ suṣadām āsīda \\ ity āsandīm ārohantam anumantrayate niṣasāda ghṛtavratas \\ ity ārūḍham //
9.1.4.d: स्योनासि सुषदा \\ इत्य् उत्तरत आहवनीयस्यासन्दीम् अवस्थापयति स्योनाम् आसीद \ सुषदाम् आसीद \\ इत्य् आसन्दीम् आरोहन्तम् अनुमन्त्रयते निषसाद घृतव्रतस् \\ इत्य् आरूढम् //
9.1.4.m: With 'You are pleasant, comfortable to sit on', he places the chair north of the āhavanīya fire; with 'Sit on the pleasant, sit on the comfortable', he accompanies [the sacrificer] mounting the chair; with 'He has sat down, he whose vow is steadfast', [he accompanies him when he is] seated.

9.1.4.s: agnaye svāhā \ somāya svāhā \\ iti rathavimocanīnaṃ juhoti //
9.1.4.d: अग्नये स्वाहा \ सोमाय स्वाहा \\ इति रथविमोचनीनं जुहोति //
9.1.4.m: With 'To Agni svāhā! To Soma svāhā!', he offers the chariot-releasing oblations.

9.1.4.s: ham̐saḥ śuciṣad iti saha sārathinā rathavāhane ratham ādadhāti /
9.1.4.d: हम्̐सः शुचिषद् इति सह सारथिना रथवाहने रथम् आदधाति /
9.1.4.m: With 'The swan seated in the pure', together with the charioteer, he places the chariot on the chariot-stand.

9.1.4.s: adhvaryave śataṃ datvāvarohati dāsyan vā /
9.1.4.d: अध्वर्यवे शतं दत्वावरोहति दास्यन् वा /
9.1.4.m: Having given a hundred [cows] to the adhvaryu, he steps down, or intending to give [them].

9.1.4.s: kṣayamāṇo hiraṇyakūrce hiraṇyakaśipuni cāsīnaḥ śaunaḥśepam̐ hotā vyācaste /
9.1.4.d: क्षयमाणो हिरण्यकूर्चे हिरण्यकशिपुनि चासीनः शौनःशेपम्̐ होता व्याचस्ते /
9.1.4.m: Seated at ease on a golden bundle of grass and a golden cushion, the hotṛ priest recites the story of Śunaḥśepa.

9.1.4.s: adhvaryuḥ pratigṛṇāti \\ adhvaryo brahma vadāma \\ ity āmantrayate \\ om̐ hotar ity ṛkṣu tathā hotar iti gathām /
9.1.4.d: अध्वर्युः प्रतिगृणाति \\ अध्वर्यो ब्रह्म वदाम \\ इत्य् आमन्त्रयते \\ ओम्̐ होतर् इत्य् ऋक्षु तथा होतर् इति गथाम् /
9.1.4.m: The adhvaryu responds; [the hotṛ] addresses [him] with 'O adhvaryu, let us speak the sacred word!'; [the adhvaryu responds] with 'Om, O hotṛ' to the verses, and with 'So, O hotṛ' to the narrative verses (gāthās).

9.1.4.s: samāpte śatam̐ hotre dadāti sahasraṃ pratigaritre /
9.1.4.d: समाप्ते शतम्̐ होत्रे ददाति सहस्रं प्रतिगरित्रे /
9.1.4.m: When it is completed, he gives a hundred [cows] to the hotṛ, and a thousand to the respondent (pratigartṛ).

9.1.4.s: madhyataḥkāriṇo yajamānaṃ paryupaviśanti pratihitaś codañco ratninaḥ senānīprabhṛtayo 'nye takṣarathakārābhyām //
9.1.4.d: मध्यतःकारिणो यजमानं पर्युपविशन्ति प्रतिहितश् चोदञ्चो रत्निनः सेनानीप्रभृतयो ऽन्ये तक्षरथकाराभ्याम् //
9.1.4.m: The central officiants sit around the sacrificer, and facing north, the substitute and the jewel-bearers (ratnins), beginning with the army commander, [and] others, including the carpenter and the chariot-maker.

9.1.4.s: brahman \\ tvaṃ me brahmāsi \\ iti yajamāno madhyataḥkāriṇām ekaikam āmantrayate //
9.1.4.d: ब्रह्मन् \\ त्वं मे ब्रह्मासि \\ इति यजमानो मध्यतःकारिणाम् एकैकम् आमन्त्रयते //
9.1.4.m: The sacrificer addresses each of the central officiants with 'O brahman, you are my brahman priest!'

9.1.4.s: savitāsi satyasavas \\ iti brahmā pratyāha mitro 'si suśevas \\ ity udgātā \\ indro 'si satyaujās \\ iti hotā varuṇo 'si viśvaujās \\ ity adhvaryuḥ //
9.1.4.d: सवितासि सत्यसवस् \\ इति ब्रह्मा प्रत्याह मित्रो ऽसि सुशेवस् \\ इत्य् उद्गाता \\ इन्द्रो ऽसि सत्यौजास् \\ इति होता वरुणो ऽसि विश्वौजास् \\ इत्य् अध्वर्युः //
9.1.4.m: The brahman responds, 'You are Savitṛ of true impulse'; the udgātṛ, 'You are Mitra of kindly favor'; the hotṛ, 'You are Indra of true strength'; the adhvaryu, 'You are Varuṇa of universal strength.'

9.1.4.s: eṣa vajras tena me radhya \\ iti sphyaṃ prayachati brahmā yajamānāya yajamānaḥ pratihitāya pratihitaḥ senānye senānīprabhṛtaya ākṣaṇivapāt /
9.1.4.d: एष वज्रस् तेन मे रध्य \\ इति स्फ्यं प्रयछति ब्रह्मा यजमानाय यजमानः प्रतिहिताय प्रतिहितः सेनान्ये सेनानीप्रभृतय आक्षणिवपात् /
9.1.4.m: With 'This is the vajra; through it be subject to me', the brahman priest hands the wooden sword to the sacrificer, the sacrificer to the substitute, the substitute to the army commander, and those beginning with the army commander down to the dice-thrower.

9.1.4.s: sphyenādhidevanaṃ kṛtvā kṛtasaṃpūtān sūdayan nivapati /
9.1.4.d: स्फ्येनाधिदेवनं कृत्वा कृतसंपूतान् सूदयन् निवपति /
9.1.4.m: Having prepared the gaming ground with the wooden sword, smoothing it, he casts down the dice purified as the winning set (kṛta).

9.1.4.s: tatra paṣṭhauhī prasuvati /
9.1.4.d: तत्र पष्ठौही प्रसुवति /
9.1.4.m: There they drive up a four-year-old cow.

9.1.4.s: tāṃ catvāro vidīvyante brāhmaṇo rājanyo vaiśyaḥ śūdraḥ /
9.1.4.d: तां चत्वारो विदीव्यन्ते ब्राह्मणो राजन्यो वैश्यः शूद्रः /
